chapters.title: Chapter 1651: Challenge The Asura Guardians
paragraphs: *Bam*
Wu Han and Niu Jie, who were having sex, were shocked when their door flew open with a loud bang.
"Shit!" Niu Jie got out of bed with a terrified expression as soon as he saw Wu Zu.
Seeing that the male demon beast wanted to escape, Wu Zu moved toward Niu Jie; however, Wu Han blocked her path, and their attacks clashed, causing both women to be knocked back.
"What do you mean by this, Wu Zu?" Wu Han gasped when he saw Dong Xuanyin and Qi Qingxiu in front of the door. ’Crap! Why are they here?’
Qi Qingxiu said nothing and stretched her right hand forward, causing Niu Jie, who wanted to escape, to stiffen in place. ’Crap! I will die in this place!’

Qi Qingxiu looked at Wu Han and spoke to her. "I don’t care or want to interfere in the affairs of the three of you, but my husband needs some items from you, and you have to give them to him. If you refuse, I will cripple your cultivation and kill your lover."

Wu Han wasn’t afraid of Wu Zu, but Qi Qingxiu was above them because she was a demon god. She looked at Zhang Fei [5], who stood between the two women with an indifferent expression. ’Is that lust demon her husband? How could he subdue a demon god like her with his cultivation still at the Celestial Emperor Realm?’
"Hehe," Dong Xuanyin chuckled. "You should listen to her, Wu Han. Qingxiu is not a patient woman, and she will not repeat her words."
Wu Han took a deep breath. "What do you want from me, Demon God Qingxiu?"

"All the materials for concocting the Bloodfiend Frenzy Elixir." Wu Han raised an eyebrow. "You don’t need to pretend in front of me because I know you helped Sha Mo concoct the elixir, and you also helped him to give it to Shang Zhanluo. If I hand you over to the Asura Demon Race, I’m sure Shang Luohu will be happy to torture you, and she will probably throw you into the Blood Sea to bait the Slaughter Blood Phantom, especially after what you did to her husband."

’Shit! How could she know about that? I still don’t know the location of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain, so I can’t ask Sha Mo for help, and I’ll die if Demon God Qingxiu hands me over to the Asura Empress.’ Wu Han was completely shocked by this, and she hurriedly took out five demon items before throwing them at Qi Qingxiu. "I only have one batch left, and you can have them. Please don’t tell Shang Luohu about the matter, or he will hunt me down and kill me."
"Naturally, I wouldn’t do that because there are only a few of your races remaining." Qi Qingxiu handed all five items to Zhang Fei [5]. "Keep them, husband."
"Yeah," Zhang Fei [5] stored them in the system inventory. ’Can you clone these five materials like the beast core, Mei?’
[The Science Capsule should be able to do it, Master.]
’Alright! One of my clones will be entering the training space, so you can help him clone those five items.’
[Yes, Master.]
Qi Qingxiu looked at Wu Zu. "Finish your business now, and we’ll return to your domain afterward."
"Leave that demon beast to me, Wu Han."
"No!" Wu Han stood in front of Niu Jie. "If you want to kill him, you’ll have to kill me too."
"You—"

"I don’t think you need to kill him." Wu Zu looked at Dong Xuanyin. "I know the rules in your race, but your sister clearly loves him, and there are only a few of your race left. If you kill him, he will definitely commit suicide, and that will only be detrimental to your race. Even if their descendants will be mixed descendants, at least their descendants will inherit your witch demon bloodline, right?"
Wu Zu let out a soft sigh. "You’re in luck, idiot ox! If you dare hurt my sister’s feelings, I’ll kill you by dismembering your body!"
Niu Jie, who was under the influence of Qi Qingxiu’s abilities, shuddered at Wu Zu’s threat.
"Can you send them back to the Endless Domain, Zhang Fei?"

"Easy," Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate to the domain, causing Wu Han’s jaw to drop. "Bring your lover inside before your sister changes her mind! Also, you better not tell Sha Mo about us, or I’ll torture you myself. Do you understand?"

’Tch! If it weren’t for Demon God Qingxiu and Dong Xuanyin by your side, I would definitely kill you straight away!’ Wu Han nodded to Zhang Fei [5], and Qi Qingxiu immediately removed his ability from Niu Jie. After that, they packed their things and entered the gate.
Zhang Fei [5] closed the gate and asked Wu Zhu. "How long will it take you to concoct the antidote?"
"The process of concocting the antidote for the Bloodfiend Frenzy Elixir is extremely complicated, so it will take me a month at the very least."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "I think we still have time, so you can focus on concocting the antidote, and I’ll come to your place in a month."
"Alright." Wu Zu nodded. "As for your previous offer, you can send me to the Endless Domain after I complete the antidote, and I’ll discuss it with my race members then."

"Okay." Zhang Fei [5] gave those ingredients to Wu Zu after one of his clones finished concocting them, and he sent her back to her domain. "I’ll send you back to your domain because Qiongqi and the other three are almost there, and you can watch over them for me, Xuanyin."
"When will they get there?"

"Around a week or so." Dong Xuanyin nodded in understanding. "You can monitor them, but the most important thing is to monitor the appearance of those shadowy creatures, and we must not be caught off guard by them. If they invade this realm, the problem will become even more complicated, and there will be even more casualties."
"Send me back now."
Dong Xuanyin immediately disappeared into the gate as soon as Zhang Fei [5] opened it, but he quickly closed it and opened another gate. "Let’s go, Qingxiu."

When they arrived at the Asura Demon Castle, Zhang Fei [5] and Qi Qingxiu saw Shang Luohu sparring with Shang Xueli. However, the Asura Demon Empress could not keep up with her daughter’s speed because she had been training in the training space for years, and she had adapted to level seven gravity, making her speed far surpass her mother’s.
Shang Luohu and Shang Xueli immediately stopped their spar. "Are you done with your business? Are you going to take my daughter away?"
"Not yet," Zhang Fei [5] replied with a shake of his head. "As for your husband’s condition, I can cure him in a month at the earliest."
"Eh? Does that mean you’ve already found out about my husband’s condition?"

"One of the witch demon race members helped me create the antidote, and I’ll bring it here when she’s done." Shang Luohu frowned upon hearing that, but she also felt relieved because the situation in their domain was getting more chaotic with Shang Zhanluo’s absence. "I want to fight the five Asura Demon Guardians, so I want you to summon them here."
Shang Luohu wasn’t surprised to hear that after her daughter told her some things about Zhang Fei [5]. "I’ll ask them to come here now."
"Thank you."

"They’ll be here in a few minutes." Then, Shang Luohu asked him. "How did you train my daughter? Her current cultivation is still at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but her speed has already far surpassed mine."

"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "Our relationship is still normal, so I won’t tell you about it. As for your daughter, I’m preparing her to be your husband’s successor. At that time, she will be able to control your race, and none of them will be able to oppose her."

Shang Luohu looked at her daughter before nodding to Zhang Fei [5]. "My daughter is our only successor, and she is the hope for the future of our race. For now, my husband has not been considered retiring, and her cultivation is not yet worthy of being the leader of our demon race."

"In fact, your daughter is quite strong now, but it’s still not enough, so she should train under me for a few more decades. By then, she will be unrivaled, and she will be fully worthy of becoming the next Asura Demon God." Shang Xueli sighed inwardly because she never dreamed of becoming the leader of their demon race, but she had no other choice, especially when her father retired later. "Hey! I’ve known you for more than two decades, so I know that you are worthy of being the leader of your race, and you just need to train harder for it."
"I have no other choice, right?" Shang Xueli smiled bitterly. "Even though I don’t like being a leader, I’ll still inherit it from my father, so I’ll continue to prepare myself until the time comes."
"That’s good." Zhang Fei [5] turned to the four asura demon guardians who had just arrived. "The last time we sparred was over six years ago, and I wanted to spar with all of you today."

"Hahaha," Shang Dongzhu laughed upon hearing that. "I don’t know how your cultivation reached the Celestial Emperor Realm in the past six years, but you still haven’t reached my level, so you won’t be able to defeat me."
Zhang Fei [5] smiled casually. "You will be surprised later."

chapters.title: Chapter 1652: Defeat The Three Guardians
paragraphs: As in the past, Zhang Fei [5] stood face-to-face with Shang Xijiao because he was the weakest among the four asura guardians.
"Haha," Shang Xijiao laughed. "Your strength has indeed improved a lot, but I have also improved in the past six years or so. Back then, I lost to you, but I won’t lose to you again this time."
Zhang Fei [5] smiled casually. "I will make my move now."
"Gah!" Shang Xijiao groaned in pain as he fell to his knees on one leg, feeling excruciating pain in his abdomen from Zhang Fei [5]’s punch.

Not only was Shang Xijiao shocked by that, but so were the other three asura guardians. They looked at Zhang Fei [5] with their brows furrowed. They couldn’t see him move, but their friend had suddenly fallen down.

Shang Luohu was particularly surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s speed. However, she was more curious about the power of his punch, and she felt that the power of his punch just now was on par with her husband’s.

Shang Xueli smirked, looking at Shang Xijiao’s painful expression. ’Hey! He could even keep up with Demon God Mingran, Demon God Qingxiu, and Demon God Shizhe! You are definitely not their opponent with your cultivation below theirs.’

Qi Qingxiu’s lips curled up as she folded her arms across her chest, watching Shang Xijiao’s expression. ’Even a demon god like me would find it difficult to defeat my husband in a spar, let alone mere asura guardians like them.’
"How—"
"I trained hard," Zhang Fei [5] replied briefly. "Do you want to continue? I’m confident I’ll win against you as long as you don’t use your bloodline awakening technique."

In fact, Zhang Fei [5] was confident that he could still defeat Shang Xijiao even if he used his bloodline awakening technique, but he would rather not show his full abilities to the four asura demon guardians, at least not until he could defeat Shang Zhanluo.

Shang Xijiao stared at him for a long moment before standing up. "You’re right, I could never have defeated you without that technique. Since this is just a sparring match, I won’t use that technique, and I admit defeat."
"Thank you."

After Shang Xijiao walked to the side, Shang Nanzhui walked towards Zhang Fei [5], standing in front of him. "Your progress, especially your speed, is truly impressive, Kid. I couldn’t even see you move, and you’ve already taken down your enemy."
"Let’s fight." Shang Nanzhui was knocked back several steps as soon as Zhang Fei [5] moved and punched his chest.

As before, Shang Nanzhui still couldn’t see Zhang Fei [5]’s movement, and he also felt that the force of his punch was much heavier than it had been a few years ago. As an experienced demon cultivator, he naturally knew that every breakthrough would also increase one’s physical strength, but this increase in his strength was simply too absurd.

Unfortunately, Shang Nanzhui was unaware that Zhang Fei [5] had learned several new body techniques since their last fight, some of which had already reached their maximum effectiveness, significantly increasing his strength compared to other cultivators.
At that time, Zhang Fei [5] had only adapted to level five gravity, but he had now adapted to level eight gravity, which significantly increased his speed.

Shang Nanzhui tried to attack Zhang Fei [5], but all his attacks hit nothing but empty air; instead, he was repeatedly hit by his counterattacks. No matter how fast he increased his speed, he never managed to land a hit on his body, which frustrated him.
After they sparred for a while, Shang Nanzhui decided to give up and admit defeat. "You were amazing, kid. How did you increase your speed so much?"
"Naturally, I have my own training method, but I won’t teach it to outsiders, and I’ll only teach it to those closest to me." Zhang Fei [5] casually replied.

Shang Nanzhui simply nodded and went to the side of the area, and Shang Beixuan replaced him. "Back then, I was superior to you, but you’ve grown tremendously since then, and I have to admit that your progress is amazing. If so, I will fight with you more earnestly than in the past, and I hope you won’t disappoint me."
"You won’t be disappointed."
Zhang Fei [5] made the first move. His feet slammed into the ground, sending dust flying as he charged like a raging bull. His fist smashed forward—without any technique, just overwhelming force.
Shang Beixuan did not back down in the face of it, and he welcomed Zhang Fei [5]’s punch head-on.
*Boom*

A wave of wind swept across the area as their fists collided. Shang Beixuan was shocked as he was pushed back by Zhang Fei [5]’s punch just now, and he felt numbness in his hand. He twisted his right hand as he massaged his shoulders to relieve the numbness. "You are truly a monster, kid! In just over six years, your attack power has increased several times higher than during our last fight. If my cultivation were at your level, and if I hadn’t trained my body, the bones of my hand would have been crushed by your fist."

"Unfortunately, such progress is still not enough, and I still have to develop myself until I reach the same level as those demon gods." Zhang Fei [5] took a stance before dashing toward him again. "Try this."
"Come!" Shang Beixuan once again met his punch with his right hand.
*Boom*

The clash between their fists was greater than before, and the wind sweeping through the area became even stronger. This time, both were knocked back, but they didn’t stop there and immediately charged at each other again, clashing their fists once more.

Zhang Fei [5] and Shang Beixuan exchanged blows for some time, and their clash continued to end in a draw. However, the situation changed when the former increased his speed, making his movements difficult for the latter to anticipate, as well as his punches.
Shang Beixuan tried to increase his strength and speed, but all his efforts were futile in the face of Zhang Fei [5]’s speed.
Shang Beixuan couldn’t see Zhang Fei [5]’s movements, and all his attacks always hit the afterimages of his Clone Illusion Steps.

At the side of the room, Shang Dongzhu folded his arms in front of him and frowned. His eyes tried to follow Zhang Fei [5]’s movements, but his speed was truly breakneck, preventing him from seeing his figure. ’This little demon! How did his speed become that fast? If I had his speed, I might be able to defeat Shang Zhanluo, and I could become the next demon god of our asura demon race. Tch! It would be dangerous if I gave him time to develop further, and he would become a threat to me in the future. I have to do something about him, and I have to make it look like an accident.’

Qi Qingxiu raised an eyebrow as she sensed Shang Dongzhu’s killing intent. She looked at him with narrowed eyes. ’Heh! If you think about killing my husband, I will teach you a lesson you will never forget for the rest of your life. Even so, I don’t need to worry about him, and I’m sure he can defeat you on his own.’

After they sparred for some time, Shang Beixuan decided to end their fight. He landed in front of Zhang Fei [5], who smiled casually. "Six years ago, I was still superior to you, but six years later, I have to admit defeat to you. If you continue to improve this quickly, you might become the first lust demon who can match my demon god in normal strength."
"Thank you for your time, Senior Beixuan."
"We’ll fight again in a few years, and I won’t lose to you again then."
"Fine with me." Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Shang Dongzhu because he also felt his killing intent earlier. ’Since you want to kill me, I have to fight seriously.’
"Mother." Shan Xueli hugged her mother’s arm. "He—"

"Yes," Shang Luohu nodded to her. "You don’t need to worry about Zhang Fei because I’ve sensed Shang Dongzhu’s killing intent since earlier, and I’ve already asked Shang Zhui to make a move if she wants to kill him. Besides, Demon God Qingxiu is here, and she will definitely act to save her husband."

Shang Xueli glanced at Qi Qingxiu, seeing a strange smile on her face. ’Sigh! I hope Shang Dongzhu won’t be that crazy, or he will die today. If he dies, our Asura Demon Race’s strength will decrease, and it will take a long time to find a replacement for him.’
Shang Dongzhu was already standing in front of Zhang Fei [5], and he didn’t bother to hide his killing intent. His gaze was so vicious that it seemed as if he wanted to swallow him alive.
Zhang Fei [5] was still relaxed in the face of Shang Dongzhu’s killing intent, and he released his own killing intent.

"Hmm?" Shang Dongzhu frowned as he remembered the incident a few years ago when Zhang Fei [5] showed his killing intent to them, but he didn’t expect it to have become so much stronger than it was then. "Looks like you’ve killed a lot since that day, kid."

"Kill or be killed is the law in the cultivation world, so I have no other choice but to kill my enemies." Shang Dongzhu frowned deeply. "Even though my cultivation is still far below yours, it won’t be easy for you to kill me; instead, you will be the one to die by my hands today."
Shang Dongzhu smirked. "Is that so? Let me try your current strength then."

Shang Nanzhui tried to attack Zhang Fei [5], but all his attacks hit nothing but empty air; instead, he was repeatedly hit by his counterattacks.
No matter how fast he increased his speed, he never managed to land a hit on his body, which frustrated him.
After they sparred for a while, Shang Nanzhui decided to give up and admit defeat.
"You were amazing, kid.
How did you increase your speed so much?"
"Naturally, I have my own training method, but I won’t teach it to outsiders, and I’ll only teach it to those closest to me." Zhang Fei [5] casually replied.
Shang Nanzhui simply nodded and went to the side of the area, and Shang Beixuan replaced him.
"Back then, I was superior to you, but you’ve grown tremendously since then, and I have to admit that your progress is amazing.
If so, I will fight with you more earnestly than in the past, and I hope you won’t disappoint me."
"You won’t be disappointed."
Zhang Fei [5] made the first move.
His feet slammed into the ground, sending dust flying as he charged like a raging bull.
His fist smashed forward—without any technique, just overwhelming force.
Shang Beixuan did not back down in the face of it, and he welcomed Zhang Fei [5]’s punch head-on.
*Boom*
A wave of wind swept across the area as their fists collided.
Shang Beixuan was shocked as he was pushed back by Zhang Fei [5]’s punch just now, and he felt numbness in his hand.
He twisted his right hand as he massaged his shoulders to relieve the numbness.
"You are truly a monster, kid!
In just over six years, your attack power has increased several times higher than during our last fight.
If my cultivation were at your level, and if I hadn’t trained my body, the bones of my hand would have been crushed by your fist."
"Unfortunately, such progress is still not enough, and I still have to develop myself until I reach the same level as those demon gods." Zhang Fei [5] took a stance before dashing toward him again.
"Try this."
"Come!" Shang Beixuan once again met his punch with his right hand.
*Boom*
The clash between their fists was greater than before, and the wind sweeping through the area became even stronger.
This time, both were knocked back, but they didn’t stop there and immediately charged at each other again, clashing their fists once more.
Zhang Fei [5] and Shang Beixuan exchanged blows for some time, and their clash continued to end in a draw.
However, the situation changed when the former increased his speed, making his movements difficult for the latter to anticipate, as well as his punches.
Shang Beixuan tried to increase his strength and speed, but all his efforts were futile in the face of Zhang Fei [5]’s speed.
Shang Beixuan couldn’t see Zhang Fei [5]’s movements, and all his attacks always hit the afterimages of his Clone Illusion Steps.
At the side of the room, Shang Dongzhu folded his arms in front of him and frowned.
His eyes tried to follow Zhang Fei [5]’s movements, but his speed was truly breakneck, preventing him from seeing his figure. ’This little demon!
How did his speed become that fast?
If I had his speed, I might be able to defeat Shang Zhanluo, and I could become the next demon god of our asura demon race.
Tch!
It would be dangerous if I gave him time to develop further, and he would become a threat to me in the future.
I have to do something about him, and I have to make it look like an accident.’
Qi Qingxiu raised an eyebrow as she sensed Shang Dongzhu’s killing intent.
She looked at him with narrowed eyes. ’Heh!
If you think about killing my husband, I will teach you a lesson you will never forget for the rest of your life.
Even so, I don’t need to worry about him, and I’m sure he can defeat you on his own.’
After they sparred for some time, Shang Beixuan decided to end their fight.
He landed in front of Zhang Fei [5], who smiled casually.
"Six years ago, I was still superior to you, but six years later, I have to admit defeat to you.
If you continue to improve this quickly, you might become the first lust demon who can match my demon god in normal strength."
"Thank you for your time, Senior Beixuan."
"We’ll fight again in a few years, and I won’t lose to you again then."
"Fine with me." Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Shang Dongzhu because he also felt his killing intent earlier. ’Since you want to kill me, I have to fight seriously.’
"Mother." Shan Xueli hugged her mother’s arm.
"He—"
"Yes," Shang Luohu nodded to her.
"You don’t need to worry about Zhang Fei because I’ve sensed Shang Dongzhu’s killing intent since earlier, and I’ve already asked Shang Zhui to make a move if she wants to kill him.
Besides, Demon God Qingxiu is here, and she will definitely act to save her husband."
Shang Xueli glanced at Qi Qingxiu, seeing a strange smile on her face. ’Sigh!
I hope Shang Dongzhu won’t be that crazy, or he will die today.
If he dies, our Asura Demon Race’s strength will decrease, and it will take a long time to find a replacement for him.’
Shang Dongzhu was already standing in front of Zhang Fei [5], and he didn’t bother to hide his killing intent.
His gaze was so vicious that it seemed as if he wanted to swallow him alive.
Zhang Fei [5] was still relaxed in the face of Shang Dongzhu’s killing intent, and he released his own killing intent.

"Hmm?" Shang Dongzhu frowned as he remembered the incident a few years ago when Zhang Fei [5] showed his killing intent to them, but he didn’t expect it to have become so much stronger than it was then.
"Looks like you’ve killed a lot since that day, kid."
"Kill or be killed is the law in the cultivation world, so I have no other choice but to kill my enemies." Shang Dongzhu frowned deeply.
"Even though my cultivation is still far below yours, it won’t be easy for you to kill me; instead, you will be the one to die by my hands today."
Shang Dongzhu smirked.
"Is that so?
Let me try your current strength then."

chapters.title: Chapter 1653: Zhang Fei Vs Shang Dongzhu
paragraphs: *Boom*

Shang Dongzhu was thrown back after his fist collided with Zhang Fei [5]’s. He hurriedly stabilized himself and looked at him with narrowed eyes. ’What exactly happened? Did he use a strengthening technique? For a split second, I felt his strength became equal to mine, but it has since returned to normal.’

Shang Beixuan, Shang Nanzhui, and Shang Xijiao looked at Zhang Fei [5] in disbelief. Shang Dongzhu was the strongest among the four asura guardians, but he was able to knock him back. However, they couldn’t sense the change in his strength, which lasted only a split second.
Zhang Fei [5] stood in the air as he looked at Shang Dongzhu. "What do you think of the power of my punch just now, Senior?"

"Not bad." Shang Dongzhu still narrowed his eyes, trying to analyze the qi within Zhang Fei [5]’s body. "I don’t know how you did it, but I’m sure you used a strengthening technique just before our fists clashed."
"Are you sure about that?" Zhang Fei [5] calmly asked. "Even if you were right that I used strengthening techniques, my strength should still not be on par with yours, right?"
Shang Dongzhu said nothing and immediately flew towards Zhang Fei [5] again. This time, he used 50% of his strength to attack him, but his fist pierced through the afterimage.
At the same time, Zhang Fei [5] moved behind Shang Dongzhu. He quickly swung his right leg at his back, but a blood shield appeared on the male asura guardian’s back, bouncing him back.
Shang Dongzhu spun around and punched toward Zhang Fei [5], but again, his fist went through another afterimage. Not only was he shocked by it, but the other three asura guardians were shocked by it.

Shang Beixuan, Shang Nanzhui, and Shang Xijiao were well aware of Shang Dongzhu’s speed. He was the fastest among them, but they felt that Zhang Fei [5]’s movements were much faster than his, and he could use his techniques without any qi moving in his body, preventing them from predicting his next move.

Qi Qingxiu smirked as she watched Shang Dongzhu trying to find Zhang Fei [5]’s whereabouts. Even though her speed was much faster than his, she sometimes couldn’t see his movements, let alone the male asura guardian. ’Heh! Your eyes won’t be able to see his movements, and your senses won’t be able to sense his aura because he can suppress it so deeply that it’s imperceptible. The only person who can see his movements and feel his aura is Feng Yao.’

Shang Luohu had sparred with Shang Xueli before, and she knew her daughter’s speed was much faster than hers, but she felt that Zhang Fei [5] was even faster. ’No wonder he’s confident in fighting Shang Dongzhu.’

’That kid used a strengthening technique earlier, Empress.’ Shang Luohu raised an eyebrow when Shang Zhui spoke in her mind. ’Even though he used the technique, the qi in his body did not experience the slightest change, and his qi was as calm as still water.’
Shang Luohu glanced at her daughter, Shang Xueli, who was smiling to herself. The look in her eyes clearly showed that she was confident in Zhang Fei [5].
*Boom*
Shang Dongzhu was knocked back again after Zhang Fei [5] suddenly appeared and launched a lightning-fast punch at his chest, preventing him or his blood shield from blocking the attack.
’His punch was truly heavy! It was as heavy as my demon god’s punch.’ Shang Dongzhu rubbed his chest as he searched for Zhang Fei [5], who had disappeared from his sight again.
Zhang Fei [5] did not want to fight Shang Dongzhu directly because he was the strongest among the four asura guardians, so he chose the hit-and-run method to deal with him.

Shang Dongzhu was certain that Zhang Fei [5] was using his strengthening technique, even though he couldn’t detect any changes in his qi. He summoned several blood shields that revolved around his body, and he believed they were enough to prevent him from attacking him.

However, a powerful blow suddenly struck Shang Dongzhu’s body and sent him flying backwards, forcing him to stabilize himself. ’Damn it! This little bastard’s speed is so fast, his punches are getting heavier, and he can hide his presence so well that he can’t be detected.’
"Hey!" Shang Dongzhu looked at Qi Qingxiu. "Give up! You will never be able to defeat my husband!"

"Humph!" Shang Dongzhu snorted at Qi Qingxiu as he continued trying to track down Zhang Fei [5]. All the blood shields turned into a sphere, covering his body. "I want to see how you will attack me now, kid."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei [5] appeared in the distance while laughing. "Your blood sphere is powerful, but it won’t be enough to protect you."
"Bullshit!" Shang Dongzhu roared. "Prove it!"
"Alright," Zhang Fei [5] opened both his palms. A golden flame appeared on his left palm, and a deep red flame appeared on his right palm. "Are you ready?"

Shang Dongzhu furrowed his brows as he looked at Zhang Fei [5]’s two flames. Unlike his golden flame, his deep red flame gave him ominous feelings that made his body tremble. ’What kind of flame is that?’

The asura empress and the other three asura guardians also felt the same way. They felt that Zhang Fei [5]’s deep red flame was extremely deadly, and they were not confident that Shang Dongzhu’s blood sphere could withstand it.
Zhang Fei [5] threw his golden flame towards Shang Dongzhu, and he threw the deep red flame after him.
Shang Dongzhu, who felt a horrible feeling from Zhang Fei [5]’s deep red flame, immediately ran away to avoid it. However, the two flames immediately changed trajectory and chased after him.
Seeing this, Shang Dongzhu flew towards Zhang Fei [5], intending to use his own flames to attack him.

Zhang Fei [5]’s body suddenly blurred, and Shang Dongzhu penetrated his afterimage once again. His two flames continued to chase the male asura demon, forcing him to attack them with his blood technique.
Shang Dongzhu was shocked because his technique instantly disappeared as soon as it came into contact with Zhang Fei [5]’s two flames, especially his deep red flame.

Zhang Fei [5]’s golden flame was the golden crow flame that would burn anything in its path. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5]’s deep red flame, known as the eternal flame, was obtained from Huo Ling, rendering Shang Dongzhu’s blood technique ineffective against it.
"Shit!" Shang Dongzhu continued to fly away as he attacked Zhang Fei [5]’s two flames, but all of his attacks disappeared as soon as they touched them.
Shang Dongzhu’s eyes widened as Zhang Fei [5] appeared in the distance with a giant deep red lotus in his hand, which he immediately threw at him.

Shang Dongzhu gritted his teeth as he did not want to lose to Zhang Fei [5]. His appearance changed drastically after he used the bloodline awakening technique, and his aura became much stronger than before.
Shang Dongzhu stopped flying, and a blood sword appeared in his right hand, which he immediately slashed twice at Zhang Fei [5]’s two flames.

Shang Dongzhu’s attacks succeeded in splitting Zhang Fei [5]’s golden flames, but he failed to destroy his deep red flame, which shocked him. He had already used his bloodline awakening technique, but his attacks were not enough to destroy it, and it continued to clash with his blood sword.

"Tch! I don’t believe I can’t destroy this flame!" Shang Dongzhu exerted more of his strength. Another blood sword appeared in his left hand, and he slashed it towards the deep red flame as well. However, the flame suddenly strengthened as soon as Zhang Fei [5] used the soul link, and his giant deep red lotus continued to spin as it approached the male asura demon. "Shit!"
"Enough!" Shang Dongzhu and Zhang Fei [5] frowned as Shang Zhui appeared among them. "Retract your abilities, or you’ll destroy this place."
Zhang Fei [5] was the first to do it by dispelling his deep red flame and giant deep red lotus.
On the other hand, Shang Dongzhu couldn’t accept it, and he shot at Zhang Fei [5] with the intention of killing him.

Seeing this, Shang Zhui immediately blocked Shang Dongzhu’s path to stop him, but Zhang Fei [5] moved faster than him. His right hand was enveloped in deep red flames, and he immediately launched a deadly blow towards the male asura demon guardian’s back.
"Argh!" Shang Dongzhu screamed in pain as he glided toward the ground before hitting it hard, causing a loud explosion.
*Boom*
The entire area shook violently, and dust scattered around them, obscuring their vision. However, Zhang Fei [5] did not stop there and attacked Shang Dongzhu, who tried to get up.
Shang Zhui tried to stop Zhang Fei [5] because Shang Dongzhu was important to their asura demon race, but he disappeared just as he was about to grab his hand.
"Shit!" Shang Dongzhu crossed his arms to stop Zhang Fei [5]’s swift attacks, but his bones cracked as his hard blow struck both of his arms, forcing him to kneel on the ground. "Argh!"
Zhang Fei [5] swung his right leg towards Shang Dongzhu’s chin, kicking him away.
"Gah!" Shang Dongzhu slid toward the west wall, but Zhang Fei [5] still didn’t stop.

Zhang Fei [5] used his maximum speed and attacked Shang Dongzhu in a series of brutal attacks. The male asura demon guardian was completely helpless before his speed, and all of his attacks hit him squarely on the body, causing blood to flow profusely from several parts of his body.
Zhang Fei [5]’s killing intent soared, and he delivered a final blow to Shang Dongzhu, sending the male Asura demon guardian crashing heavily to the ground.
"Gahh!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1654: Defeat Shang Dongzhu
paragraphs: "This is absolutely impossible." Shang Luohu, Shang Zhui, and the other three asura guardians muttered after they saw Shang Dongzhu’s condition. He had already used his bloodline awakening technique, but Zhang Fei [5] was still able to defeat him and beat him to such an extent.

Zhang Fei [5] slowly descended before Shang Dongzhu, but the silhouette covered in scarlet flames that appeared behind him made everyone hold their breath. The silhouette was the phantom of an Ancient War God, brimming with qi and killing intent.
Shang Zhui narrowed his eyes as he saw the silhouette. As an asura demon, he immediately noticed that it was not an ordinary silhouette. ’A war god? How could he do it?’
Shang Luohu turned to her daughter, but Shang Xueli shook her head at him because Zhang Fei [5] had never summoned that silhouette during the time she lived with him in the training space.

Unlike them, Qi Qingxiu’s lips curled up, forming a proud smile. She knew that the war god silhouette came from the War God’s Berserk Method that Zhang Fei [5] obtained from Puyang Shangren before the auction in the Forbidden Land a few years ago. The technique itself has five sub-techniques, and the silhouette appeared because he used the fifth sub-technique, the War God’s Descent. ’Hehe! I knew it! I knew from the start that he could beat that stupid demon!’

Zhang Fei [5] himself had long mastered the War God’s Berserk Method, but he had never used it in any of his past battles. However, he was forced to use the War God’s Berserk Method in his fight with Shang Dongzhu because he could not defeat the male asura demon guardian while using his bloodline awakening technique.

Shang Dongzhu, who was lying on the ground helplessly, looked at Zhang Fei [5] with hatred. He had already used the bloodline awakening technique, but he was still unable to deal with the young demon cultivator in front of him. The attack inflicted serious injuries on his entire body, particularly shattering the bones in both his arms. ’Fuck! Damn it! What kind of technique did he use?’

Zhang Fei [5] cancelled his technique, landed beside Shang Dongzhu, and stomped his leg into his chest. "You are not worthy! We were just sparring, but you were so eager to kill me that you used your bloodline awakening technique. Unfortunately, you knew nothing about me, and you underestimated me too much."
*Swoosh*

A strong wind swept across the area as Zhang Fei [5] unleashed his aura, causing everyone to freeze in place, including Shang Luohu. ’Unbelievable! His cultivation became on par with us, but we could feel that he was stronger than us!’

Shang Luohu and the others didn’t know that Zhang Fei [5] was using the soul link to borrow the power of the beasts inside the beast space. There were seven evil beasts that were as powerful as them inside, and there was also the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu that was far stronger than all the beasts in the Paradise Realm.

"Just like you, I have some secret technique, but mine is stronger than your bloodline awakening technique." Zhang Fei [5] used his soul manipulation ability to pull Shang Dongzhu out of his body. He replicated it, merged the replica with his own soul, and returned his soul to his body. "From now on, you are under my control, and I can kill you at any time, so you have to think carefully before you attack me."

Zhang Fei [5] looked at the other three asura guardians, but they didn’t dare to look him in the eye. He hadn’t used his technique before, but he had managed to defeat them. If he had used his technique in their previous fight, they might have suffered the same fate as Shang Dongzhu.
[Quest: Defeat Four Asura Guardians.]
[Quest rank: Hard.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Hard gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
"Can you tell me about your technique?" Shang Zhui asked.
Zhang Fei [5] smiled. "The name of my technique is War God’s Berserk Method, but I won’t explain the details to you because it’s my secret technique."

"I see." Shang Zhui nodded in understanding. "Although I don’t know the details of your technique, I know it’s not just any technique; otherwise, you wouldn’t be able to manifest your killing intent into that war god silhouette."

"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "Unfortunately, this technique is not enough if I want to defeat you, let alone defeat Shang Zhanluo, right, Senior Zhui? Among the asura demon race members, you are the second strongest after the asura demon god; even your empress can’t match your strength."
Shang Luohu’s lips twitched, but she knew that Zhang Fei [5] was telling the truth, and she was indeed no match for Shang Zhui.

Shang Zui neither denied nor admitted it. "For me, my demon race is the most important thing, and it’s far more important than my personal ambitions. Even if I had that much power, I would only use it when my demon race faced major danger."

"I’m the same as you; I will only use my power to protect myself and those closest to me." Zhang Fei [5]’s eyes swept across the other three asura guardians. "As long as people don’t mess with me, I won’t hurt or kill them; otherwise, if those people threaten our lives and peace, I will become their worst nightmare. Even if a god messes with us, I won’t hesitate to kill him."
"So, does that mean you really intend to fight with my demon god?"
Zhang Fei [5] smiled. "Shang Zhanluo won’t just submit to me, right? That’s why I will fight him after he recovers, and I will defeat him to subdue him."
"Zhang Fei." He looked at Shang Luohu. "Do you want to kill my husband?"

"When did I say I was going to kill your husband?" Zhang Fei [5] returned the question with a shake of his head. chapters.title: Chapter 1655: Envy Soul
paragraphs: After speaking with Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui, Zhang Fei brought Qi Qingxiu back to her domain, as they still had to wait a week before attacking the Torture Demon Race Domain.
Shang Luohu ordered Shang Zhui to take Shang Dongzhu away and treat his wounds.

The other three Asura Demon Guardians also left the area in shock. They still couldn’t believe that Zhang Fei [5] had managed to defeat their friend using the bloodline awakening technique, but they were more curious about his War God’s Berserk Method, which they believed had a similar effect to their technique.
"Do you like Zhang Fei, Xueli?"

Shang Xueli sighed and nodded to her mother. "At first, I don’t have feelings like that for him, and I only have gratitude to him because he freed me. However, my feelings slowly changed after I lived for years with him and his wives, and I unknowingly fell in love with him. Unfortunately, he had no feelings for me, and he only considered me to be his prisoner."
"I’m not sure if he doesn’t like you."
"What do you mean by that, Mother?"
Shang Luohu led her daughter away. "I can see from the look in his eyes that he has an interest in you, but he might have other reasons for not approaching you."
"My father," Shang Xueli immediately guessed.

"That’s right." Shang Luohu nodded. "As he said before, he wants to fight your father when he recovers. Your father is a battle freak, and he won’t be able to accept it if he loses to a young man like him. If their fight becomes too fierce, they might fight to the death."
"Does that mean he’s confident in defeating my father?"

"I don’t know." Shang Luohu looked at her. "His cultivation hadn’t broken through to the Celestial Emperor Realm for long, but he managed to defeat Shang Dongzhu with his cultivation at the Celestial Venerable Realm and used the bloodline awakening technique. He might not be able to defeat your father if they fight now, but he might manage to do so in a few years, especially with all the advantages in his grasp. Besides, he is no less brutal and ruthless than your father, and he might kill him if their fight becomes too intense."
"Does he not want to accept me because he is afraid that he will kill my father?"
"Probably." Then, Shang Luohu asked her daughter, "How would you feel if your father died by his hands in their future battle?"
Shang Xueli replied with a light shake of her head. "I like him, but I don’t want him to kill my father. I don’t know what will happen if they fight in the future, so I can’t say anything now."

"Let’s talk about this after your father recovers." Shang Luohu embraced her daughter tightly. "Since we only have time together for the next week, I’ll put aside all my activities to accompany you, and Zhui will take care of everything for me."

Shang Dongzhu was lying on a bed, with several demons standing around him to help him recover, especially his arms. He looked at Shang Zhui, who was observing him silently. "Are you going to let that bastard mess with our demon race?"

"Isn’t that your own fault?" Shang Dongzhu trembled when Shang Zhui asked that. "Before fighting you, he fought with three others, but he didn’t take any excessive action against them. On the contrary, you threatened him with your killing intent from the start, and you tried to kill him when I stopped you two, so today’s incident is your own fault."
"But-"

"I know you’re thinking about rebelling, but I’ll close my eyes for now because you haven’t done it yet." Shang Dongzhu’s pupils contracted, not expecting that Shang Zhui already knew his plans. "Besides, there is a serious danger threatening this universe, and our race needs all powerful demons to protect our domain. If we’re careless, our domain will be destroyed, and all our demon race members will die. For now, I want to focus on your recovery, and I want you to put aside your crazy desires; otherwise, I will kill you with my own hands."

Shang Dongzhu took a deep breath after Shang Zhui disappeared. However, he still couldn’t accept his loss to Zhang Fei [5], and he thought of taking revenge on him even if he had to die. Unfortunately, he no longer had the chance to do that, especially after he replicated his soul and merged it with his.

"Haha," Qi Qingxiu laughed out loud. "Shang Dongzhu is such an idiot! He wouldn’t have suffered such a fate if only he could accept his defeat with an open heart, and he’s no different from your slave now."

Qi Qingxiu naturally remembered when Zhang Fei [5] replicated her soul and merged it with his, and she was bound to him from then on. Although she was annoyed and angry with him at first, their relationship changed afterward, and she enjoyed herself as his woman.
"If I didn’t need him, I would have killed him earlier."
"I don’t doubt that because you’re truly ruthless." Qi Qingxiu looked at him. "What are your plans now?"

"Nothing," Zhang Fei [5] sighed. "I will return to the training space with my three other clones, and we will cultivate inside until next week. After Sha Mo leaves Ku Shenzu’s domain, I will pick everyone up, and we will face him then."
Qi Qingxiu sighed. "Alright, you should leave now, and I will monitor my entire domain."
After Zhang Fei [5] entered the training space, Qi Qingxiu immediately left her palace, checking every corner of her domain.
Inside the void, Zhang Fei and Feng Yao lay side by side, naked. As usual, the female phoenix had erected a barrier, preventing Long Xukong from peeking or eavesdropping on them.
Since they first got intimate a few days ago, Zhang Fei has always been eager to ravish Feng Yao’s naked body. She didn’t reject him, and she enjoyed all the time they spent together.

For the past few days, Zhang Fei had brought Luo Yunxiao and the others out of the training space, but they preferred not to disturb the two of them. They knew that their husband had long desired to get Feng Yao, and they preferred to train to prepare themselves for future bad situations.
As before, their activities caused problems for all the inhabitants of the universe, but they couldn’t care less about them.
Zhang Fei had already informed Feng Yao about Wu Han and the others. "When will we arrive at the next domain?"
"We’re pretty close, and we’ll be there in four days." Feng Yao looked at him. "Do you really want to go to the Puyang Clan?"

Zhang Fei nodded as he kneaded her breasts. "I have to find those ingredients, and I’ll concoct the two pills once I have them all. The Celestial Soul Ascension Pill will be very useful for me, and I hope my soul level can reach the immortal soul level. By the way, your mother was overjoyed after I told her about our relationship, and she hopes you will give birth to many grandchildren for her."

Feng Yao let out a helpless sigh upon hearing that, but she didn’t know if she could live up to her mother’s expectations. She worried about her fate after Zhang Fei freed her from the chains that bound her to the universe. In the past, she wasn’t worried about it, and she didn’t have a problem if she disappeared forever, but her feelings changed after her relationship with him became deeper.

Zhang Fei felt the unease in Feng Yao’s heart. He pinned her under him and looked into her eyes. "Don’t think too much about it, okay? You’re my woman, so I’ll never let you disappear. You’ll always be by my side for the rest of our lives, and you’ll give birth to many lovely children in the future."
"Yeah," Feng Yao wrapped her arms to his neck, pulled his head closer, and kissed him. Their action quickly heated up, and they had anal sex again like days before.
Four days later.
When Feng Yao informed him that they had arrived at their destination, Long Xukong immediately stopped flying, but he didn’t immediately open the void.
Feng Yao checked the domain, particularly regarding the presence of those shadowy creatures there. She found those creatures, but their numbers weren’t as numerous as in the Cangxuan Domain.
Feng Yao confirmed the location of Hu Tianlang’s envy soul, so they didn’t need to fight with those shadowy creatures; otherwise, the main creature would chase after them again.
After she found the location of Hu Tianlang’s envy soul, Feng Yao informed Zhang Fei and asked Long Xukong to open the void.

As soon as they came out of the void, Zhang Fei hugged Feng Yao’s waist as he used his invisibility ability, and he brought her to the location of Hu Tianlang’s envy soul. However, that place was quite full of those shadowy creatures who had long been trying to destroy the barrier.
Fortunately, those shadowy creatures couldn’t detect Zhang Fei’s invisibility ability, and Feng Yao brought him into the barrier to meet Hu Tianlang’s envy soul.
"Haha," Hu Tianlang laughed as they appeared before him. "Luckily, you guys got here quickly, or they would have gotten this soul first."

"Let’s start now, old fox." After Hu Tianlang entered his body, Zhang Fei hurriedly took Feng Yao out of the area and returned into the void. He was worried that the core creature would arrive there, and another domain would be destroyed because of them. "Senior Xukong, we’re going to the Puyang Clan now."
"Show me the way."

"I guessed wrong because Ku Shan and Ku Yin have already returned to this domain."
"Master, I will face Ku Cang," Jiu Moze said.
Ye Futian drew his sword.
"Jiu Mozu and I will face Ku Yanji and Ku Xian."
Jiu Mozu raised an eyebrow for a moment, but he didn’t protest.
"Should we kill them?"
"Stupid!" Qi Qingxiu shouted at him.
"We still need those grand elders, so we can’t kill them.
You two just need to paralyze them, and my husband will do something about them."
"Oh." Jiu Mozu didn’t dare to refute Qi Qingxiu like in the past because he was Zhang Fei’s salve, and the female demon god was his wife, which meant she was also his master.
"The two of us will face Ku Yin and Ku Shan." Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe spoke in unison.
Qi Qingxiu sighed.
"I will face Ku Shenzu’s wife, Ku Biyun.
But are you sure you want to fight with that idiot demon god, husband?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] nodded to her.
"You don’t need to worry about me because things have changed in the past few days, and I’ve gained a protector far stronger than anyone else."
"Who?"
Huo Ling came straight out of Zhang Fei [5]’s body and sat on his shoulders.
Her gaze made everyone tremble, including those demon gods.
"She-"

"Ling’er is my new wife, and she will protect me." All the demon gods exchanged looks of shock because they already knew that Huo Ling was the Eternal Flame, but they didn’t know that she was actually the Primordial Flame, including Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran.
"She will only make a move if I’m in trouble during my fight with Ku Shenzu.
Since everyone is ready, I will lure that demon god and his subordinates to meet us now."
"Let me do it, husband." Huo Ling stretched her slender hand forward and snapped her finger.
In that instant, a powerful and deadly aura enveloped the entire area of the Torture Demon Race Domain.
The temperature became extremely hot, and the ground throughout the domain shook violently.
Wu Mian and the other demons were speechless at this, and they looked at Huo Ling in horror. ’Doesn’t this situation mean he’s become too powerful with her by his side?’
"They will arrive soon, husband." Unlike in the past, Huo Ling had become much gentler towards Zhang Fei, especially after she had sex with him for several days in his soul world.
"Thank you, Ling’er." Zhang Fei [5] looked at the others.
"Get ready!
We will proceed according to our previous plan."
Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu immediately summoned their subordinates, borrowing their power.
Ye Futian also prepared himself to face the incoming enemy.
Meanwhile, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe still looked relaxed because their opponents were clearly no match for them.
Wu Mian looked at Zhang Fei [5].
"Since she will help you fight Ku Shenzu, I will take care of other matters in his palace."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] activated the soul link, borrowing the power of the beasts.
Wu Mian immediately disappeared and went to Ku Shenzu’s palace.
Qi Qingxiu immediately followed him after she sensed that Ku Biyun hadn’t joined the others, and she decided to stay in the palace.
After they waited for some time, Ku Shenzu, Ku Yu, and the five grand elders arrived in front of Zhang Fei [5] and the others.
Ku Yu, Ku Shan, and Ku Yin immediately recognized Zhang Fei [5].
However, they said nothing and watched the demon gods before them, giving them a bad feeling.
Ku Shenzu himself was shocked by the presence of Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, Jiu Moze, and Jiu Mozu.
He raised an eyebrow slightly when his son told him about Zhang Fei [5], but he didn’t pay him any mind because his strength was still below those demon gods like him.
He smirked when he saw Huo Ling, licking his lips.
"Humph!" Huo Ling snorted with a look of disdain. ’If it wasn’t for my husband wanting to test your strength, I would have directly burned you to ashes!’
Ku Shenzu shivered and felt a chill down his spine because of Huo Ling’s gaze.
Even so, he immediately suppressed his fear of her and asked the others.
"What is the purpose of all of you coming to my domain and causing trouble here?"
"Argh!" Ku Shenzu and the others were shocked to hear Ku Yu’s scream, but the prince had already disappeared before they could react, and they couldn’t sense his aura.
"Move!"
Nalan Shizhe and the others immediately moved, bringing the five grand elders of the Torture Demon Race away to other areas.
Ku Shenzu frowned at Zhang Fei [5], who remained calm in his presence.
He didn’t expect those demon gods to follow the orders of the lust demon before him.
"Who exactly are you?"
"My identity is not important." Ku Shenzu subconsciously took a step back when Zhang Fei [5] summoned the Demon Extermination Sword.
"You have caused a lot of trouble in other domains, and today will be the day of your downfall."
"Hahaha!" Ku Shenzu laughed loudly, and his gaze turned sharp.
"I admit that I felt some fear from the woman on your shoulder, but I’m not the least bit afraid of facing a weak lust demon like you."
"Is that so?"
"Come—Argh!" Ku Shenzu screamed in pain and blood spurted from his chest.
He rushed to stop the bleeding and stared at Zhang Fei [5] in shock because he didn’t see him swing his sword, but he felt a powerful slash on his chest.
"How—"
"Less talking and fight me," Zhang Fei [5] said, pointing his sword at the demon god.
"Use your abilities now; otherwise, you will die without a fight."
"Bastard!" Ku Shenzu’s aura exploded and the area instantly transformed, filling with various torture tools.
"I will torture you before I kill you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1663: Defeat Ku Shenzu
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] looked at the area around them, especially those torture tools.
"It’s a domain," Huo Ling coldly spoke, looking at Ku Shenzu. "His domain is too weak compared to yours, so you should be able to destroy it easily, husband."

"Hahaha," Ku Shenzu laughed and pointed at Zhang Fei [5]. "Him? Destroy my domain? I believe you can destroy my domain, but that weak lust demon won’t have the ability to, not with his borrowed strength."
"Heh! Frog in the well!" Huo Ling snorted in disdain.
"Come one! Prove it! Destroy my domain!" Ku Shenzu taunted.
"No wonder you are one of the weakest demon gods." Ku Shenzu frowned at Zhang Fei [5]. "Just one domain, and weak at that, but you are too proud. Let me show you the real domains."
Ku Shenzu trembled as he sensed a powerful qi fluctuation from within Zhang Fei [5]’s body. Despite his borrowed strength, the demon god could feel that it was much stronger than his.

Ku Shenzu’s eyes widened as he clenched his teeth, especially after several layers of domains appeared, covering his torture domain. The next second, nine elements appeared, followed by thousands of swords and eight heavenly flames.
"Hah." Zhang Fei [5] exhaled as his gaze turned sharp. Those thousands of swords immediately moved and destroyed all of Ku Shenzu’s torture tools, followed by the eight heavenly flames attacking him.

"Shit!" Ku Shenzu activated his defenses to block the eight heavenly flames, but he underestimated the power of the Primordial Flame, and his defenses instantly crumbled after the flame hit them. The eight heavenly flames directly slammed into him, sending him flying backwards with blood flowing from all over his body. "Gah!"
At first, Zhang Fei [5] only had a fragment of the Primordial Flame, but it changed after Huo Ling acknowledged him as her master, and he was able to use the true power of the flame because of it.

"Cough... Cough..." Ku Shenzu coughed and vomited blood. He looked at Zhang Fei [5] in disbelief because he could destroy his torture domain with his current cultivation, and his attack just now was clearly as powerful as a demon god-class attack. "Bastard!"
Several black chains shot toward Zhang Fei [5]; he coldly waved his hand. His eight heavenly flames shot out rapidly, clashing with those chains.

"Fuck!" Ku Shenzu cursed as those black chains turned to ashes. He summoned several iron blocks for protection, but Zhang Fei [5]’s eight heavenly flames destroyed them before they hit his body. "Argh!"
"Weak but talking big." Huo Ling muttered in a cold tone.
Ku Shenzu flew away from Zhang Fei [5] and Huo Ling, taking out an artifact to protect himself. ’Fuck! If this artifact is unable to withstand his attack, I will die!’

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] looked at it, rubbing his chin. "I thought he was stronger than Ye Mingran or my mother-in-law, but his strength turned out to be only so-so, and he could only rely on his torture tools and artifacts. Even Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu are stronger than him, even if they have to borrow the power of the demons by their side."
"Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe are much stronger than this coward." Huo Ling tilted her head to the side. "We don’t need to waste time with this coward and let me clean him up, okay?"

"Are you impatient to dual-cultivate with me again, Ling’er?" Huo Ling’s face turned red, but she acknowledged it with a nod. "Alright, you can finish him off now because Ye Mingran and the others will be finished with the others soon."

Ku Shenzu trembled when Huo Ling looked at him, and the artifact protecting him shattered as soon as she snapped her fingers. The next moment, six fire arrows pierced his chest and limbs, leaving six big holes. "Argh!"
Ku Shenzu quickly glided to the ground like a broken kite, and his body slammed hard onto the ground a few seconds later, causing a large explosion.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately moved in front of Ku Shenzu and stomped his chest.
"Cough... Cough..." Although Ku Shenzu was a demon god, Huo Ling’s previous attack had caused him serious injuries. "Hehehe! Hahaha! I never thought I would suffer such a fate today!"

"Being at the top for too long makes you arrogant." Ku Shenzu stared at Zhang Fei [5]. "Do you still not believe I can defeat you with my own strength? Even if Ling’er doesn’t make a move, you will definitely lose to me. Unlike you, I didn’t inherit strength from anyone, and I reached this level through my own hard work."
Ku Shenzu wanted to curse Zhang Fei [5], but he swallowed his words when his other three clones appeared, and one of them was holding Ku Yu, who looked different. "What did you do to my son?"
"Your son is no longer himself, and he is my slave now."

Ku Shenzu was shocked to hear that, but he was even more shocked when Qi Qingxiu appeared by their side carrying his wife, Ku Biyun. Even though his wife was quite strong, she was not an opponent for a demon god like her.
"Husband." Ku Biyun called out with a trembling voice, unable to believe that her husband would lose so easily.
*Swoosh*
Jiu Moze appeared, throwing the bloodied Ku Cang to the ground. "I leave him to you, Master."
*Bam*
Ku Yanji and Ku Xian slammed to the ground, followed by Jiu Mozu and Ye Futian. "It’s done, Master."

"Husband!" Ye Mingran called as she landed on the spot along with Nalan Shizhe. The two female demon gods carried the unconscious Ku Yin and Ku Shan; they threw the two grand elders to the ground. "I thought they were strong, but they are still weak."
"That’s because we’ve been training in his secret place, Mingran." Nalan Shizhe shook her head. "If we hadn’t trained there, we would have needed more time to defeat them."
*Thud*
Wu Mian landed there and handed a crystal to Zhang Fei [5], causing Ku Shenzu to be shocked. "This crystal is a treasure of the Torture Demon Race, but I don’t know its exact uses."

"Haha." Ku Shenzu and Ku Biyun looked at Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong, who had just appeared. "Looks like our presence here is unnecessary, huh? Even though your strength is not yet on par with a demon god, you can already defeat one. Even if this woman doesn’t help you, you will definitely win against him."

"You’re wrong about that, Emperor Long." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Ku Shenzu. "I might be able to defeat him, but I wouldn’t have been able to do it so easily without Huo Ling’s help. Besides, this demon god is different from Mo Shentian, Sha Mo, Shang Zhanluo, and Qian Yan, and he can only rely on his torture tools. I’m sure that I can defeat him, but I’m not sure that I can beat the other four."

"As long as this woman helps you, you can definitely defeat them, son-in-law." Ku Shenzu and Ku Biyun took a deep breath as soon as they heard Tianshi Bailong address Zhang Fei [5] as his son-in-law. Besides, Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran had previously addressed him as their husband, which was an unbelievable thing. "What are you going to do to them?"

"See for yourself." Zhang Fei [5] activated his soul domain, pulling the souls of those demons out of their bodies. He replicated their souls and merged them with his own before returning them to their bodies. Then, he used his demon slave marks on the demon god and his wife. "This way, I have complete control over them, and they won’t cause any more trouble."
As a demon god, Ku Shenzu had never felt so desperate before, but he truly felt helpless now.
"Who’s your next target?"

"Sha Mo," Zhang Fei [5] paused for a moment. "However, we don’t need to move, and Sha Yuan will help me do something to her husband. Once she succeeds, I just need to go to their domain, and I’ll take care of him myself."
Long Wuzhao nodded in understanding. "If you need our help against Mo Shentian and Qian Yan, you just need to contact us."
"I won’t take action against Mo Shentian and Qian Yan now."
"Why?"

"Even though I didn’t do anything to the two of them, they would immediately notice if those shadowy creatures invaded their domains. I don’t know their exact strength, but Feng Yao is confident that they can do something against those creatures." Zhang Fei [5] thought of something else. "As for Shang Zhanluo, I will wait for Wu Zu to complete the antidote to restore his condition first, and I will fight with him after he recovers."
"Why do you have to wait for Shang Zhanluo to recover? Wouldn’t it be better if you did something to him in his current condition?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at Tianshi Bailong. "Father-in-law, there is something I have to settle with Shang Zhanluo, and I can only settle it after I fight with him, so I will wait for him to recover and challenge him to a fight."
"Are you sure you can defeat the Asura Demon God in his prime?"
"Hey, little dragon! You’re underestimating my husband!" Huo Ling snarled.
"Haha," Tianshi Bailong laughed wryly. "Senior, I believe that my son-in-law won’t lose to Shang Zhanluo if you help him, but his words clearly indicate that he wants to fight him alone. He—"
"He will win against Shang Zhanluo even if I don’t help him."
"If you say so, I will believe it too, and I can’t wait to watch their fight."
"Send us back to our domain, Zhang Fei."
"Alright."

chapters.title: Chapter 1664: Yin Demon Race
paragraphs: After sending Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong back to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, Zhang Fei [5] asked Jiu Moze, Jiu Mozu, and Ku Yu to bring Ku Shenzu, Ku Biyun, and the five grand elders back to the palace.

Upon arrival, Zhang Fei [5] sat on the throne with Huo Ling perched on his shoulder. He gave Ku Shenzu, Ku Biyun, and the five grand elders some healing pills and restoration pills to restore their condition. Since they were demons, he couldn’t use his light element to heal them, but his pills were enough for that.
Ku Shenzu was furious in his heart because he was a demon god, but Zhang Fei [5] treated him like a slave, and he also sat on his throne as if it were his own.

Ku Biyun hugged her husband’s arm tightly, afraid that Zhang Fei [5] and the others would do something bad to her. She looked at Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu, who were standing beside him, wondering about how he convinced them to become his wives, especially with his low cultivation and low demon rank.

The five grand elders had also woken up, though they were still too weak due to the demon gods’ merciless beatings. Ku Yin and Ku Shan were completely shocked that Zhang Fei [5] had managed to defeat Ku Shenzu, but they had already realized that he was indeed extraordinary since they were still in the tower.

Zhang Fei [5] wasn’t concerned about their gazes, and he was more curious about the crystal that Wu Mian gave him earlier. He had already asked Ku Shenzu about it, but the demon god didn’t know the origin of the crystal, and he inherited it from the previous demon god.
"You don’t need to be confused about this crystal, husband." Huo Ling took the crystal from Zhang Fei [5]’s hand. "This is the Yin Demon Core, originating from the Yin Demon Race."
"The Yin Demon Race?"

"As the name suggests, all members of the Yin Demon Race are women, but they do not exist in this Paradise Realm, and they only exist in the Ancient Realm." Huo Ling created a qi screen, which displays the demon race. "They are the Yin Demon Race."

The Yin Demon Race’s presence was shrouded in a suffocating aura of cold yin energy. Their appearance was both terrifying and enchanting. Skin as pale as bleached jade stretched over perfect features, delicate yet devoid of warmth, like corpses preserved in ice. Their eyes were deep and unsettling—dark as a bottomless abyss. A single glance from them felt like falling into an endless night.

Their beauty was unearthly—perfect, yet hollow. Some possessed an almost seductive allure. Their expressions were distant, cold, and filled with a quiet cruelty. Their hair was silver like moonlight, swayed by the currents of yin energy that encircle their bodies.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow. "Even though they look calm, I can feel horror just by looking at their form."
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, and the other demons also felt the same way as Zhang Fei [5] when they looked at the Yin Demon Race.

"Hehe," Huo Ling laughed softly. "Since they are Yin Demons, their primary targets are men of all races, and they will absorb their Yang Qi as their source of strength. Although their primary targets are men, they will also attack any women who make them jealous. They will swarm to attack you if you enter their domain because your Yang Qi is far more powerful than any man’s."
"Where do they live, Ling’er?"

"You can find them in all domains with high Yin concentrations, but they mostly reside in the Frozen Yin Domain." Huo Ling changed the image on the qi screen. "There! That is the Frozen Yin Domain, and the number of the Yin Demon Race there is really large. Apart from them, there are many other demon races living in that domain, and some of them are much stronger than these demon gods."
Zhang Fei [5] narrowed his eyes, feeling interested in going to that domain. "In your opinion, what will happen if I absorb the Yin Demons?"
"Are you really thinking about absorbing them, husband?" Hui Ling looked at him.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "Since they are Yin Demons, their Yin Qi should be abundant, right? If I sacrifice them, I’m sure my cultivation will increase much faster, and I might be able to reach the Celestial Venerable Realm much earlier than I initially thought."
"How strong are they compared to us, Senior Ling?"
Huo Ling looked at Qi Qingxiu. "What, Senior? Call me Big Sister Ling! Although I don’t want to admit it, we’re both his wives."
"Hehe," Qi Qingxiu giggled. "Alright, I’ll call you Big Sis Ling from now on."
"So, how strong are the yin demons, Big Sis Ling?" Ye Mingran asked.
Zhang Fei [5] smiled when he saw Huo Ling’s smug smile. "One Yin Demon has a hundred times more Yin Qi than the two of you."
"Huh?" Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, and Nalan Shizhe were shocked to hear that. "The amount of their Yin Qi is really that much?"

Huo Ling nodded. "No one can approach them because their abilities are too terrifying, and they can detect their enemies’ presence from miles away, especially men. However, it’s not a big deal for our husband because I can protect him from them, but he will probably need days or months to absorb one Yin Demon."
"Days or months just to absorb one Yin Demon." Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, and Nalan Shizhe muttered in a daze because that meant the amount of Yin Qi in one Yin Demon was truly abundant.
Huo Ling returned the crystal to Zhang Fei [5]. "Try absorbing the remaining Yin Qi inside this crystal core, husband."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] jolted as the Yin Qi within the crystal entered his body. "This! This Yin Qi is simply too abundant!"

paragraphs: "Who’s there? How dare you infiltrate the Puyang Clan?" Didn’t your master send you to the Paradise Realm? Why are you back here? Who are these four people?"
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu pointed at Zhang Fei. "My master sent me to the Paradise Realm to protect him, but he went to this realm without my knowledge."
"Hmm?" The old man furrowed his brows, scrutinizing Zhang Fei’s face. "How—"

"I didn’t expect you to still be alive, Little Zong." The old man named Puyang Zong shuddered as he shifted his gaze towards Feng Yao. "The last time I saw you, you were still in your early twenties, and you always followed behind your big sister, Puyang Yeyu."
"Who... who are you, Young Miss?" Puyang Zong stuttered, unable to recognize Feng Yao’s face. However, his gaze immediately shifted to Huo Ling, who was standing beside her. "Senior Guang Zhiyi!?"
"Humph!" Huo Ling snorted and entered Feng Yao’s body.

Puyang Zong was puzzled by Huo Ling’s behavior, but his eyes widened before falling to his bottom. He looked at Feng Yao, who had transformed her face into Guang Zhiyi’s. "You... you... Senior Guang!"
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu smiled in amusement after seeing Puyang Zong’s expression, but he immediately flew away to another area to look for his master, Puyang Shangren.
"Hehehe," Feng Yao chuckled and reverted back to her original form. "Do you recognize me now, Little Zong?"

Puyang Zong took a deep breath and stood up. He dusted off his clothes, cupped his hands to Feng Yao, and paid respect to her. "Welcome back, Senior Guang. I always thought I wouldn’t be able to see you again in this lifetime, but you’re standing before me now."

"Alright, you don’t have to be so formal with me, Little Zong." Then, Feng Yao searched for someone’s whereabouts in other areas of the Puyang Clan. "Where is Little Yeyu? Why can’t I sense her presence in this clan?"
Puyang Zong let out a sad sigh. "Senior Guang, my elder sister’s condition isn’t good, so we asked her to rest in the secret ground."
"Oh?" Feng Yao raised an eyebrow. "What happened to Little Yeyu?"

Puyang Zong immediately explained the situation. "My sister was outside when those strange creatures suddenly appeared; they attacked her and caused her to suffer quite severe internal injuries. Although her injuries are not life-threatening, she will need a long time to recover."
"I see." Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei, who nodded in understanding. "Lead us to the secret ground now."

"Alright." Puyang Zong immediately led them, but he was curious about the identities of Zhang Fei and Long Xukong. "Who are these two people, Senior Guang? Why did Old Shangren send Leiyu to the Paradise Realm specifically to protect this young man?"

"Didn’t Puyang Shangren explain the reason to you?" Puyang Zong shook his head at Feng Yao. "If that’s the case, I won’t explain the reason to you either. However, I can tell you that he is my husband, Zhang Fei."

Puyang Zong almost fell forward after Feng Yao said that, but he nimbly stabilized himself. He looked at Zhang Fei with wide eyes, wondering about her reasons for choosing him as her husband. "Are you kidding me, Senior Guang? Why—"
Puyang Zong did not continue his words as he was stunned by Feng Yao’s action of cupping Zhang Fei’s face and kissing his lips.
They only kissed briefly, and Feng Yao smiled playfully at Puyang Zong. "Do you believe me now? Zhang Fei is my husband, and you should be able to sense his Yang Qi within my body."
Puyang Zong immediately examined Feng Yao’s body to find out the truth. He took a deep breath after discovering Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi was so thick within her body.
Puyang Zong cupped his hands to them. "Congratulations on your wedding, Senior Guang and Junior Fei."
"No need to be so formal with us, Senior." Zhang Fei smiled casually. "For now, please lead us to Senior Yeyu’s place, and I might be able to do something to heal her."

Puyang Zong was skeptical upon hearing this because Zhang Fei’s cultivation was too low to treat Puyang Yeyu, but he didn’t dare say anything because he was Feng Yao’s husband. He nodded and led them away again. "Then, who is the other man?"
"Senior, my name is Long Xukong from the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain." Long Xukong respectfully introduced himself to Puyang Zong.
"Oh?" Puyang Zong was a little surprised. "Does that mean you are a dragon?"
"A void dragon, to be precise."
Puyang Zong nodded to Feng Yao. "No wonder the three of you were able to get through our barrier. It turns out you brought a void dragon with you, Senior Guang."

"We have no other choice, right?" Feng Yao looked outside the barrier. "I’ve long wanted to return to this realm, but I still have some unfinished business in the Paradise Realm. However, my husband needs some alchemy ingredients to concoct his new pills, and they only exist in this realm. Since those creatures appeared in this realm, I brought Long Xukong with us to avoid them."
"Do you know the origins of those creatures, Senior Guang? What are they seeking in this realm?"
Feng Yao shook her head slightly. "I don’t know about their origins or what they seek in this realm."
Along the way, Puyang Zong asked Feng Yao a few other things, but he didn’t inquire further about her relationship with Zhang Fei.
When they arrived at the portal to the secret ground, Puyang Shangren, Ancient Leiyu Tianlu, and several others were already waiting for them.
Puyang Shangren was the first to speak. "Tianlu just told me your identity, and I really didn’t expect you to be Senior Guang Zhiyi."

The rest of the people also spoke to Feng Yao as they paid their respects. However, they were shocked when they sensed the strong yang qi of a man within her body, and they glanced at Zhang Fei without saying anything.
"Haha," Feng Yao softly laughed. "Guang Zhiyi and Huo Yanling are my past, and I am now Feng Yao, so you don’t need to discuss my two past identities anymore."
"Why did you bring him here, Senior Feng?" Puyang Shangren asked, glancing at Zhang Fei.

"I brought him to this realm to look for some things, and he’s the only one who can take two of them. We’ve already obtained two of them, and we came here to look for some rare herbs." Feng Yao handed two papers to an old woman. "Could you collect them for me, Puyang Meihua? I don’t need a large amount, and I only need one fresh one complete with its root for each herb."

"Yes," Puyang Meihua took the two papers and read them. "Do you want to plant them somewhere else, Senior Feng? We have all these herbs, but most of them are still young and not ready to be used for alchemy."
Feng Yao nodded at her. "My husband will plant them in his private place."
"Hmm?" Puyang Meihua looked at Zhang Fei, and she could smell the scent of herbs from his body. "Can you tell me your alchemy rank, Young Man?"

Zhang Fei took out his alchemy badge and showed it to them, causing everyone to hold their breaths. They could see that he was still young—not even a hundred years old, but he had already become an alchemy god.
"Puyang Kongque will be happy to meet this young man." An old man said quietly.
Puyang Meihua agreed with him. "Senior Feng, I’ll go see Puyang Kongque now, and I’ll ask him to prepare all these herbs."
"Alright." After Puyang Meihua left, Feng Yao asked the others. "Who among your clan members possesses body techniques from the Light, Wind, Wood, and Metal elements?"
An old woman immediately answered Feng Yao. "Senior Feng, I possess a body technique from the light element."
"Please share your technique with my husband."

"Are you satisfied with that technique, husband?"
"Satisfied!" Zhang Fei nodded at Feng Yao. "How could I not be satisfied with getting an immortal-grade technique for free?"
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "Do any of you have elemental seeds?"
"This." They seemed confused about answering Feng Yao because elemental seeds were too precious even for their Puyang Clan.
Feng Yao’s lips curled up. "If you have them, my husband is willing to pay a high price for them, so you don’t need to hesitate to sell them to him."
Puyang Shangren looked at the others before taking out a white elemental seed. "Senior Feng, our clan only has this light elemental seed."

"Too bad." Feng Yao released a regretful sigh. "My husband already possesses the light element, so this light elemental seed is useless to him. Anyway, we don’t have much time, so one of you must lead us to Puyang Yeyu now."
"I will lead the three of you to meet her." Puyang Shangren kept the light elemental seed and activated the portal to the secret ground. "Please follow me."
Soon, the four of them arrived at a place that resembled a temple, and it was very spacious—much larger than the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow when they arrived. He sensed something unusual inside.
"Can you feel it, husband?"
