chapters.title: Chapter 1674: Three God Realms
paragraphs: Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao. "The quality and quantity of Qi in this secret ground is stronger than in my private place; if I’m not mistaken, it’s about twentyfold."

"Yes," Feng Yao explained. "The Puyang Clan is located above a natural formation, a legacy of the Ancient Dao Sect. As the name suggests, the sect was once a Dao pursuer, but they were destroyed along with the Zenith Sun Sanctum and the Endless Night Dungeon."
"Oh? Does that mean the Puyang Clan is younger than those two clans?"

"You’re wrong, kid." Zhang Fei and Long Xukong looked at Puyang Shangren. "My Puyang Clan is as old as those two clans, but we were once weaker than them. When those two clans and several others were destroyed, my ancestor brought our clan to move here because he was a member of the Ancient Dao Sect. Guang Zhiyi helped our ancestors with that, so we respect her for her great contribution to our clan. Since we moved to this domain, our clan has continued to grow, and we have become one of the major powers in this Ancient Realm."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "If I cultivate here, my cultivation will definitely improve much faster.
"That’s true." Long Xukong nodded in agreement with him. "If you and all your wives cultivate here, all of you will become stronger much faster."
"You’re not wrong about that, Senior Xukong." Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "However, I won’t do that because our presence will disturb this clan’s members."

"With Senior Feng by your side, I don’t think you need to cultivate here, kid." Zhang Fei and Feng Yao simply smiled, and they followed behind Puyang Shangren, heading towards the inner area of the sacred ground. "Fortunately, we have those barriers, and those creatures cannot destroy them; otherwise, they have already invaded my clan since their appearance."
"What exactly is their goal in attacking your Puyang Clan, Senior?"
"They’re targeting this place, husband."
Zhang Fei tilted his head to the side. "Aren’t they already powerful? Why are they targeting this place?"

"I don’t know their exact reason, but I’m sure my guess is correct." Feng Yao looked around the area. "They probably intend to prevent the Puyang Clan members from becoming stronger, so they targeted this place. The core creature is truly powerful, but it’s not omnipotent. If many powerful cultivators emerge, they will become an obstacle for those creatures to take over this universe, so they want to destroy them before it’s too late."
"That makes sense." Zhang Fei nodded a few times. "Honestly, I’m still curious about one thing, and I’m sure you know the answer, Yao’er."
"What are you curious about?"
"Are there other cultivation stages after the Celestial God Realm?"

After Zhang Fei asked that, Puyang Shangren stopped walking and looked at Feng Yao. "Are there any other stages after the Five Celestial Realms, Senior Feng? Honestly, my clansmen and I have long wondered about that, especially after Ancestor Puyang Shenmi reached the Celestial God Realm. She stated that the Celestial God Realm was not the peak of the cultivation world because the Qi within her body was still far from reaching its maximum, which led her to believe that other stages existed beyond it."

"There are two other stages after the Five Celestial Realms." Puyang Shangren and Long Xukong were shocked after Feng Yao said that. "The first stage is the Three God Realms, which is divided into three minor stages: the God King Realm, the God Emperor Realm, and the Supreme God Realm. As for the last stage, only the primordials can reach that stage."
"What’s the name of that last stage?"
"The Exalt Supreme Realm is the final cultivation stage."

Puyang Shangren took a deep breath and asked, "How do you know about those two realms, Senior Feng? There are no records of those two cultivation realms in this Ancient Realm, and no cultivator in this realm has ever been able to surpass the Celestial God Realm before."

chapters.title: Chapter 1675: Yue Xuelian’s Decision
paragraphs: Yue Qingyi and several elders were confused because Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou had disappeared without a trace for a week. Upon their return, they asked all the elders to gather in the meeting hall. They also discovered something different about the two women, especially their faces and auras.

Yue Yuling froze after examining Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou’s bodies. She discovered that they were no longer virgins, and she also discovered that there was thick yang qi within their bodies. ’No way! Did the sect master and vice sect master really give themselves to a man? As far as I remember, they loved each other, and they often spent intimate time together.’
"Why did you suddenly gather us, Sect Master?" Yue Wanxian curiously asked.
Yue Qingyi, Yue Mingyi, and the other elders were also curious about that, but they were more curious about the changes in Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou.
Yue Xuelian looked at Yue Qianrou for a moment before returning her gaze to the elders. "Qianrou and I decided to step down from our positions, and—"
"What?" Yue Qingyi, Yue Mingyi, and the other elders shouted in shock at the same time. "Sect Master, why did you suddenly make this decision?"
"What exactly happened, Sect Master?"
"Does your decision have anything to do with your previous disappearance?"
"You’ve noticed, right, Yuling?"
Yue Yuling only nodded to Yue Xuelian, making all the elders look at her. "Let our sect master explain everything to you."
The elders returned their gaze to Yue Xuelian. "Currently, I am no longer fit to serve as sect master of our sect. You guys may not realize it yet, but I am no longer a virgin."
*Boom*
A small explosion occurred in the elders’ brains, and their eyes went wide as they stared at Yue Xuelian.
Yue Qianrou immediately spoke to them. "Just like my big sister, I’m no longer a virgin, so I’ve decided to step down from my position as the vice sect master of our sect."
*Boom*

This? What happened? Who was the man who took their virginity? All the elders wondered in their minds because they knew that Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were a couple of lilies, and they had never been close to any man before.
Yue Qingyi suddenly realized something. "Is that man Zhang Fei, Sect Master?"
"Yes," Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou immediately admitted. "We both disappeared for a few days before, and we spent some time together with Zhang Fei."
"This? How—"

"Do you remember when I disappeared for several years?" Yue Wanxian nodded to Yue Xuelian. "For the past few years, I spent time in Zhang Fei’s private quarters to train, and we often spent time together. Honestly, I’ve never been attracted to any man before, but I started falling for him for some reason, and I gave myself to him a week ago. As for Qianrou, she is my sister and lover, and I begged her to be his wife so we could be together forever."

The elders looked at Yue Qianrou, who shrugged. "As you already know, I have always loved my big sister, and I don’t want to be separated from her. If she were with Zhang Fei, he would monopolize her, and I wouldn’t be able to spend time with her anymore. Thus, I decided to fulfill my big sister’s request and become his wife."

All the elders sighed heavily after hearing all that, not expecting that Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou would fall into Zhang Fei’s arms. Their sect never forbade anyone to fall in love and get married, but they had to leave the sect once they decided to get married.

"Sect Master, I don’t think you and the vice sect master need to resign from your positions." All the elders looked at Yue Mingyi with a frown. "Although our sect has such a rule, the sect has begun to change since we moved into this domain, so I think we should change the old rules. Besides, none of us have the ability to lead this sect, and the sect might decline if one of us becomes the leader."

"I agree with Mingyi, Sect Master," Yue Wanxian spoke, nodding her head. "The sect has made great progress since you became our sect master, and our development has only gotten better since we moved to this domain, especially with the help Zhang Fei has given us."

Yue Qingyi spoke directly. "I also agree that you and Qianrou remain our sect master and vice sect master, and we will keep a close eye on your relationship with Zhang Fei. However, you two should not spend time with him in our sect, and you can do it in his sect; otherwise, our disciples will be aware of the situation, and they will probably not be comfortable with it."
"What do you think about that, Big Sis? Honestly, I don’t want to leave this sect because I grew up in our sect, and I don’t want our sect to experience decline if we leave."
"I feel the same way as you, Qianrou." Yue Xuelian looked at the elders. "Are you all really okay with that?"
"No problem."

Yue Xuelian nodded to them. "For now, Qianrou and I will remain the sect master and vice sect master of this sect, but I will begin preparing two of the five of you to take over our positions in the future. According to our master’s request before she died, Yue Qingyi and Yue Yuling will replace our positions if we decide to step down, so you two should start preparing yourselves from now on."

Yue Wanxian and the others had no problem with Yue Xuelian’s decision to choose Yue Qingyi and Yue Yuling, and they were actually pleased with it because they felt burdened if they became the leaders of their sect.

On the other hand, Yue Qingyi and Yue Yuling felt a headache because of Yue Xuelian’s decision. They didn’t like taking on such a big responsibility, but he chose them. "Alright, the two of us will start preparing ourselves, Sect Master."
"That’s good." Yue Xuelian nodded in satisfaction. "You guys can take care of the others now."
After they left, Yue Qianrou moved to sit on her big sister’s lap and hugged her neck, but Yue Xuelian stopped her when she wanted to kiss her. "Why?"

"Sigh." Yue Xuelian sighed and hugged her sister’s waist. "Have you forgotten our husband’s words? He has no problem with us being intimate, but he doesn’t like it when we do it behind his back. We are his wives, and we’ve agreed to that, so we shouldn’t break it."

Yue Qianrou pursed her lips. "I still can’t believe that we’re already his wife, Big Sis. In the past, I felt that relationships between men and women were utterly disgusting, but I’ve already given myself to him. Besides, I enjoyed myself when he fucked me non-stop, and my body craved his cock."

"You never filter your words, you know?" Yue Xuelian pinched her sister’s nose. "I never thought about sex with men in the past either, but I have to admit that I enjoyed having sex with our husband. Somehow, I felt myself changing after I had sex with him, and I feel like my life was no longer as cold as it was in the past."
"Have your feelings for me changed, Big Sis?"
Yue Xuelian shook her head and rubbed her sister’s cheek. "You are my sister and my first love, so my feelings for you will never change, and we will always be together for the rest of our lives."
"Yeah." Yue Qianrou laid her head on her big sister’s shoulder. "Even though we are both his wives, I will always love you forever."
"Qianrou."
"Hmm?"
"Thank you for forgiving me."

"I should be the one apologizing to you, Big Sis." Yue Qianrou hugged her tighter. "We’ve been together since we were little, and you’ve always treated me with such care, even when I was sick. You even starved yourself for me many times, but I hate you for what happened back then. I should have known how you felt about me, and I should have known that you never intended to leave me in that damned place."

Yue Xuelian breathed a sigh of relief, rubbing her sister’s back. "Let’s forget all that and move forward together in our new life, okay? Sister Yao already said that there’s a solution to reverse the curse, and our husband has promised you that he’ll do whatever it takes to get you back to normal."

"Now that I think about it, I no longer care whether I’m human or a corpse demon." Yue Qianrou raised her head and looked at her big sister. "After all, our husband is a lust demon, so it shouldn’t matter if I remain a corpse demon, right?"
"Yes." Yue Xuelian suddenly remembered someone. "Actually, there is a corpse demon woman by our husband’s side."
"Oh? Who is that woman, Big Sis?" Yue Qianrou was surprised by that because she still didn’t know much about Zhang Fei.

Yue Xuelian created a qi screen. "Her name is Wang Yin, and our husband met her in the middle realm. Unlike you, she is the true corpse demon because she no longer has her soul, and her fate is worse than yours."

"You mean?" Yue Xuelian told Yue Qianrou about Wang Yin, Yuan Xiajie, and some other things. "Tch! That woman is truly outrageous! I hope our husband will capture her one day, and I hope he will torture her at that time. Where is Wang Yin now? Since she is a corpse demon like me, I want to meet her."
"She is in the Tower of Eternity now, so you have to wait for her to come back to meet her."

He has no problem with us being intimate, but he doesn’t like it when we do it behind his back.
We are his wives, and we’ve agreed to that, so we shouldn’t break it."
Yue Qianrou pursed her lips.
"I still can’t believe that we’re already his wife, Big Sis.
In the past, I felt that relationships between men and women were utterly disgusting, but I’ve already given myself to him.
Besides, I enjoyed myself when he fucked me non-stop, and my body craved his cock."
"You never filter your words, you know?" Yue Xuelian pinched her sister’s nose.
"I never thought about sex with men in the past either, but I have to admit that I enjoyed having sex with our husband.
Somehow, I felt myself changing after I had sex with him, and I feel like my life was no longer as cold as it was in the past."
"Have your feelings for me changed, Big Sis?"
Yue Xuelian shook her head and rubbed her sister’s cheek.
"You are my sister and my first love, so my feelings for you will never change, and we will always be together for the rest of our lives."
"Yeah." Yue Qianrou laid her head on her big sister’s shoulder.
"Even though we are both his wives, I will always love you forever."
"Qianrou."
"Hmm?"
"Thank you for forgiving me."
"I should be the one apologizing to you, Big Sis." Yue Qianrou hugged her tighter.
"We’ve been together since we were little, and you’ve always treated me with such care, even when I was sick.
You even starved yourself for me many times, but I hate you for what happened back then.
I should have known how you felt about me, and I should have known that you never intended to leave me in that damned place."
Yue Xuelian breathed a sigh of relief, rubbing her sister’s back.
"Let’s forget all that and move forward together in our new life, okay?
Sister Yao already said that there’s a solution to reverse the curse, and our husband has promised you that he’ll do whatever it takes to get you back to normal."
"Now that I think about it, I no longer care whether I’m human or a corpse demon." Yue Qianrou raised her head and looked at her big sister.
"After all, our husband is a lust demon, so it shouldn’t matter if I remain a corpse demon, right?"
"Yes." Yue Xuelian suddenly remembered someone.
"Actually, there is a corpse demon woman by our husband’s side."
"Oh?
Who is that woman, Big Sis?" Yue Qianrou was surprised by that because she still didn’t know much about Zhang Fei.
Yue Xuelian created a qi screen.
"Her name is Wang Yin, and our husband met her in the middle realm.
Unlike you, she is the true corpse demon because she no longer has her soul, and her fate is worse than yours."
"You mean?" Yue Xuelian told Yue Qianrou about Wang Yin, Yuan Xiajie, and some other things.
"Tch!
That woman is truly outrageous!
I hope our husband will capture her one day, and I hope he will torture her at that time.
Where is Wang Yin now?
Since she is a corpse demon like me, I want to meet her."
"She is in the Tower of Eternity now, so you have to wait for her to come back to meet her."

chapters.title: Chapter 1676: Divine Samsara Sect’s Ancestors
paragraphs: *Tap... Tap...*
After a little over three weeks of travel, Yue Ningxue, Liang Huizhong, Li Guangyu, and several other main elders finally arrived at the Divine Samsara Sect.
"I’ll go meet the others."
"I’ll join you, Ancestor Ningxue." Yue Ningxue simply nodded and walked away, followed by Liang Huizhong and Li Guangyu.
Soon, they arrived at a room with ten chairs neatly arranged on the north side, but they were divided into three rows, with one chair above another. "Come."
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

"Why did you summon us, Ningxue?" An old man sitting in the back seat asked. His sitting position indicated that he was the strongest among them. Only one seat was empty in the second row from the top because that was Yue Ningxue’s seat.

Yue Ningxue created a few screens showing those shadowy creatures. She explained to them about those creatures, which was based on Zhang Fei’s explanation. Since her soul had merged with his, they could communicate easily, and he guided her to explain to others.
"Where did you get all this information?" The old man asked.

"I heard everything from Empress Huo and Emperor Long, Senior Huang Tianzhun. We met them at the Tower of Eternity, and they talked about those creatures." Yue Ningxue glanced at Liang Huizhong and Li Guangyu, signaling them to shut up. "Those creatures have not yet appeared in this Paradise Realm, but that does not rule out the possibility that they will appear one day. For now, people from several domains have already moved to monitor their respective domains, so we must also order our people to move; otherwise, it will be too late if they appear here."
Huang Tianzhun nodded to Yue Ningxue before looking at Liang Huizhong and Li Guangyu. "Leave now and order our people to monitor every corner of this domain."
"Yes, Ancestor Huang." Liang Huizhong and Li Guangyu did not dare to disobey Huang Tianzhun’s orders, leaving the place hastily.
An old woman suddenly asked. "Are you hiding something from us, Ningxue?"
"Hmm?" Yue Ningxue looked at the old woman. "What do you mean by your question, Ouyang Xuening?"

"I don’t mean anything, but I feel that you are hiding some things about the incident at the tower." Yue Ningxue raised an eyebrow at Ouyang Xuening. "I noticed your glance at Liang Huizhong and Li Guangyu earlier, and they seemed scared of you, so I believe you are hiding something from us."

Yue Ningxue nodded to her. "You’re right, I did hide some things. However, I did this for the good of the sect and our future. Sometimes, it’s best to leave certain things unsaid, particularly those that impact the future of many people."
"What do you mean by that, Ningxue?" Another old man asked in a deep voice, his eyes narrowed as he looked at Yue Ningxue.

Crimson flames suddenly burst out from inside Yue Ningxue’s body, which not only shocked her but also everyone present. ’Empress Huo? Since when did she plant her flames inside me? Why didn’t I ever notice?’

The crimson flames quickly transformed into Feng Yao, but instead of using her current form, she appeared in front of them as Huo Yanling. She looked at them one by one, her lips curled up into a faint smile after seeing the expressions of several of them. "The three of you seem afraid of me, Ba Huangtian, Song Ruihuang, and Tang Xuanzong."
’Tch! Who wouldn’t be afraid of a barbaric woman like you?’ The three old men cursed inwardly, their bodies shuddering and trembling.
"What brings you to my sect today, Empress Huo?" Huang Tianzhun asked in a calm tone, but his heart was uneasy because of Feng Yao’s presence.

"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled before her eyes turned sharp, and her killing intent spread throughout the room, causing Yue Ningxue, who was behind her, to take a few steps back. "I warn all of you for the first and last time: stay away from the Twin Flames Domain and the Moonlit Passion Temple! I know that all of you are targeting Zhang Fei after the incident several years ago, and you guys are trying to capture him. However, you should know that he is my husband, and I will not hesitate to destroy this sect and kill all of you if you dare touch him."

Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening frowned as they listened to Feng Yao’s declaration about Zhang Fei being her husband and her accompanying threat. Meanwhile, the others expressed shock upon hearing that the barbarian woman in front of them would submit to such a young man.

Ouyang Xuening’s aura flared up as she stood up from her seat. "Do you think we’re afraid of you, Empress Huo? If you were your past self, we might be afraid of you. However, hundreds of years have passed, and the current you is no longer our match."
"Is that so?" Feng Yao smirked.
Ouyang Xuening frowned further, but her expression turned to shock as soon as Feng Yao’s aura pressed down on her. Despite her best efforts to resist the pressure, she was forced to her knees.

Huang Tianzhun and the others were shocked when they saw that. They tried to dispel Feng Yao’s aura to help Ouyang Xuening. However, they were even more shocked because her aura did not disappear, and it immediately suppressed them, causing their chairs to shatter and forcing them to kneel on the floor.

Yue Ningxue, who was standing far behind Feng Yao, trembled when she saw this incident. She knew that the female phoenix was powerful in the past because she had once lost to her, but she didn’t expect her strength to still be as terrifying after her reincarnation.

"Heh!" Feng Yao sneered. "Hundreds of years have passed, and I’m no longer your opponent, you say? You overestimate yourselves, you know? In my eyes, all of you are no different from ants, and I can kill you guys without moving a finger. In the past, I let you all live because I had some goals, and I needed you to achieve them. I still need all of you today, but the situation is different now, and I won’t hesitate to kill you. You must remember my words in your stupid brain! If you dare to attack the Twin Flames Domain and the Moonlit Passion Temple, let alone my husband, I will send you all to a place you have never imagined."
After saying that, Feng Yao turned into crimson flames again, but she did not enter Yue Ningxue’s body and disappeared from that place.
*Boom*

Huang Tianzhun’s aura was the first to explode, followed by the auras of Ouyang Xuening and the others. They had lived for so long and reached the pinnacle of cultivation, but Feng Yao humiliated them to such an extent, completely enraging them. However, they didn’t know that the Celestial God Realm wasn’t the pinnacle of cultivation, and there were several other stages above it.
"What should we do? Are we really going to let that kid develop?" Tang Xuanzong asked.
Song Ruihuang shook his head. "If we let that kid develop, he will be a threat to us in the future."
"Even though Empress Huo is powerful, I’m sure she can’t protect that kid forever." Ba Huangtian said.
"The problem is, we haven’t found the location of the Twin Flames Domain yet, so how are we supposed to find that kid?"
"Send more people to search for the domain, and we have to get rid of that kid as soon as possible."
Ouyang Xuening ignored those people and looked at Huang Tianzhun. "What are your plans next? Are we really going to continue our plan against that kid?"

"Yes," Huang Tianzhun nodded as he rose to his feet. "That kid will be a threat to us in the future, so we must get rid of him as soon as possible. However, we don’t need to act openly, and we will use other means to kill him. But before that, we must find the location of the Twin Flames Domain, so I will send more people to search for him. If necessary, we should go looking for him so we can find him faster."

Yue Ningxue massaged her forehead as she listened to them, mainly because Zhang Fei could listen to their conversation through her. ’This is bad! If they really do that, they will lead this sect to destruction.’

[Hehe!] Yue Ningxue froze as Zhang Fei’s voice appeared in her mind. [There are so many cultivators who hate the Divine Samsara Sect, and they desperately want your sect destroyed. However, they are lucky that I can’t kill them now, especially with the appearance of those shadowy creatures. When I find a solution to eliminate those shadowy creatures, it will mark the time of your sect’s destruction.]
Huang Tianzhun contacted several people and ordered them to carry out his orders. After that, he said nothing more and disappeared from the scene, followed by Ouyang Xuening and the others.
Yue Ningxue inwardly sighed and hurriedly returned to her ice cave.
The moment Yue Ningxue entered her ice cave, Zhang Fei [5] appeared before her. "How long have you been here?"
"Since you arrived." Yue Ningxue raised an eyebrow at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately sat down on her ice bed. "Is Huang Tianzhun the strongest among the ten of you?"

Yue Ningxue nodded. "Senior Huang Tianzhun is the pioneer behind the founding of this sect, and he is the strongest among us. His true strength is on par with Emperor Long, but he is physically weaker because he is a human and not a beast."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "What about the others?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1677: Take Yue Ningxue Away
paragraphs: "Ouyang Xuening is the second strongest, and I am the third." Zhang Fei [5] did not expect that Yue Ningxue was only ranked third. "Ba Huangtian, Song Ruihuang, and Tang Xuanzong are ranked fourth to sixth. As for the people ranked seventh to tenth, you don’t need to pay attention to them because they don’t have any official authority."
"How strong is Ouyang Xuening compared to you? What about the strength of those three old men?"

"Hump!" Yue Ningxue snorted coldly, causing Zhang Fei [5] to see disdain in her eyes. "If I were serious, I could defeat Ouyang Xuening easily. I handed over the second position to her based on Senior Huang Tianzhun’s request, mainly because of the family relationship between the Huang Clan and the Ouyang Clan."
"Do you hate the Ouyang Clan that much?"

Yue Ningxue sighed. "The Ouyang Clan is no ordinary clan, and they are powerful, with their average strength being on par with Ouyang Xuening. Empress Huo must know about them because she once attacked that clan in the past, and she killed a member of their clan in front of everyone."
"Hmm? What was Feng Yao’s problem with the Ouyang Clan in the past?"
"You know the habits of the young masters of those prominent clans, right? Some of them are virtuous, but some of them are evil."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "The Ouyang Clan was lucky because Feng Yao only killed the culprit that time. If I were in her shoes and someone else did something bad to someone close to me, regardless of who they were, I would slaughter the entire clan."

’Not everyone is as cruel as you! Even though Empress Huo was notorious in the past, she would never kill people who had no problems with her directly, and she only killed her targets.’ Then, Yue Ningxue asked her. "Do you intend to fight them?"

"If I wanted to fight them, I would have appeared on that place earlier. They are stronger than me, but I am confident in defeating them, including Huang Tianzhun." Zhang Fei [5] stood up and walked towards Yue Ningxue. She wanted to move away from him, but her body suddenly couldn’t move, convincing her that he was controlling her soul. He lifted her chin and kissed her, causing her eyes to widen and her mind to go blank. Even though he had kissed her before, she was still uncomfortable with his action. "Such soft and cold lips."
"You-"

"Hehe! I’ve seen your naked body and kissed you before, remember?" Yue Ningxue’s face turned red with anger and embarrassment. She didn’t expect Zhang Fei [5] to act like a hoodlum. "I want you to leave this sect and return to the Celestial Moon Sect."
Yue Ningxue furrowed her brows. "Why do you want me to return to the Celestial Moon Sect? Hasn’t that sect already joined you?"

"Even though the Celestial Moon Sect joined me, it still stands alone, under the leadership of Yue Xuelian." At first, Yue Ningxue thought that Zhang Fei [5] merged that sect with the Moonlit Passion Temple, but her previous guess turned out to be wrong. "After all, you are their ancestor, and you are one of the powerful cultivators in this Paradise realm. If you return to them, they will be even stronger, and you will also gain many benefits from me."
"Benefits?"

"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] took out some pills and showed them to Yue Ningxue. She took a deep breath and looked at the pills with wide eyes. "This sect does have three alchemy gods, but I have nine. Their pills have good effects, but my pills are much more beneficial than theirs. Besides, this sect will disappear after I find a solution to get rid of those shadowy creatures, so you don’t need to think about it anymore."
Yue Ningxue frowned again. "Are you really going to destroy this sect in the future?"

"Are my words not clear yet?" Zhang Fei [5] rubbed her cheeks. "You are my woman, so I can’t possibly leave you to ruin with them. Therefore, I want you to return to the Celestial Moon Sect, and you can help them develop even more."
’Tch! I’m not your woman!’ Yue Ningxue gritted her teeth in anger.

Yue Ningxue thought seriously about Zhang Fei [5]’s words. She herself had fought him some time ago, and she couldn’t defeat him, even though her cultivation was far above his, which ended with him merging their souls. Moreover, she already knew more or less about the people behind him, such as Feng Yao, Long Wuzhao, those demon gods, and several others. With their help, it was not difficult for him to destroy the Divine Samsara Sect, and he had not done that just because of the appearance of those shadowy creatures.

Yue Ningxue was brought out of her thoughts when Zhang Fei [5] opened her mouth and poured some liquid into it, and her body stiffened once she realized what kind of liquid it was. At first, she didn’t want to swallow it, but she immediately swallowed it all after she realized the liquid’s power.

’How could his yang qi be this strong? I have never swallowed yang qi before, but I can confirm that his yang qi is truly powerful—far beyond that of male cultivators above his level.’ Yue Ningxue coughed after she finished swallowing it. "What are you doing? Why are you giving your yang qi to me?"

Zhang Fei [5] kissed Yue Ningxue’s lips again after he cleared his yang qi from her mouth, leaving her dumbfounded and speechless. "I told you that you are my woman, and I gave you my yang qi to mark you. So, what about your decision? Do you want to return to the Celestial Moon Sect?"
"Sigh," Yue Ningxue sighed. "Do you think they’ll be willing to accept me? I left them when the sect’s situation declined, and I continue to take their members for the Divine Samsara Sect."

"Why not?" Zhang Fei [5] created a qi screen and showed Yue Ningxue when his main body was dual cultivating with Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou, making her face red with embarrassment. She was also shocked that the two women decided to become his wives, especially with their characters like that. "See? Xuelian and Qianrou are my wives, but they still run the sect now. They may find it hard to forgive you, but I believe they will listen to me and accept you back."
"Are you sure about that?"

"Why are you so pessimistic?" Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. "Everyone makes mistakes, but your mistakes aren’t that serious. You did abandon them and suppress them in the past, but you can fix everything, and I will help you in the process."

"Alright," Yue Ningxue decided after she thought about Zhang Fei [5]’s offer carefully, especially with the uncertain future of the Divine Samsara Sect. "I’ll pack up my things first, and you can take me to the Celestial Moon Sect afterward."
Sometime later, Zhang Fei [5] and Yue Ningxue walked into the Celestial Moon Sect, causing the disciples who saw them to immediately stop.

Yue Ningxue followed behind Zhang Fei [5] while looking at the sect areas. Even though the sect was smaller than their old sect, all the buildings were entirely new because the giant race and others built new ones especially for them.

Those disciples recognized Yue Ningxue, and they had heard that she forced Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou to hand over all their sect’s top talents to the Divine Samsara Sect, which made their sect continue to decline in several decades.
Although they didn’t dare rebuke Yue Ningxue directly, they began whispering about her to each other, curious about Zhang Fei [5]’s purpose in bringing her to their new sect.
Although Yue Ningxue could hear them and feel their hatred for her, she didn’t bother with them because those disciples were no different from ants in front of her.
"Zhang Fei! Why did you bring her here?"

Zhang Fei [5] and Yue Ningxue turned to the owner of the loud voice, who was none other than Yue Yuling. "Elder Yuling, I know you and the others hate her for her past actions, but she is my woman now, so I brought her here to help you all."
"Shameless!" Yue Ningxue inwardly cursed.

Yue Yuling froze in place and looked at Zhang Fei [5] in shock. She shifted her gaze to Yue Ningxue, who didn’t refute him and turned her red face to the side. "Hahaha! Are you serious? Is this woman your woman now?"
"Do you want proof, Elder Yuling?" Yue Yuling nodded at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately hugged Yue Ningxue’s waist and kissed her. "Are you satisfied with the proof?"
Yue Yuling nodded repeatedly, giving Zhang Fei [5] a thumbs up. "You’re amazing! Not only did you manage to subdue my sect master and vice sect master, but you also managed to subdue this woman."
On the other hand, Yue Ningxue’s face darkened because of their conversation. ’Tch! I’ll beat this brat one day!’
"Since you are satisfied with the evidence, I will take her to meet Xuelian and Qianrou, and you can join us if you want."
"I will summon the other elders."
"Alright! Call them now and ask them to gather in the main hall."

Soon, they were gathered in the main hall, and all the elders of the sect were looking at Yue Ningxue with hatred. However, Yue Yuling had already told them that she was Zhang Fei [5]’s woman, making them satisfied with that fact.
"What do you want to do to her, husband?" Yue Xuelian asked, glancing at Yue Ningxue.

sentences.text: "Ouyang Xuening is the second strongest, and I am the third." Zhang Fei [5] did not expect that Yue Ningxue was only ranked third.
"Ba Huangtian, Song Ruihuang, and Tang Xuanzong are ranked fourth to sixth.
As for the people ranked seventh to tenth, you don’t need to pay attention to them because they don’t have any official authority."
"How strong is Ouyang Xuening compared to you?
What about the strength of those three old men?"
"Hump!" Yue Ningxue snorted coldly, causing Zhang Fei [5] to see disdain in her eyes.
"If I were serious, I could defeat Ouyang Xuening easily.
I handed over the second position to her based on Senior Huang Tianzhun’s request, mainly because of the family relationship between the Huang Clan and the Ouyang Clan."
"Do you hate the Ouyang Clan that much?"
Yue Ningxue sighed.
"The Ouyang Clan is no ordinary clan, and they are powerful, with their average strength being on par with Ouyang Xuening.
Empress Huo must know about them because she once attacked that clan in the past, and she killed a member of their clan in front of everyone."
"Hmm?
What was Feng Yao’s problem with the Ouyang Clan in the past?"
"You know the habits of the young masters of those prominent clans, right?
Some of them are virtuous, but some of them are evil."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"The Ouyang Clan was lucky because Feng Yao only killed the culprit that time.
If I were in her shoes and someone else did something bad to someone close to me, regardless of who they were, I would slaughter the entire clan."
’Not everyone is as cruel as you!
Even though Empress Huo was notorious in the past, she would never kill people who had no problems with her directly, and she only killed her targets.’ Then, Yue Ningxue asked her.
"Do you intend to fight them?"
"If I wanted to fight them, I would have appeared on that place earlier.
They are stronger than me, but I am confident in defeating them, including Huang Tianzhun." Zhang Fei [5] stood up and walked towards Yue Ningxue.
She wanted to move away from him, but her body suddenly couldn’t move, convincing her that he was controlling her soul.
He lifted her chin and kissed her, causing her eyes to widen and her mind to go blank.
Even though he had kissed her before, she was still uncomfortable with his action.
"Such soft and cold lips."
"You-"
"Hehe!
I’ve seen your naked body and kissed you before, remember?" Yue Ningxue’s face turned red with anger and embarrassment.
She didn’t expect Zhang Fei [5] to act like a hoodlum.
"I want you to leave this sect and return to the Celestial Moon Sect."
Yue Ningxue furrowed her brows.
"Why do you want me to return to the Celestial Moon Sect?
Hasn’t that sect already joined you?"

"Even though the Celestial Moon Sect joined me, it still stands alone, under the leadership of Yue Xuelian." At first, Yue Ningxue thought that Zhang Fei [5] merged that sect with the Moonlit Passion Temple, but her previous guess turned out to be wrong.
"After all, you are their ancestor, and you are one of the powerful cultivators in this Paradise realm.
If you return to them, they will be even stronger, and you will also gain many benefits from me."
"Benefits?"
"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] took out some pills and showed them to Yue Ningxue.
She took a deep breath and looked at the pills with wide eyes.
"This sect does have three alchemy gods, but I have nine.
Their pills have good effects, but my pills are much more beneficial than theirs.
Besides, this sect will disappear after I find a solution to get rid of those shadowy creatures, so you don’t need to think about it anymore."
Yue Ningxue frowned again.
"Are you really going to destroy this sect in the future?"
"Are my words not clear yet?" Zhang Fei [5] rubbed her cheeks.
"You are my woman, so I can’t possibly leave you to ruin with them.
Therefore, I want you to return to the Celestial Moon Sect, and you can help them develop even more."
’Tch!
I’m not your woman!’ Yue Ningxue gritted her teeth in anger.
Yue Ningxue thought seriously about Zhang Fei [5]’s words.
She herself had fought him some time ago, and she couldn’t defeat him, even though her cultivation was far above his, which ended with him merging their souls.
Moreover, she already knew more or less about the people behind him, such as Feng Yao, Long Wuzhao, those demon gods, and several others.
With their help, it was not difficult for him to destroy the Divine Samsara Sect, and he had not done that just because of the appearance of those shadowy creatures.
Yue Ningxue was brought out of her thoughts when Zhang Fei [5] opened her mouth and poured some liquid into it, and her body stiffened once she realized what kind of liquid it was.
At first, she didn’t want to swallow it, but she immediately swallowed it all after she realized the liquid’s power.
’How could his yang qi be this strong?
I have never swallowed yang qi before, but I can confirm that his yang qi is truly powerful—far beyond that of male cultivators above his level.’ Yue Ningxue coughed after she finished swallowing it.
"What are you doing?
Why are you giving your yang qi to me?"
Zhang Fei [5] kissed Yue Ningxue’s lips again after he cleared his yang qi from her mouth, leaving her dumbfounded and speechless.
"I told you that you are my woman, and I gave you my yang qi to mark you.
So, what about your decision?
Do you want to return to the Celestial Moon Sect?"
"Sigh," Yue Ningxue sighed.
"Do you think they’ll be willing to accept me?
I left them when the sect’s situation declined, and I continue to take their members for the Divine Samsara Sect."
"Why not?" Zhang Fei [5] created a qi screen and showed Yue Ningxue when his main body was dual cultivating with Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou, making her face red with embarrassment.
She was also shocked that the two women decided to become his wives, especially with their characters like that.
"See?
Xuelian and Qianrou are my wives, but they still run the sect now.
They may find it hard to forgive you, but I believe they will listen to me and accept you back."
"Are you sure about that?"
"Why are you so pessimistic?" Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly.
"Everyone makes mistakes, but your mistakes aren’t that serious.
You did abandon them and suppress them in the past, but you can fix everything, and I will help you in the process."
"Alright," Yue Ningxue decided after she thought about Zhang Fei [5]’s offer carefully, especially with the uncertain future of the Divine Samsara Sect.
"I’ll pack up my things first, and you can take me to the Celestial Moon Sect afterward."
Sometime later, Zhang Fei [5] and Yue Ningxue walked into the Celestial Moon Sect, causing the disciples who saw them to immediately stop.
Yue Ningxue followed behind Zhang Fei [5] while looking at the sect areas.
Even though the sect was smaller than their old sect, all the buildings were entirely new because the giant race and others built new ones especially for them.

Those disciples recognized Yue Ningxue, and they had heard that she forced Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou to hand over all their sect’s top talents to the Divine Samsara Sect, which made their sect continue to decline in several decades.
Although they didn’t dare rebuke Yue Ningxue directly, they began whispering about her to each other, curious about Zhang Fei [5]’s purpose in bringing her to their new sect.
Although Yue Ningxue could hear them and feel their hatred for her, she didn’t bother with them because those disciples were no different from ants in front of her.
"Zhang Fei!
Why did you bring her here?"
Zhang Fei [5] and Yue Ningxue turned to the owner of the loud voice, who was none other than Yue Yuling.
"Elder Yuling, I know you and the others hate her for her past actions, but she is my woman now, so I brought her here to help you all."
"Shameless!" Yue Ningxue inwardly cursed.
Yue Yuling froze in place and looked at Zhang Fei [5] in shock.
She shifted her gaze to Yue Ningxue, who didn’t refute him and turned her red face to the side.
"Hahaha!
Are you serious?
Is this woman your woman now?"
"Do you want proof, Elder Yuling?" Yue Yuling nodded at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately hugged Yue Ningxue’s waist and kissed her.
"Are you satisfied with the proof?"
Yue Yuling nodded repeatedly, giving Zhang Fei [5] a thumbs up.
"You’re amazing!
Not only did you manage to subdue my sect master and vice sect master, but you also managed to subdue this woman."
On the other hand, Yue Ningxue’s face darkened because of their conversation. ’Tch!
I’ll beat this brat one day!’
"Since you are satisfied with the evidence, I will take her to meet Xuelian and Qianrou, and you can join us if you want."
"I will summon the other elders."
"Alright!
Call them now and ask them to gather in the main hall."
Soon, they were gathered in the main hall, and all the elders of the sect were looking at Yue Ningxue with hatred.
However, Yue Yuling had already told them that she was Zhang Fei [5]’s woman, making them satisfied with that fact.
"What do you want to do to her, husband?" Yue Xuelian asked, glancing at Yue Ningxue.

chapters.title: Chapter 1678: Yue Ningxue Join In
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] wanted to sit Yue Xuelian on his lap, but he quickly forgot about it because he felt bad for the elders, and he sat in an empty chair. "From now on, Yue Ningxue will return to this sect, and she will help you improve the abilities of the disciples of this sect."
"What about the Divine Samsara Sect? Do they know about her departure?" Yue Qianrou asked.

"Feng Yao previously threatened those old men, and I sneaked into Yue Ningxue’s ice cave, so they didn’t know about my presence or her departure. Even if they later find out that she returned to this sect, I will never be afraid to face them, and I will kill any of their members if they dare to attack this domain, so you don’t need to think about them and focus on our affairs." Zhang Fei [5] threw several jade bottles to Yue Ningxue. "Some of them contain basic pills, and they are much more potent than the ones sold in the Divine Samsara Sect. For the rest, you can see all the instructions inside the bottles; I have written their names and effects inside. As for my techniques, Xuelian will give them to you later, and you can use them to improve yourself. With your qualities, I’m sure that you’ll surpass Huang Tianzhun one day."
’Me? Surpass Huang Tianzhun?’ Yue Ningxue was startled when she heard Zhang Fei [5]’s voice in her mind. "Thank you."

"You are my woman, okay?" Yue Ningxue’s lips twitched in response to Zhang Fei [5]’s words; she turned her face to the side when all the women looked at her. "Since my business is finished, I will go to take care of some other things."
"Husband, has Mo Shentian returned to his domain?"

Yue Ningxue perked up her ears when Yue Xuelian asked that question, waiting for Zhang Fei [5]’s answer. "He will arrive in a week, but Mo Zainan and I have already arranged everything so that he won’t suspect anything. As for Sha Mo, he will arrive at his domain in a month, and Sha Yuan will help me to take care of her husband. Alright, I’ll go now, and I’ll contact you later."
"Wait, husband! Aren’t you going to send Qianrou to your private place?"

"Oh! That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] opened the portal to his training space, shocking Yue Ningxue and all the elders. "Go in, Qianrou. You have to catch up with your sister, so you have to train hard inside."

Yue Qianrou pursed her lips, but she didn’t protest and went straight into the training space to practice using the gravity feature. After he closed the portal, Zhang Fei [5] disappeared from their sight.
"Sect master, does he also have the space element?"

"No." Yue Xuelian shook her head at Yue Wanxian. "I can’t explain the details to you, but my husband obtained that technique from someone, and he doesn’t need the space element to use it. However, he won’t bring outsiders in, and he will only bring all his wives. Alright, you guys should leave now, and I will talk to Ancestor Ningxue."

Yue Wanxian and the other elders didn’t argue with Yue Xuelian and immediately left the place. Although they disliked Yue Ningxue and didn’t want to accept her presence in their sect, they decided to keep everything to themselves because of Zhang Fei [5].
"I didn’t expect you to be that kid’s wife, Xuelian." Yue Ningxue sat down on an empty chair.

"Soon, you will also be his wife, Ancestor Ningxue." Yue Ningxue was shocked because Yue Xuelian was already standing in front of her in the blink of an eye, touching her forehead. "My husband asked me to share all those techniques with you because you are his woman, and no one but his wives has them."

Yue Ningxue closed her eyes and read all the techniques, which were the Flawless Yin-Yang Art, the Nine Heavens Illusory Avatar Technique, the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art, the Lotus Ascension Art, the Frozen Heaven Body Technique, and the Winter Celestial Sutra.

Yue Ningxue clicked her tongue when she read the Flawless Yin-Yang Art, which was a dual-cultivation technique, making her aware of Zhang Fei [5]’s intentions toward her. She was excited after she read the soul technique and the avatar technique. She had an ice body technique that she had already learned for years, but his two techniques were slightly superior to hers. As for the Lotus Ascension Art, she was still confused about the technique.

Yue Ningxue did not expect that Zhang Fei [5] would be so generous as to give her some valuable techniques, but she sighed in her heart when she remembered his intentions towards her. Soon, she opened her eyes, looked at Yue Xuelian, and asked her, "How can your movement speed be so fast? I couldn’t even see you move, and you were suddenly in front of me."
"When you become his wife, you will know everything." Yue Xuelian walked away. "Let me show you to your room."
"Alright." Yue Ningxue followed behind Yue Xuelian, wondering about some things.
Soon, they arrived in front of a room, and Yue Xuelian left Yue Ningxue there after explaining a few things to her.
Yue Ningxue immediately entered the room, but she was unfamiliar with its layout. She waved her hand, and the room immediately froze.
"This arrangement suits me much better." Yue Ningxue sat on the ice bed, crossed her legs, and studied those techniques. "Sigh!"
Ouyang Xuening frowned upon entering Yue Ningxue’s ice cave because she could not find her there, and she noticed that all of her belongings had disappeared.
"Did that damned woman leave the sect? Why did she leave so suddenly?" Ouyang Xuening immediately exited the ice cave and went elsewhere.
Soon, Ouyang Xuening arrived at Huang Tianzhun’s private quarters. "Why did you come here?"
"Yue Ningxue left our sect." Huang Tianzhun frowned. "I just returned from her ice cave, but all her personal belongings are gone."
Huang Tianzhun tried to contact Yue Ningxue, but she did not reply to him. "She didn’t answer me."
"Why did she suddenly leave our sect without telling us? Could Empress Huo have kidnapped her on purpose?"

"That’s possible." Huang Tianzhun nodded slightly. "Empress Huo’s avatar appeared from within her body, so she must have done something to her. However, I can’t fathom that barbarian woman’s purpose in doing so."
Ouyang Xuening thought of something. "I’ll call Liang Huizhong now. I’m sure he knows something about her."
"Alright."

A few minutes later, Liang Huizhong arrived in the room. He immediately told Ouyang Xuening and Huang Tianzhun about everything that had happened in the tower, including Zhang Fei’s relationship with the people he met there.
"Leave."

After Liang Huizhong left, Ouyang Xuening spoke to Huang Tianzhun. "If that kid’s relationship with those people is truly like that, we’ll be facing a huge risk if we attack him and his domain. Empress Huo is already making things difficult for us, and we’ll be in even more trouble if Emperor Long and the others also help him."

"Yes," Huang Tianzhun agreed with her. "I don’t understand how a little brat like him can get the support of so many powerful cultivators, but what’s most shocking is that Empress Huo chose him as her husband. If we want to kill that kid, we can’t do it openly, and we need a special notch to kill him. For now, we don’t need to think about that, and we must find the Twin Flames Domain as soon as possible. Since Liang Huizhong and the others have returned, we will hand over the security of this domain and our sect to them, and we will go find the location of that domain."

"Liang Huizhong previously said that the Celestial Moon Sect moved to that domain; I feel that Yue Ningxue’s disappearance has something to do with that brat. If we manage to find that domain, I’m sure that we will find her there too."
"Yes," Huang Tianzhun called Ba Huangtian, Song Ruihuang, and Tang Xuanzong before standing up. "Let’s go now! We must find that domain as soon as possible."
"Let’s go."

In the Puyang Clan’s sacred ground, Zhang Fei had already withdrawn his hand from Puyang Yeyu’s back. He got off the bed, laid her down, and touched her chest. Once again, he channeled his qi into the woman’s body, even though sweat was drenching his entire body.
Just like Zhang Fei, Puyang Yeyu’s body was covered in beads of sweat, but her expression was much calmer than before undergoing the treatment.

Puyang Shenmi, who was observing the process from the side, nodded her head several times. "Senior Feng, where did you meet him? We’ve used many methods to treat Puyang Yeyu, but we couldn’t completely cure her injuries; we could only alleviate the pain. Her face is much calmer than before, and her injuries have healed 70%."

"Haha," Feng Yao laughed softly. "We met in the Sky Jade Realm, one of the planets in the lower realm. His cultivation had only just broken through to the foundation level at the time, but he was already able to face cultivators with cultivations above his, and he has improved a lot since then."

"I see." Puyang Shenmi nodded slightly as she looked at Zhang Fei’s solemn face. "Senior Hu didn’t make a mistake in choosing an heir, and this kid truly deserves that status. His age is still under one hundred, but his cultivation has already reached the Celestial Emperor Realm. Besides, he possesses several elements, and he has also mastered some of the elemental laws of those elements. Will you two stay here for long, Senior Feng?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1679: Puyang Kongque
paragraphs: Feng Yao shook her head at Puyang Shenmi. "In fact, I sensed those shadowy creatures targeted my husband because he was Hu Tianlang’s sole heir, especially the main core. They attacked us when we were in the Cangxuan Domain, but we managed to escape first, which led to the domain’s destruction."
"Huh? Is the Cangxuan Domain really destroyed?"
"Fortunately, there are no humans or other living creatures in that domain, so the victims that fell were only those low-level beasts."

"After all, the population in this Ancient Realm had decreased significantly after the past disaster, and many domains became empty because of it, including the Cangxuan Domain." Puyang Shenmi sighed. "So, are you two going to return to the Paradise Realm directly?"
"At first, I wanted to take my husband back to the Paradise Realm after we got those herbs, but he has other plans, and we will go to the Zenith Sun Sanctum after things are settled here."

"The Zenith Sun Sanctum? Is he looking for the Sun Flame?" Feng Yao looked at Puyang Shenmi. "Before those creatures appeared, some of my clan members accidentally entered that place, and they found the Sun Flame on the Sun Altar. However, they didn’t manage to get close to the altar to take the flame, so they ignored it and looked for something else."
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "My husband already has eight of the ten heavenly flames, and the Sun Flame will be the ninth in his collection."
"Does that mean he has obtained the Moon Flame?"

"My husband has obtained the Phoenix Flame, the Dragon Flame, the Soul Flame, the Blood Flame, the Sky Flame, the Earth Flame, and the Eternal Flame." Puyang Shenmi was shocked to hear this because no one had ever managed to obtain so many heavenly flames in the past; however, she recalled that Zhang Fei was Hu Tianlang’s sole heir, which explained her surprise. "The Eternal Flame is with me, and the flame spirit is one of his wives. Thus, my husband only needs to take the Sun Flame and the Chaos Flame to perfect it, but the latter is in a dangerous place, and that core creature might attack us there."
"Where is the location of the Chaos Flame?"

"Near the core of this universe." Puyang Shangren wanted to ask again, but Feng Yao shook her head at him. "Little Shenmi, there are some things you should not be curious about, let alone try to find out, or they will be detrimental to you."
Puyang Shenmi sighed inwardly and shifted her gaze to Zhang Fei, who was helping Puyang Yeyu put on her dress. She examined the female elder’s body and found that her injuries were 90% recovered.
Puyang Shenmi and Feng Yao walked towards the bed. "Thank you, Zhang Fei. If you don’t come here and treat Puyang Yeyu, I’m afraid she will never be able to fully recover."

"Senior, you don’t need to thank me; I just did what I could. Her injuries haven’t fully recovered, but it’s not a big deal." Zhang Fei handed some pills to Puyang Shenmi. "She just needs to rest and cultivate as usual, and her injuries will fully recover within the next month. To speed up her recovery, you can give her these pills."
"Thank you."
"Since the treatment is finished, we will take our leave, Senior."
"Please be careful both of you."
Feng Yao hugged Puyang Shenmi. "We must part today, but we will meet again in the future, so please take good care of yourself."
"I will." Puyang Shenmi hugged her back. "Even though my clan members are not as strong as you, you can tell me if you need our help in the future, and we will act according to your direction."
"Alright." Feng Yao hugged Zhang Fei’s arm and led him away. They immediately left the place together with Puyang Shangren and Long Xukong.
After they left, Puyang Shenmi looked at Puyang Yeyu, who was still lying there with her eyes closed. "How long are you going to pretend to be asleep, Yeyu?"

"Sigh." Puyang Yeyu opened her eyes and sat there. Her cheeks flushed red, remembering the previous situation. "How am I supposed to wake up with that kid still here earlier, Grandma? He saw my naked upper body, and he also touched my chest. Even though he did that to treat me, I’m really embarrassed."
"Haha," Puyang Shenmi laughed, amused by her shyness.

"Don’t laugh at me, Grandma!" Puyang Yeyu pouted. "Even though I’m so old, I’m still a virgin, and I’ll die of embarrassment if I open my eyes. I never thought such a young man would win Senior Feng’s heart, but I never expected him to be Senior Hu’s sole hair. His light element is more powerful than mine, and his healing techniques surpass all the senior healers in our clan."

Puyang Shenmi caressed her head. "Have you forgotten that Senior Hu is the owner of the best light element in this universe? Since Zhang Fei is his sole heir, his light element should also be powerful, right?"
"You’re right."

"Sister!" Puyang Shenmi and Puyang Yeyu looked at Puyang Zong, who was running as fast as lightning towards them. He immediately hugged the latter tightly, and his old eyes shed tears. "I’m glad... I’m glad you’re finally awake, Sister."
Puyang Yeyu sighed. "Brother, can you let go of me first? I’m not fully recovered yet, and you’re holding me this tightly."

"Haha," Puyang Zong laughed, wiping away his tears. "I was so happy after Senior Feng told me that you’ve recovered, Sister! You’ve been suffering from an injury for so long, and not a single healer in our clan could cure you. I asked them to stay a few days to thank them, but they declined my invitation."
Puyang Yeyu sighed again. "They still have other matters to attend to, so we can’t keep them in our clan, and we’ll thank them in the future."
"Yes... Yes..." Puyang Zong nodded repeatedly. "So, how is your condition exactly?"
"Currently, I have recovered 90%, and Zhang Fei said that I will fully recover in a month."
"Phew." Puyang Zong breathed a sigh of relief. "In that case, I’ll be leaving now, and you can rest here until you recover."
"Alright, brother."
Puyang Zong nodded to Puyang Shenmi and left the place directly, with a smile full of relief on his old face.

Puyang Shenmi looked at Puyang Yeyu with a smile. "Your brother has always loved you since you were both little, and your condition has made him depressed lately. Now that you’re awake, his heart can feel relieved."
"I know, my brother really loves me more than himself." Puyang Yeyu smiled to himself. "I’m going to cultivate now, grandma."
"You can cultivate, but you must not overexert yourself because your injury hasn’t fully recovered."
"I know."
An old man, none other than Puyang Kongque, was watching Zhang Fei examine the herbs. He didn’t expect the young man in front of him to be an Alchemist God, which made him overjoyed.

Puyang Kongque intended to keep Zhang Fei at the Puyang Clan longer, but Feng Yao immediately refused. Since she had already said so, he didn’t dare force his will to force them to stay. "Are you satisfied with these herbs, young man?"

"Completely satisfied!" Zhang Fei stored the herbs into the system inventory so his clone could plant them in the Sealed World Pearl. "Senior, I actually wanted to discuss many things with you about alchemy, but time doesn’t permit, so we’ll discuss them in the future."

"It’s fine... it’s fine..." Puyang Kongque waved his hands. "More important matters must be dealt with first, and we will discuss alchemy when you come to this clan again in the future. By the way, do you have other alchemists by your side?"
"Eight alchemy gods." Puyang Kongque’s eyes nearly popped out of their sockets after Zhang Fei said that. "Oh! Yao’er is also an alchemy god, so I have nine."
Puyang Kongque wiped his forehead, stealing a glance at Feng Yao. "If my clan didn’t need my presence, I would definitely follow you to the Paradise Realm, young man."
Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao. "Can my teleportation device be used to connect the two realms?"
"No," Feng Yao shook her head slightly. "The barrier separating the Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm is too strong for your teleportation device to penetrate, so it’s useless for now."
"For now?" Puyang Kongque was confused. "Does that mean it can be used in the future, Senior Feng?"

"One step at a time, and we’ll see the results in the future." Puyang Kongque’s lips twitched, but Feng Yao ignored him and hugged Zhang Fei’s arm. "Since our business in this clan is settled, we will leave now."
"Are you two going straight back to the Paradise Realm?"
"We are going to the Zenith Sun Sanctum."

Puyang Kongque could only sigh as he watched them walk away. Zhang Fei suddenly tossed him a storage ring. "Senior, you can share those pills with the others, and you’ll definitely be satisfied with their effects."
Puyang Kongque was overjoyed upon hearing this and immediately took out several pills from the storage ring.

"All the pills are superior grade! Basic pills, healing pills, recovery pills, yin pills, yang pills, beast pills, and many more." Puyang Kongque was stunned when he read the names of the other two pills. "The Youthful Retaining Pill and the Beauty Restoring Pill? Are the effects of the two pills really as he wrote?"
Puyang Kongque kept the other pills, and he swallowed the Youthful Retaining Pill and the Beauty Restoring Pill as per Zhang Fei’s instructions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1680: Mo Shentian’s Return
paragraphs: "Zhang Fei, you should take Leiyu with you."
Zhang Fei looked at Puyang Shangren. "Don’t you need his help? Those shadowy creatures keep attacking this clan, and—"

"You don’t need to worry about us because our barriers can hold them off." Puyang Shangren rubbed Ancient Leiyu Tianlu’s head. "Tianlu, you must always help Zhang Fei when he faces danger, okay? The future of this universe depends on him, and everything will be destroyed if those creatures manage to capture him."
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu nodded slightly. "Leave everything to me, Master. I will protect him, and I will kill anyone who dares to attack him."
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "Can you protect him as well as I can, little bird?"
Ancient Leiyu Tianlu’s lips twitched, but he was too lazy to argue with Feng Yao. "Zhang Fei, please send me into your beast space now, and you two can head to the Zenith Sun Sanctum."

"Alright." After sending Ancient Leiyu Tianlu into the beast space, Zhang Fei cupped his hands to the senior cultivators of the Puyang Clan. "Seniors, we will part now, but we will meet again in the future, so please take care of yourselves until then."
"We will be waiting for you, kid. We hope you will have evolved into a ten-tailed fox by then, and we will fight alongside you."
"Farewell!"
"Farewell!"
Long Xukong immediately opened a gap in the void, bringing Zhang Fei and Feng Yao in. He immediately returned to his dragon form and shot towards the Zenith Sun Sanctum.
*Tap... Tap...*
Puyang Shangren and the others turned towards Puyang Kongque before falling into a daze, especially because of the change in the old man’s appearance.
"Hahaha," Puyang Kongque laughed loudly. "Are you shocked by my changes? I’m no longer an old man, and I’ve regained my youth, making me feel much fresher and stronger."
"How did you suddenly become this young, Old Kongque?"
"Seeing your appearance now reminds me of our youth."

"Hahaha," Puyang Kongque laughed with satisfaction. "That kid is truly amazing! Even though I’m also an alchemy god, and I’m much older than him, I have to admit defeat to him. He gave me many pills, and two of them helped me regain my youth. Most importantly, the effect is not temporary but permanent, so I’ll stay young until the end of my lifespan."
"What? Are you serious about that?"
"Are you joking with us? There’s no such thing as a permanent youthful pill, right?"

"I’m just stating what that kid told me, so whether it’s true or not, you guys will have to ask him directly." Puyang Kongque took many pills and distributed them among the group. "That kid didn’t forget all of you, and he left enough pills for us. Some of them are basic pills, and their effects are much stronger than mine. You should go back to your room to swallow the other two pills, especially since the effects are a little dirty."
Without waiting, all the elders, including Puyang Shangren, returned to their rooms to swallow those pills. Meanwhile, Puyang Kongque entered the sacred ground.
"Ancestor."
Puyang Shenmi looked at Puyang Kongque. "Is there any trouble outside? How did you suddenly become this young?"

"No problem at all." Puyang Kongque gave her several of Zhang Fei’s pills and explained the benefits of each one. "That kid is too scary, Ancestor. I’ve swallowed all these pills, and their effects are truly extraordinary. His basic pills have a higher effect than mine, and these beauty pills are what made me so young. By the way, you and Sister Yeyu can swallow them, and I will come back out to distribute the basic pills to our clan members."
Puyang Shenmi stared at the pills in her hand in a daze. She had heard that Zhang Fei was an alchemy god, but she didn’t expect him to be able to concoct so many superior-grade pills.
Puyang Kongque was also an alchemy god like Zhang Fei, but Puyang Shenmi knew that he couldn’t concoct so many superior-grade pills at once.

Puyang Shenmi was most curious about the two beautiful pills. Even though she was a powerful cultivator, she was still a woman, and she had long coveted such pills. "Yeyu, stop your cultivation and swallow these pills first."
"Hmm?" Puyang Yeyu opened her eyes and received the pills from Puyang Shangren. "Did Zhang Fei really concoct these pills?"
"Yes." Puyang Shenmi nodded. "Swallow them and continue your cultivation afterward."
"Alright."

The two women swallowed the pills as explained by Puyang Kongque, starting with the two beauty pills. A few moments later, they stared at each other in amazement, and their appearances became much younger than before.
"Grandma, you’ve become so young, and your skin looks so firm."
"You are the same, Yeyu."
The two women took out mirrors to examine their physical changes, leaving them stunned once again. They stared at their reflections, rubbing their faces in disbelief.
"Not only have our appearances become young again, but our bodies have also rejuvenated." Puyang Yeyu muttered in a daze.

Puyang Shenmi nodded in agreement. "I don’t know how Zhang Fei managed to concoct these pills, but their effects are truly extraordinary. Alright, let’s swallow the other pills, and you can continue your cultivation afterwards."
"Yes, grandma."
Zhang Fei lay on Long Xukong’s back, his head resting on Feng Yao’s lap. "Are you interested in Puyang Yeyu?"

"Hehe! You understand me very well, Yao’er," Zhang Fei replied with a chuckle. "Compared to Puyang Shenmi, Puyang Yeyu is much more attractive, and she’s an old virgin. Honestly, I previously wanted to take her with us, but I changed my mind, and I’ll see her again in the future."
"You already used your Dream Lordship ability on her, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Since I won’t be able to return to this realm anytime soon, I deliberately used my ability on her so I can see her whenever I want."
"What other abilities did you use on her?"

"Puyang Yeyu’s cultivation is on par with you, but her physique is simply too low, so I slightly modified and enhanced her body. She still doesn’t realize it now, but she will realize that her physique has become stronger than Puyang Shenmi soon."
"Haha," Feng Yao laughed. "She’ll definitely be shocked when she finds out."

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "I’ve already brought Yue Ningxue to the Celestial Moon Sect, and the five ancestors went out on their own to search my domain. I don’t know whether they’ll succeed in finding my domain or not, but they’d better think twice about causing trouble there. If they mess up in my domain, I will repay them by causing great chaos in their sect, and I will kill some of them, like Liang Huizhong and Li Guangyu."

"I think it’s fine if you want to wreak havoc in their sect, but you don’t need to kill Liang Huizhong and Li Guangyu, and you can just enslave them." Zhang Fei looked up at Feng Yao. "Currently, we still need them to monitor their domain, so you shouldn’t kill them because they are powerful enough to help us."

"Alright." Zhang Fei opened a portal to the training space, asking Luo Yunxiao and the others to come out from inside. After all, it would take them one to two months to arrive at the Zenith Sun Sanctum, so they had plenty of time to relax.
Unlike the previous days, Zhang Fei did not dual cultivate with them, but he dual soul cultivated with them at the same time.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] took Lillea, Janette, and Shi Wu into the Sealed World Pearl. The three women cloned all the herbs he got from the Puyang Clan into many, and he planted most of them inside.
After everything was done, Zhang Fei [1] took the three women back to the tower to continue their challenge on the second floor, which was quite difficult for them and the other women.

Inside the training space, Feltia [2] and two other clones were busy preparing alchemy. One of Zhang Fei’s clones had already brought Shang Xueli back to the training space, and she continued her training together with Yue Qianrou.

Zhang Fei wanted to concoct the Celestial Soul Ascension Pill first because it would be beneficial for increasing his soul power and that of everyone close to him. Furthermore, he was curious about whether the pill could help him break through to the immortal soul level, even though Feng Yao had already stated that it was unattainable with his current cultivation level.

Unfortunately, concocting the Celestial Soul Ascension Pill wasn’t as easy as Zhang Fei had initially imagined, and his clones repeatedly failed to concoct it despite already having reached the god-rank alchemist rank. He didn’t think much of it because Lillea, Janette, and Shi Wu could help him if the herbs ran low.
A week quickly passed.

Mo Shentian and his five subordinates finally arrived at the Celestial Demon Domain, and he immediately went to see his wife, Mo Zainan, to inquire about everything that had happened during his absence over the past few years.
As Zhang Fei predicted, Mo Shentian was unaware of the changes that had occurred to his trusted aides. He was unaware of the changes in his three sons, let alone the departure of his two daughters.
*Bam*
Mo Shentian slammed the table to pieces. "How dare they even think of attacking our demon race! Have you found the locations of their domains?"
"I’ve found the locations of the Thousand Eyes Demon Domain and the Faceless Demon Domain, but I haven’t managed to find the others."
"Where’s my master?"
"He’s in his private place and hasn’t been out since you were gone."
"I’m going to meet him now."
