She had heard that Zhang Fei was an alchemy god, but she didn’t expect him to be able to concoct so many superior-grade pills.
Puyang Kongque was also an alchemy god like Zhang Fei, but Puyang Shenmi knew that he couldn’t concoct so many superior-grade pills at once.
Puyang Shenmi was most curious about the two beautiful pills.
Even though she was a powerful cultivator, she was still a woman, and she had long coveted such pills.
"Yeyu, stop your cultivation and swallow these pills first."
"Hmm?" Puyang Yeyu opened her eyes and received the pills from Puyang Shangren.
"Did Zhang Fei really concoct these pills?"
"Yes." Puyang Shenmi nodded.
"Swallow them and continue your cultivation afterward."
"Alright."
The two women swallowed the pills as explained by Puyang Kongque, starting with the two beauty pills.
A few moments later, they stared at each other in amazement, and their appearances became much younger than before.
"Grandma, you’ve become so young, and your skin looks so firm."
"You are the same, Yeyu."
The two women took out mirrors to examine their physical changes, leaving them stunned once again.
They stared at their reflections, rubbing their faces in disbelief.
"Not only have our appearances become young again, but our bodies have also rejuvenated." Puyang Yeyu muttered in a daze.
Puyang Shenmi nodded in agreement.
"I don’t know how Zhang Fei managed to concoct these pills, but their effects are truly extraordinary.
Alright, let’s swallow the other pills, and you can continue your cultivation afterwards."
"Yes, grandma."
Zhang Fei lay on Long Xukong’s back, his head resting on Feng Yao’s lap.
"Are you interested in Puyang Yeyu?"
"Hehe!
You understand me very well, Yao’er," Zhang Fei replied with a chuckle.
"Compared to Puyang Shenmi, Puyang Yeyu is much more attractive, and she’s an old virgin.
Honestly, I previously wanted to take her with us, but I changed my mind, and I’ll see her again in the future."
"You already used your Dream Lordship ability on her, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"Since I won’t be able to return to this realm anytime soon, I deliberately used my ability on her so I can see her whenever I want."
"What other abilities did you use on her?"
"Puyang Yeyu’s cultivation is on par with you, but her physique is simply too low, so I slightly modified and enhanced her body.
She still doesn’t realize it now, but she will realize that her physique has become stronger than Puyang Shenmi soon."
"Haha," Feng Yao laughed.
"She’ll definitely be shocked when she finds out."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly.
"I’ve already brought Yue Ningxue to the Celestial Moon Sect, and the five ancestors went out on their own to search my domain.
I don’t know whether they’ll succeed in finding my domain or not, but they’d better think twice about causing trouble there.
If they mess up in my domain, I will repay them by causing great chaos in their sect, and I will kill some of them, like Liang Huizhong and Li Guangyu."
"I think it’s fine if you want to wreak havoc in their sect, but you don’t need to kill Liang Huizhong and Li Guangyu, and you can just enslave them." Zhang Fei looked up at Feng Yao.
"Currently, we still need them to monitor their domain, so you shouldn’t kill them because they are powerful enough to help us."
"Alright." Zhang Fei opened a portal to the training space, asking Luo Yunxiao and the others to come out from inside.
After all, it would take them one to two months to arrive at the Zenith Sun Sanctum, so they had plenty of time to relax.
Unlike the previous days, Zhang Fei did not dual cultivate with them, but he dual soul cultivated with them at the same time.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] took Lillea, Janette, and Shi Wu into the Sealed World Pearl.
The three women cloned all the herbs he got from the Puyang Clan into many, and he planted most of them inside.
After everything was done, Zhang Fei [1] took the three women back to the tower to continue their challenge on the second floor, which was quite difficult for them and the other women.
Inside the training space, Feltia [2] and two other clones were busy preparing alchemy.
One of Zhang Fei’s clones had already brought Shang Xueli back to the training space, and she continued her training together with Yue Qianrou.
Zhang Fei wanted to concoct the Celestial Soul Ascension Pill first because it would be beneficial for increasing his soul power and that of everyone close to him.

Furthermore, he was curious about whether the pill could help him break through to the immortal soul level, even though Feng Yao had already stated that it was unattainable with his current cultivation level.

Unfortunately, concocting the Celestial Soul Ascension Pill wasn’t as easy as Zhang Fei had initially imagined, and his clones repeatedly failed to concoct it despite already having reached the god-rank alchemist rank.
He didn’t think much of it because Lillea, Janette, and Shi Wu could help him if the herbs ran low.
A week quickly passed.

Mo Shentian and his five subordinates finally arrived at the Celestial Demon Domain, and he immediately went to see his wife, Mo Zainan, to inquire about everything that had happened during his absence over the past few years.
As Zhang Fei predicted, Mo Shentian was unaware of the changes that had occurred to his trusted aides.
He was unaware of the changes in his three sons, let alone the departure of his two daughters.
*Bam*
Mo Shentian slammed the table to pieces.
"How dare they even think of attacking our demon race!
Have you found the locations of their domains?"
"I’ve found the locations of the Thousand Eyes Demon Domain and the Faceless Demon Domain, but I haven’t managed to find the others."
"Where’s my master?"
"He’s in his private place and hasn’t been out since you were gone."
"I’m going to meet him now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1681: Mo Shentian - Mo Zhejun
paragraphs: "Master."
Mo Zhejun opened his eyes and looked at Mo Shentian. "Did you just come back today?"

"Yes." Mo Shentian sat in front of Mo Zhejun, recounting the story of being trapped in the tunnel for several years. He didn’t notice the faint smile on the face of his master, who had long been Zhang Fei’s slave. "I don’t know the identity of that mysterious woman, but she is truly powerful, and my ability to bend reality is ineffective against her."

"Since you’re back, you should forget about that woman." Mo Shentian furrowed his brows. "Currently, this Paradise Realm is in serious danger, and all domains are already on alert. If we are not careful, we will be doomed if those creatures suddenly appear in our domain."
"Where did you get this news?" Mo Shentian asked as his frown deepened.
"I got this information from my slaves in some other domain, and they heard it from the conversations of the cultivators there."
Mo Shentian himself knew that his master had many slaves in other domains to spy on the cultivators living there. "What creatures?"
"They called them shadowy creatures."
"Shadowy creatures? What kind of creatures are they? Where do they come from?"

Mo Zhejun shook his head. "I don’t have clear information about those shadowy creatures, but the people in those domains said they heard about them from Empress Huo and Emperor Long. Both of them are powerful and uphold righteousness, so I don’t dare doubt their words. I’ve discussed this matter with your wife, and I’ve asked her to deploy everyone to monitor every corner of this domain, so we’ll know immediately if those creatures invade ours."

Mo Shentian naturally knew that Empress Huo and Emperor Long would not spread false news, which would tarnish their reputation. Besides, they always cared about security in the Paradise Realm, and they would do anything to protect it. He was skeptical of those dark creatures, though, primarily because his master was unsure of their origins.

Mo Shentian spread his senses throughout the Celestial Demon Domain, discovering many members of his demon race standing guard and watching over all areas of his domain, including his confidants. However, he still did not know that his trusted confidants were under Zhang Fei’s control, and they were acting on his orders.

Mo Shentian contacted the other demon gods to find out the truth of the matter, but Sha Mo, Shang Zhanluo, and Qian Yan did not answer him. Meanwhile, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, and several others confirmed the news.

Mo Shentian thought Qian Yan was still in his slumber, so he did not answer him. Since Sha Mo and Shang Zhanluo did not answer him, he contacted their two wives, Shang Luohu and Sha Yuan, who immediately confirmed the news.
"Do you believe the truth of the news now?"
Mo Shentian nodded to his master. "All the demon races have confirmed the news, and they have also ordered their members to be on guard every day."

"In the past, Empress Huo was the strongest cultivator; she could even defeat Long Wuzhao and the previous demon gods. However, I heard from my slaves in other domains that she didn’t have the confidence to fight those shadowy creatures, so she asked everyone to watch over their respective domains, especially since those gates have long disappeared."

Mo Shentian sucked in a deep breath as he clearly remembered Feng Yao’s past strength. Although he didn’t know about her current strength after being reincarnated, he was certain it wasn’t much different from the past, considering her actions several years ago when she returned to the Paradise Realm. "Master, did you hear about the demon gods’ intention to fight me?"
"We both have known for a long time that Shang Zhanluo, Sha Mo, Qian Yan, Ku Shenzu, and Jiu Mozu want to kill you to lead all the demon races."
"What about Wu Mian and the others?"

Mo Zhejun shook his head. "Wu Mian, Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, and Nalan Shizhe don’t have that big of an ambition, so you don’t need to worry about them. Fortunately, those gates disappeared shortly after your departure; otherwise, Shang Zhanluo and the others would have long since attacked our domain if they discovered your absence."

"Sigh." Mo Shentian sighed heavily. "My travels over the past years have been in vain because of the appearance of that mysterious woman, and I’m sure she deliberately locked me in the tunnel. I can’t look for Mo Tianshen because of her, and I’m afraid that he will return to this realm one day to overthrow me."

"I understand your concern for your brother because I’m also worried about him, but I’m sure he won’t be able to return to this realm anytime soon, and I’m sure he’s still busy improving his cultivation in the Three Mortal Realms. For now, you don’t need to think about your brother or the other demon gods, and you must focus on protecting our domain from those shadowy creatures."
After they talked about some other things, Mo Shentian immediately left his master’s place without noticing the changes in Mo Zhejun.
Mo Shentian had returned to his palace, and he went straight to his royal chamber to meet his wife, Mo Zainan, to discuss those shadowy creatures with her.

Mo Zainan felt tense in her heart, and she was worried that Mo Shentian would suspect her. Fortunately, her husband was still preoccupied with his thoughts and didn’t notice anything. She explained several things to him about her plans to prevent those shadowy creatures from escaping their surveillance.

"You can take care of everything, and I’ll help monitor from afar." Mo Zainan nodded to Mo Shentian, who immediately spread his senses to search for his children. He found his three sons busy with their own affairs and his two daughters busy cultivating in their rooms. "Since when have our daughters been serious about their cultivation?"
"They focused on their cultivation shortly after you left for the tunnel."
Mo Shentian nodded slightly. "In that case, I will go to my seclusion place now, and you can contact me directly if there is any change to the situation in our domain."

"Yes." Mo Zainan released a sigh of relief after her husband disappeared. ’For now, I will patiently wait for Zhang Fei to improve his cultivation and clean up those creatures, and he will take me away from this place once he can match my husband.’

Puyang Yeyu opened her eyes, but she found herself in a place that was unfamiliar to her. She tried to use her cultivation, but her powers simply wouldn’t appear. "What is this place? How did I get here? Why can’t I use my powers?"

"You don’t need to be confused about this place." Puyang Yeyu frowned for a moment before becoming surprised at the sight of Zhang Fei. "This place is a dream, so you cannot use your cultivation here; your current state is merely your subconscious."
"A dream?" Puyang Yeyu was shocked by that because she had never heard of such an ability before. "Why did you bring my subconscious here?"
Zhang Fei sat beside her. "I just want to spend time with you."
"What do you mean by that?" Puyang Yeyu was not worried that Zhang Fei would hurt her because he had already helped her to heal her injuries.
Zhang Fei lifted Puyang Yeyu’s chin and looked at her eyes. "Would you believe me if I said I liked you the moment I saw you?"
Puyang Yeyu’s jaws dropped, and her lips formed an O shape.
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed softly as he pushed Puyang Yeyu’s chin up. "I told you the truth; I was attracted to you the moment I saw you."
"But how? Why?"
"There is no how and why in feelings."

"Do you think you’re too old for me?" Puyang Yeyu nodded at Zhang Fei. "You are indeed old, but age means nothing to cultivators like us, right? I only know that I’m attracted to you, but I can’t spend time in the Puyang Clan getting to know you because I have a lot of problems on hand to deal with. That’s why I used my dream technique on you, and I can spend time with you getting to know you wherever and whenever I want."
Puyang Yeyu was at a loss for an answer to Zhang Fei. "Anyway, I want to thank you for healing my injury."

"No need to thank me." Zhang Fei lifted Puyang Yeyu to her feet. "I’ve adjusted the flow of time in this dream, so we can spend time getting to know each other without worrying about the outside world."
Puyang Yeyu felt awkward and uncomfortable when Zhang Fei took her hand, but he was clearly much stronger than she was in the dream. "Where did you get this ability?"

"I am Hu Tianlang’s sole heir, but I am also a demon, and this dream is one of demon abilities." Puyang Yeyu was shocked to hear that, but Zhang Fei immediately created a qi screen, showing the stone monument left by his predecessor. "The writing on the stone is his handwriting, and he has long predicted my appearance. I am a human, a heavenly fox, and a demon."

After Puyang Yeyu read the writing on the stone monument, Zhang Fei removed the qi screen. He showed his three forms, leaving her stunned once again. After all, no one has three forms at the same time in their universe, and he is the only living being who has them. "Tell me, what kind of place do you miss the most, Yeyu?"
"I like a small lake with a waterfall on the side."

chapters.title: Chapter 1682: Zhang Fei - Puyang Yeyu
paragraphs: Zhang Fei transformed the place to suit Puyang Yeyu’s wishes. "I don’t know the small lake in your memories, so I could only create it like this."
"This lake and waterfall are more beautiful than the ones I visited as a child." Puyang Yeyu smiled broadly as she looked around them.
"Do you like the view here?"

"I like it." Puyang Yeyu rolled up her lower dress and took off her shoes. She sat on the side of the small lake, dipping her feet into the water. "When I was little, my brother took me to a lake like this in our home domain, but the lake was destroyed long ago, and there is no lake like this in our current domain."
Zhang Fei removed his shoes and sat beside her. "Your brother is Senior Zong, right?"
"Yes." Puyang Yeyu tilted her head to the side. "Hey, you’re still young, under a hundred years old; why don’t you look for a woman your age?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "Naturally, I like women my age, but women like you age like fine wine."

"Gibberish!" Then, Puyang Yeyu asked him. "Tell me honestly, how many women are by your side? When you were treating my injuries, I could sense the abundance of yin qi in your body, and their strengths varied."
Zhang Fei created hundreds of qi screens showing all the women by his side, causing Puyang Yeyu to be stunned again. "All of them are my wives."

"Too many!" Puyang Yeyu counted the number of women who appeared on those screens. She took a deep breath because she realized there were more than a hundred women. "How? How can you have so many wives? Why are they willing to share you with so many of them?"
"I told you that I was a demon, right?"
"Yes."

"My demon race is a lust demon." Zhang Fei transformed into his lust demon form, with nine tails dancing behind him. "My demon nature is too lustful, and it continues to affect me. I’ve tried to control myself in the past, but the urges that arise within me are too strong. In the end, I decided to accept my demon nature, and their numbers have become so numerous now."

Puyang Yeyu stretched out her hand, gently rubbing Zhang Fei’s horns. "In the past, some lust demons tried to capture me. I knew they were too lustful, and they wanted to use me as their plaything. They underestimated me because they were strong enough, and I killed them all."
"Are you going to kill me too?" Zhang Fei asked with a faint smile.

"I’m not a cold-blooded killer, okay?" Puyang Yeyu shook her head. "Furthermore, you’ve healed my injury, so I can’t possibly kill my benefactor, right? Besides, I was in a helpless situation because I couldn’t use my powers in this place, and you could have easily forced yourself on me, but you didn’t do anything of the sort."

"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed. "Honestly, I’m not as good as you think, and I used a bit of force to get some of my women. They had malicious intentions towards me in the past, so I used my demon abilities on them, and they couldn’t stop themselves from falling into my arms."
"How many of them fell to you because of your demon abilities?"
"Hmm? About twenty of them."
"Around twenty percent of them, right?"
"That’s right." Zhang Fei showed all the women affected by his lust demon abilities to Puyang Yeyu. "I used my abilities on them."
Puyang Yeyu returned her gaze to those qi screens. "Hmm? Some of them are female demons?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei explained to Puyang Yeyu the identities of the women one by one, including their encounters and his reasons for using his demon abilities on them. "Actually, I divided all my wives into six groups, and only a small portion of the main harem is affected by my demonic abilities."
"Six groups?" Puyang Yeyu was confused by that.

"In fact, I have five clones, but they are different from other clones. My clones possess my powers, but they don’t have their consciousness, and they are directly connected to the real me." Zhang Fei removed the other qi screens, leaving six of them behind. Each screen showed his real body and five clones, along with their respective wives. "I divided them like that, and my real body has the most wives."

Puyang Yeyu looked at all the qi screens; she was a little surprised because Zhang Fei’s three clones only had three to four wives. His first clone had seventeen wives, and his second clone had seven wives, all of whom were demons. "They are humans, demons, beasts, natural races, and winged races. You have wives from all five races, but you don’t have a wife from the demihuman race yet."

"There are several female demihumans by my side, but I have no interest in them." Zhang Fei removed all the qi screens and looked at Puyang Yeyu. "I know that I have too many wives, but I want you to be my wife."

Puyang Yeyu sighed inwardly. "I am truly grateful to you, but I cannot give you an answer now. My first reason is that I have never liked men with many wives, my second reason is that we don’t know each other yet, and my third reason is that you are too young for me."

"I understand that." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "That’s why I brought your subconscious here, so we could get to know each other better. I will convince you that I am the best man for you, and you won’t regret it if you decide to accept me. As for age, I never thought about that, and some of my wives are actually older than you."
’This kid leaves me speechless,’ Puyang Yeyu inwardly muttered. "You may be confident, but you won’t be able to convince me to accept you that easily."

Zhang Fei smiled at that. "Some of my women also said that in the past, but they eventually fell into my arms. I am confident in my abilities, and I will convince you to accept me, even if I have to spend a lot of time getting you."
"You can try, but I won’t fall in love with you that easily."
"Let’s see later."

After that, Zhang Fei and Puyang Yeyu exchanged stories about their past. She was truly shocked when he told her that he was born as an ordinary human on a planet without qi, and the woman who fell from the sky entirely changed her fate.
"Ugh." Puyang Yeyu moaned softly.
"Wake up?" Puyang Yeyu turned to Puyang Shenmi. "What happened to you? Why did you suddenly fall asleep?"
Puyang Yeyu immediately got up and sat up in bed. "How long was I asleep, Grandma?"
"Almost an hour."

"Eh? Only about an hour?" Puyang Yeyu was surprised for a moment, but she remembered that Zhang Fei could adjust the time in the dream to his liking. "Grandma, that kid brought my subconscious into a dream."
Puyang Shenmi raised an eyebrow. "Zhang Fei?"
"Yes," Puyang Yeyu nodded. "He used one of his demon abilities on me when he treated me a week ago, and he brought my subconscious there before."
Puyang Shenmi was not surprised by Zhang Fei’s identity as a demon because Feng Yao had told her before, but he was curious about his intentions towards Puyang Yeyu. "What did he say to you?"
Puyang Yeyu massaged her forehead. "He said he was attracted to me the moment he saw me, and he wanted me to be his wife."
"Did he force you to be his wife?"
"No," Puyang Yeyu denied it. "He could have forced me to be his wife if he wanted, but he didn’t do that to me. We spent so long in the dream, and we shared stories about our lives."
"How long did you spend in the dream with him?"
"Uhm? About a year, maybe? He can adjust the time in the dream as he pleases, but I don’t know how long the time flows inside, causing me to lose track of time."
"Do you like him?"

"I don’t know," Puyang Yeyu replied with a shake of her head. "After we spent so much time together, I feel he’s a good man, and he treats me with respect. However, he has more than a hundred wives from all races, except for the demihuman race. I’ve never been in a relationship with any man because I want to find the right man for me and love me alone, and he’s entirely different from the man in my dreams."

Puyang Shenmi nodded in understanding. "He’s a lust demon, so I think it’s natural that he has so many wives. After all, lust demons are the most lustful of all the demon races, but he’s good enough that he doesn’t use his demon abilities on you."
"Yes." Puyang Yeyu agreed with her.

"Why don’t you accept him, Yeyu?" Puyang Yeyu looked at Puyang Shenmi with raised eyebrows. "Even though he is a lust demon with many wives, he is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir, so I think he will become the best husband for you. Besides, you should still remember Senior Feng’s character in the past, and she always distanced herself from any man, but she decided to be his wife in this life."

"Grandma." Puyang Yeyu called softly before sighing. "Honestly, I love spending time with him, but I don’t have those kinds of feelings for him. Besides, Senior Feng and I are different, and I can’t follow in her footsteps of choosing a husband with many wives."
Puyang Shenmi chose not to ask any more questions. "Since you’re awake, you should continue your cultivation so you can fully recover faster."
"Yes."

sentences.text: Zhang Fei transformed the place to suit Puyang Yeyu’s wishes.
"I don’t know the small lake in your memories, so I could only create it like this."
"This lake and waterfall are more beautiful than the ones I visited as a child." Puyang Yeyu smiled broadly as she looked around them.
"Do you like the view here?"
"I like it." Puyang Yeyu rolled up her lower dress and took off her shoes.
She sat on the side of the small lake, dipping her feet into the water.
"When I was little, my brother took me to a lake like this in our home domain, but the lake was destroyed long ago, and there is no lake like this in our current domain."
Zhang Fei removed his shoes and sat beside her.
"Your brother is Senior Zong, right?"
"Yes." Puyang Yeyu tilted her head to the side.
"Hey, you’re still young, under a hundred years old; why don’t you look for a woman your age?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed.
"Naturally, I like women my age, but women like you age like fine wine."
"Gibberish!" Then, Puyang Yeyu asked him.
"Tell me honestly, how many women are by your side?
When you were treating my injuries, I could sense the abundance of yin qi in your body, and their strengths varied."
Zhang Fei created hundreds of qi screens showing all the women by his side, causing Puyang Yeyu to be stunned again.
"All of them are my wives."
"Too many!" Puyang Yeyu counted the number of women who appeared on those screens.
She took a deep breath because she realized there were more than a hundred women.
"How?
How can you have so many wives?
Why are they willing to share you with so many of them?"
"I told you that I was a demon, right?"
"Yes."
"My demon race is a lust demon." Zhang Fei transformed into his lust demon form, with nine tails dancing behind him.
"My demon nature is too lustful, and it continues to affect me.
I’ve tried to control myself in the past, but the urges that arise within me are too strong.
In the end, I decided to accept my demon nature, and their numbers have become so numerous now."
Puyang Yeyu stretched out her hand, gently rubbing Zhang Fei’s horns.
"In the past, some lust demons tried to capture me.
I knew they were too lustful, and they wanted to use me as their plaything.
They underestimated me because they were strong enough, and I killed them all."
"Are you going to kill me too?" Zhang Fei asked with a faint smile.
"I’m not a cold-blooded killer, okay?" Puyang Yeyu shook her head.
"Furthermore, you’ve healed my injury, so I can’t possibly kill my benefactor, right?
Besides, I was in a helpless situation because I couldn’t use my powers in this place, and you could have easily forced yourself on me, but you didn’t do anything of the sort."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed.
"Honestly, I’m not as good as you think, and I used a bit of force to get some of my women.
They had malicious intentions towards me in the past, so I used my demon abilities on them, and they couldn’t stop themselves from falling into my arms."
"How many of them fell to you because of your demon abilities?"
"Hmm?
About twenty of them."
"Around twenty percent of them, right?"
"That’s right." Zhang Fei showed all the women affected by his lust demon abilities to Puyang Yeyu.
"I used my abilities on them."
Puyang Yeyu returned her gaze to those qi screens.
"Hmm?
Some of them are female demons?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei explained to Puyang Yeyu the identities of the women one by one, including their encounters and his reasons for using his demon abilities on them.
"Actually, I divided all my wives into six groups, and only a small portion of the main harem is affected by my demonic abilities."
"Six groups?" Puyang Yeyu was confused by that.
"In fact, I have five clones, but they are different from other clones.
My clones possess my powers, but they don’t have their consciousness, and they are directly connected to the real me." Zhang Fei removed the other qi screens, leaving six of them behind.
Each screen showed his real body and five clones, along with their respective wives.
"I divided them like that, and my real body has the most wives."
Puyang Yeyu looked at all the qi screens; she was a little surprised because Zhang Fei’s three clones only had three to four wives.
His first clone had seventeen wives, and his second clone had seven wives, all of whom were demons.
"They are humans, demons, beasts, natural races, and winged races.
You have wives from all five races, but you don’t have a wife from the demihuman race yet."
"There are several female demihumans by my side, but I have no interest in them." Zhang Fei removed all the qi screens and looked at Puyang Yeyu.
"I know that I have too many wives, but I want you to be my wife."
Puyang Yeyu sighed inwardly.
"I am truly grateful to you, but I cannot give you an answer now.
My first reason is that I have never liked men with many wives, my second reason is that we don’t know each other yet, and my third reason is that you are too young for me."
"I understand that." Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"That’s why I brought your subconscious here, so we could get to know each other better.
I will convince you that I am the best man for you, and you won’t regret it if you decide to accept me.
As for age, I never thought about that, and some of my wives are actually older than you."
’This kid leaves me speechless,’ Puyang Yeyu inwardly muttered.
"You may be confident, but you won’t be able to convince me to accept you that easily."
Zhang Fei smiled at that.
"Some of my women also said that in the past, but they eventually fell into my arms.

"You can try, but I won’t fall in love with you that easily."
"Let’s see later."

chapters.title: Chapter 1683: Celestial Soul Ascension Pill
paragraphs: *Boom*
Zhang Fei [4] breathed a sigh of relief after the final explosion. She withdrew her fire qi, opened the lid of the Heaven Creation Furnace, and checked the five pills inside.

At the same time, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Feltia [2] had also finished refining their pills. They also checked the pills inside their furnaces, finding five each. They cleaned their furnaces and prepared another batch of ingredients to concoct the pills, as they had so many women by their side, and they also had to help those closest to them.

"Phew," Zhang Fei [4] took the pills. "After repeated failures, I finally succeeded in concocting the Celestial Soul Ascension Pill. I hope the effects of this pill can help my soul power break through to the immortal soul level."

Zhang Fei [4] called Shang Xueli and Yue Qianrou, who were training at the training ground. After the two women arrived, he gave them two pills and asked them to swallow them. "Tell me if there are any changes in the strength of your souls later."

Shang Xueli and Yue Qianrou immediately sat cross-legged in front of Zhang Fei [4], closed their eyes, and swallowed the pills directly. He looked at the two women with a look full of expectation, but he himself was still doubtful whether the pill would be able to help him or not, especially since Feng Yao believed that the pills would not be of much use to him.

A few minutes later, Shang Xueli and Yue Qianrou could feel their souls being enveloped by a heavenly aura. Their souls were undergoing refinement, expansion, and purification simultaneously, making them feel slightly uncomfortable. Faint visions of the heavens and Dao patterns appear in their minds, guiding the soul toward a higher state of existence.
*Boom*

An hour later, Zhang Fei [4] raised an eyebrow as a shockwave shot out from Shang Xueli’s body. Compared to Yue Qianrou, she was far weaker in every way, including her soul power. Before swallowing the pill, her soul power was only at the early stage of the saint soul level due to her long life as a puppet, which significantly slowed her progress in all areas.
Within a few minutes, Shang Xueli’s soul power broke through and reached the middle stage of the saint soul level, but it didn’t stop, and her soul power continued to increase.

’The effect of the pill is extraordinary for Shang Xueli because her soul level is only at the saint level.’ Zhang Fei [4] looked at Yue Qianrou; he could feel that his soul power was constantly fluctuating, convincing him that her soul power would also break through soon. ’Qianrou’s soul power is at the perfection of the venerate soul level, and she will enter the divine soul level after this breakthrough.’
After waiting for a few hours, Shang Xueli’s soul power stopped breaking through, and she reached the early stage of the venerate soul level.

At the same time, Yue Qianrou also completed her soul breakthrough, and the result matched Zhang Fei [4]’s previous guess, as she reached the early stage of the divine soul level. ’Her soul power only broke through one stage, huh? Although the result isn’t significant, it will be of great help to her.’

Yue Qianrou was the first to open her eyes and looked at Zhang Fei [4] with awe. "Sigh! An alchemy god like you is indeed different, husband. My soul power has been stuck for so long that I can’t even remember it anymore, but today it finally broke through again, and I feel that it won’t be difficult to break through in the future."

"Haha," Zhang Fei [4] laughed. "If you successfully learn the Lotus Ascension Art and form the black lotus within your soul, your soul power will definitely become stronger, and you won’t have any difficulty breaking through."

Yue Qianrou pursed her lips upon hearing that. Since she became Zhang Fei [4]’s woman, she has been trying to form the black lotus, but her efforts always end in vain because she doesn’t yet have an unwavering heart and absolute trust in him. Unlike her, her big sister, Yue Xuelian, had succeeded in forming the black lotus in her soul because her feelings for him were too deep. "Can I swallow the pill again, husband?"
"No," Zhang Fei [4] shook his head. "The pill can only be consumed once in a lifetime, so you’ll have to work hard to break through to the next stage, and I’ll help you with that."
"Alright." Yue Qianrou stood up and walked away. "I’ll continue my training, husband. I’m far behind you and big sister, so I want to catch up with you two."

[Master, as Feng Yao said before, the Celestial Soul Ascension Pill cannot help you break through to the immortal soul level. However, it can still strengthen your soul even further, and your soul world will be much stronger because of it.]

Zhang Fei [4] agreed with Mei because his soul power was the foundation of his soul world, and it would strengthen as his soul strengthened. He looked at Shang Xueli, who had just opened her eyes. "How do you feel after your soul level breaks through several stages at once?"

"I feel light and great." Shang Xueli was truly grateful to Zhang Fei [4]. About six years ago, he saved her from her hellish life, and he gave her many valuable opportunities since then. All of this made her slowly fall in love with him, but unfortunately, he always pushed her aside because of her father. "You’ve given me so many opportunities, and I don’t know how I should repay you."

Zhang Fei [4] smiled at that. "If you want to repay me, you must become a great leader for your Asura Demon Race after I defeat your father in the future, and you must lead them to become a better race."
"Do you really want to fight with my father?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] seriously nodded. "There are some matters I must settle, and they are related to your father, so I have no choice but to fight him."
"Are you going to kill my father?"
"Do you believe I can kill your father?"

"I do." Shang Xueli nodded. "I’ve been living in this place since you freed me from that hell, and I’ve seen many things about you with my own eyes over the past years. Other demons might insult you if you said you could kill my father, but I have no doubt in my heart that you could kill him."
"Will you hate me if I kill your father in the future?"

"I don’t know." Shang Xueli was in a dilemma about that. Zhang Fei [4] had saved her and given her so many precious opportunities, and she had also long been in love with him. On the other hand, Shang Zhanluo was her father, and she would never exist without him, so she sincerely hoped that they wouldn’t kill each other. "Will you stop if I ask you not to kill my father?"

"I don’t have an answer for you, and the outcome of our fight depends on your father. If he wants to kill me, I won’t stay silent, and I will kill him first. If your father can accept his defeat to me later, then no one will die then."
"I understand." Shang Xueli nodded in understanding. "I’ll continue my training now, so you can continue with your alchemy."
Zhang Fei [4] looked at Shang Xueli, who was walking away before sighing softly. He cleaned the remnants of the previous alchemy from his furnace, and he started concocting pills again afterward.
Inside the void, Zhang Fei took out some Celestial Soul Ascension Pills and handed them to Luo Yunxiao and the others.
Luo Yunxiao, Tianshi Shengjie, Helian Xun’er, Nalan Wangzi, Qing Qiu’er, and You Feiling immediately sat cross-legged and swallowed the pills.
Zhang Fei wanted to give them to Feng Yao and Huo Ling, but they refused. "These pills are useless to us, so you can give them to the others, husband."
"That’s true, husband," Huo Ling spoke. "I am the primordial flame, and my master’s soul is a primordial soul, so these pills will not be of any use to us."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and kept one pill. "This pill won’t be able to help me break through to the immortal soul level, but at least it can strengthen my soul even more, which will also have an effect on my soul world."
"Yes," Feng Yao nodded. "Your soul world will become even more solid with the help of this pill, so you should swallow it now, and you can check your soul world afterward."
Zhang Fei closed his eyes and swallowed the pill directly. He used his qi to dissolve and spread it throughout his body to speed up the process.
Huo Ling observed Zhang Fei and asked her master, "Is there a chance for our husband’s soul power to break through to the immortal soul level, Master?"

"Why must you ask a question you already know the answer to, Ling’er?" Huo Ling looked at Feng Yao in confusion. "Have you forgotten that Hu Tianlang is a primordial being? When our husband obtains all his souls and evolves into the ten-tailed fox in the future, his soul power will break through to the immortal soul level, and he will never die like us because his soul will already be immortal by then."
"Oh! That’s right!" Huo Ling exclaimed happily. "Do you think he will become completely immortal, Master?"

Feng Yao nodded. "When his physical cultivation breaks through to the immortal flesh stage, he will become a true immortal. Unfortunately, it won’t be easy for him to break through to that stage, and I haven’t found a solution to help him yet."

chapters.title: Chapter 1684: Evil Beasts - Their Master
paragraphs: Dong Xuanyin, who was relaxing in her little pond, creased her brows. She spread her senses to other areas of the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, discovering that the four perils had returned.

From afar, Dong Xuanyin could confirm that Taotie and the other three evil beasts were injured, although their injuries were not that severe. She contacted Zhang Fei through one of his clones because his real body was in the void, informing him about the return of the four evil beasts.
"Should I meet them to inform them about those shadowy creatures?" After thinking it over, Dong Xuanyin chose not to meet them.
In their palace, the four evil beasts gathered with furious looks, as they had been trapped in the four tunnels for years.
"We—" Taotie stopped speaking. He and his three friends shivered at the appearance of black smoke before them, and they hurriedly prostrated themselves.

The black smoke quickly transformed into a miniature version of the Primordial Nihility Beast. He looked at the four with his deep, dark eyes. "What about the task I gave you? Have you still not found those items?"

"Master, many things have happened in recent years, and they were beyond our control." Taotie shivered as the beast glared at him, and he immediately recounted everything that had happened, starting with Xereth’s disappearance and ending with their being trapped in the four tunnels.

Seeing that the Primordial Nihility Beast didn’t believe them, the four evil beasts created four qi screens showing their situation inside the four tunnels, including the appearance of the four mysterious women.
The Primordial Nihility Beast looked at the four qi screens with a sharp gaze, especially the figures of the four mysterious women.

"Who are these women? How can they control the tunnels? As I recall, no primordial beings had such abilities in the past, and all the remaining primordials have yet to wake up from their long slumber." The Primordial Nihility Beast suddenly realized something. "Could it be that they are those hidden forces that deliberately appear to protect the Three Mortal Realms? They are part of this universe, as are the tunnels, so only they could do such a thing."

"Master." The Primordial Nihility Beast shifted its gaze to Qiongqi. "You haven’t contacted us for a long time, so we couldn’t inform you that the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon has returned, and he is the strongest cultivator in this Paradise Realm."
The Primordial Nihility Beast narrowed his eyes. "Show me."

Qiongqi displayed an image of Long Wuzhao on one of the qi screens. "He is the current Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, and he lives in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain. We have long wanted to take control of this realm, but he has repeatedly stopped us, and his strength is a bit far above ours."
"Oh?"
"Qiongqi is right, Master," Taowu said. "We once fought with Long Wuzhao, and we lost to him in the end. Apart from him, his group has three other powerful beasts, Master."
"What are those three beasts?"
Hundun displayed images of the three beasts and provided explanations for each one. "The Celestial Dragon, Tianshi Bailong, the Void Dragon, Long Xukong, and the Golden Phoenix, Feng Jinhuang."
"A Golden Phoenix?"

"We don’t know how Feng Jinhuang was able to evolve into a golden phoenix, but his strength is not inferior to Long Wuzhao and the others, and his golden flames are truly terrifying." The Primordial Nihility Beast returned its gaze to the four. "Currently, those four beasts are protecting all domains, and we cannot go to open war with them. Besides, the situation in this realm changed several years ago, and all domains are separated from each other now."

The Primordial Nihility Beast was shocked when he heard that, and he spread his senses to check the situation. He frowned after finding those gates had disappeared, making him believe that those hidden forces were responsible for everything. However, he couldn’t understand the reason for their sudden move, and they foiled all his plans.
Taotie spoke to the beast again. "Besides those four beasts, there’s a terrifying female beast, and her strength appears to be superior to theirs."
"Who is that female beast?"

"That female beast is a fire phoenix, and she is the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling. A few years ago, she caused chaos throughout the domains, and her subordinates killed many living beings. Ten of our generals also disappeared along with the chaos, and we think they fell into her hands."

"A fire phoenix?" The Primordial Nihility Beast frowned. "Could it be that the fire phoenix is the same as the one I felt in the Ancient Realm a while ago? I remember she was with the Calamity Demon Dragon and the Void Dragon, so she should be the same person. But how could they know about the Ancient Realm? All living creatures in the Paradise Realm should not know about the Ancient Realm."

Taowu spoke. "Master, we probably won’t be able to descend into the Three Mortal Realms forever because those mysterious women will surely appear to stop us again, making it difficult for us to carry out the tasks you gave us."

"Forget those tasks for now." Taotie and the others were surprised to hear that, as they thought their master would punish them for all their failures. "Many strange creatures have suddenly appeared in the Ancient Realm, and their power is terrifying even to me."
"Strange creatures?"

"I don’t know their origin, but I do know that their power is terrifying." The four were shocked to hear that. "Their leader used a small amount of his power to destroy a domain, so I decided to withdraw my avatar from the Ancient Realm. For now, your job is to guard and supervise this domain, and you must be alert if those creatures suddenly appear in this Paradise Realm. If their leader appears here, the four of you must immediately escape, or you will die. As for those items, I will let you know when the situation has calmed down, and you can move then."
After saying that, the avatar of the Primordial Nihility Beast immediately vanished from the scene, much to the relief of Taotie and the other three.
"Phew," Qiongqi wiped his forehead. "I thought we were going to die today, but it turns out our master didn’t punish us for our failures."
Hundun let out a sigh of relief. "Our master seemed afraid of that mysterious woman, so he didn’t punish us."
"What does our master mean by those hidden forces? Why does he say that those women are those hidden forces?" Taowu asked the others.

"You ask me, who should I ask?" Taotie shook his head. "We shouldn’t think about those mysterious women now, and we should focus on healing ourselves while guarding our domain. His previous words clearly indicated that those mysterious creatures are terrifying, so we must be on full alert to prevent them from invading our domain, or we will die at their hands."
"For now, we must focus on recovering from our injuries and monitoring this domain."
"Let’s go." The four evil beasts immediately disappeared from the palace after instructing their subordinates.
Inside Zhang Fei’s soul world, Beiming Youhuang and Jia Xianzu sensed changes in every area.
"Do you feel that, Xianzu?" Beiming Youhuang asked, her eyes moving around to examine several areas.

"Yes." Jia Xianzu nodded at her. "I don’t know what Zhang Fei did out there, but his soul power is starting to increase again, and the increase in his soul power is also making this soul world stronger."

"Unfortunately, this change isn’t enough." Beiming Youhuang and Jia Xianzu looked at Zhang Fei [5], who had just appeared. He gave them each a Celestial Soul Ascension Pill. "You two need to swallow those pills now, and they will help you both strengthen your soul power."
"Did the increase in your soul power come from this pill?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Beiming Youhuang. "That pill is the Celestial Soul Ascension Pill, and its effects are quite amazing for our soul power. You two must swallow them now, and I’ll head back out to take care of some things."
After Zhang Fei [5] disappeared, Beiming Youhuang and Jia Xianzu swallowed the pills in their hands, and they hoped that the effects would be as good as they had expected.
"How do you feel?"

Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. "The Celestial Soul Ascension Pill is excellent, but its effects aren’t significant for me. My soul has become stronger, but I feel like the increase is only about ten percent."

"Haha," Feng Yao softly laughed. "Alright, you don’t need to regret that, and you just need to prepare yourself to face Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul. He is the most formidable opponent for the current you, so you must really prepare yourself if you don’t want to lose to him again."

"Phew." Zhang Fei clenched his fists. "I’m still weak now, but I won’t stop here, and I will continue to improve my strength. When I’m ready, I will go to the Illusionary Spirit Fox Domain to face him, and I will definitely defeat him then. By the way, Dong Xuanyin previously contacted me and told me that the four perils have returned, and the avatar of the Primordial Nihility Beast has also appeared to meet them."
"Humph." Huo Ling snorted. "If my master hadn’t forbidden me, I would have killed those weak beasts long ago."
Feng Yao smiled upon hearing that. "What are the four perils planning next?"

"Nothing." Zhang Fei shook his head. "Their master is afraid of the core creature, and he asked them to keep an eye on their domain. However, they’ve already told him about Long Wuzhao and the others, and he’ll probably take action against them soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 1685: Share The Pills I
paragraphs: Luo Yunxiao was the first to open her eyes and smiled broadly. "My soul power has finally broken through to the intermediate stage of the divine soul level, husband."
"Isn’t that great?" Zhang Fei pulled Luo Yunxiao close and kissed her. "Your soul power is the highest among your sisters, and you are getting closer to the peak now."
Luo Yunxiao pursed her lips. "Isn’t there still the immortal soul level?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "However, the immortal soul level is very difficult to achieve, so you just need to be patient, and you will eventually reach that level in the future."
Luo Yunxiao sighed. "Naturally, I am aware of my limits, so I will be patient to reach that stage."
"That’s good." Zhang Fei looked at Tianshi Shengjie. "Congratulations, Little Shengjie. Your soul power has also reached the intermediate stage of the divine soul level."

Tianshi Shengjie nodded with a smile. "If it weren’t for you, my soul level wouldn’t have reached this stage now. The Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art and the Lotus Ascension Art are truly extraordinary, and they have both really helped me in increasing my soul power."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "I got the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art by luck. As for the Lotus Ascension Art from the Lotus Forbidden Codex, you should thank Qiu’er because she gave the technique to me."
"I know." Tianshi Shengjie nodded slightly.

Soon, Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling had opened their eyes, and their soul power had reached the half-perfection stage of the divine soul level. Zhang Fei directly sent them back to the Twin Flames Domain to take care of some matters in their sect.
A few minutes after that, it was Helian Xun’er and Nalan Wangzi’s turn to open their eyes, and their soul power had reached the early stage of the divine soul level.
"Congratulations, you two! Your soul power has finally reached this stage."
Nalan Wangzi sighed. "My soul power is the slowest to develop among all my sisters, husband."

"Hehe," Helian Xun’er laughed. "Sister Wangzhi, we cultivated dual souls with him much later than the others, remember? Therefore, you don’t need to be so sad, and your soul power will continue to increase in the future."
"You’re right." Then, Nalan Wangzi asked Zhang Fei. "When will you take Sister Xun’er and Sister Shengjie as your wives, husbands?"

"After we return from the Ancient Realm, I will take them into seclusion, and we won’t come out for some time." Helian Xun’er and Tianshi Shengjie blushed in anticipation. They were ready to become Zhang Fei’s wives, but she was still busy with many things. "Hahaha! Don’t worry, okay? After we get back, I’ll eat you both until I’m satisfied."
"Husband, have you never been interested in Hua Mei’er and Hua Xiang’er?" Helian Xun’er asked.

"No." Zhang Fei shook his head. "Hua Mei’er is too reckless and innocent for my taste. Hua Xiang’er is beautiful, but she doesn’t catch my eye. The only woman I desire most is Tian Qiye, but I must first crush her arrogance to subdue her."
"Haha," Nalan Wangzi laughed. "I can’t imagine Tian Qiye’s expression when she moaned under your onslaught, Husband. However, she is a proud woman, and she will not submit to you just like that."
"Humph!" Huo Ling snorted. "If she dares to be arrogant in front of our husband, I will pull out her golden wings by the roots, and she will never dare to be arrogant again."
"Big Sis Ling, you are becoming so supportive of our husband now." Luo Yunxiao teased Huo Ling.
Huo Ling pursed her lips. "I used to underestimate him because he was weak, and my master always protected him. However, he has changed now, so I won’t underestimate him anymore."
"Hahaha! Your reasoning is nonsense, Big Sis Ling!" Huo Ling glared at Nalan Wangzi. "Just admit it, our husband managed to subdue you using his cock!"
"Humph!" Huo Ling snorted and turned her red face to the side.
"Hahaha," Huo Ling’s reaction made all the women laugh.

Feng Yao immediately put up a barrier as soon as Zhang Fei glanced at her, and the other women hurriedly released their souls and summoned their avatars. He pulled Luo Yunxiao onto his lap, used his demon touch on her, and removed her dress.

Soon, Zhang Fei dual cultivated and dual soul cultivated with Luo Yunxiao. He also dual soul cultivated with his other women, especially since they still needed three weeks to arrive at the Zenith Sun Sanctum.
"Why did you suddenly come here, kid?"

Zhang Fei [5] gave some Celestial Soul Ascension Pills to Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong. "Those pills will increase your soul power, even if your soul power is already high. Besides, I have one important piece of information, and you must be on full alert, Emperor Long."
"Information?"

"The Primordial Nihility Beast already knows about your existence from the four perils, and we don’t know when he will attack you, so you better be careful." Long Wuzhao frowned deeply as his fears of several years finally came true. "In fact, he also sensed the aura of the Calamity Demon Dragon, but he still doesn’t know my identity. Even if he does, I’m no longer afraid of him because I have Feng Yao and Huo Ling by my side, and the two of them are enough to beat him."

Long Wuzhao took a deep breath. "I’ve long prepared myself to face him, but I never thought he would discover my identity when we were facing a critical situation. If he attacked me and killed me, all of the beast races would suffer if those shadowy creatures appeared in my domain."

"Besides you, he also knows about my father-in-law, Senior Xukong, and Feng Jinhuang. He might also attack the three of you, but Senior Xukong is with my real body right now, and Feng Yao is with us, so he will be safe for the time being."
"Where did you get this news, son?" Tianshi Bailong asked with a grim look.

"Dong Xuanyin." Tianshi Bailong and Long Wuzhao weren’t too surprised to hear that name. "I asked her to monitor the movements of the four perils, and it turned out that beasts appeared to meet them. For now, you should tell Feng Jinhuang about this matter so he can prepare himself for the worst situation. I will leave something in this domain, and I will make a move if that beast really appears here."
"When will you return from the Ancient Realm?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "My true body is on his way to the Zenith Sun Sanctum, and we’ll arrive there in about three weeks. After that, I’ll be going to another domain, so I probably won’t be back for another few months. However, my four clones are in this realm, so I can move around whenever I want."

"Thank you for your information, and we will prepare ourselves from now on. If we really can’t fight him, we’ll contact you directly." After Zhang Fei [5] left, Long Wuzhao immediately contacted Feng Jinhuang, informing him about the Primordial Nihility Beast. "Brother Bailong, I don’t know if it can block the beast, but you can activate it now."
Tianshi Bailong nodded and disappeared from the place to carry out Long Wuzhao’s request.
Long Wuzhao leaned on his throne and thought about many things, especially about the Primordial Nihility Beast.

After leaving the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Celestial Demon Realm. He didn’t go to the palace and asked Mo Tianqi to meet him in a distant city. He asked him to deliver a Celestial Soul Ascension Pill to Mo Zainan.

Afterward, Zhang Fei [5] went to see Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, and Qi Qingxiu. He gave them some Celestial Soul Ascension Pills so they could give them to their trusted confidants. Naturally, he did not forget Dong Xuanyin, and he also gave her one pill.
Then, Zhang Fei [5] went to see Wu Mian, and he gave him two pills for him and Arbeola. Since Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze were his slaves, he gave each of them one pill.

As for the Asura Demon Race, Zhang Fei [5] only gave the pills to Shang Zhui and Shang Luohu, which surprised them. Although he didn’t have a good relationship with the demon race, the former was Tian Shuixiang’s father, and the latter was Shang Xueli’s mother, so he wanted to help them improve their soul power.
"Zhang Fei!" Sha Qingge exclaimed in surprise.
"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] pulled Sha Qingge into his embrace and kissed her, leaving her stunned for a while before returning his kiss.
Sha Qingge’s face flushed red as she enjoyed their kiss, especially when Zhang Fei [5]’s tongue slipped into her mouth. She hooked her tongue with his and took turns sucking each other.
Zhang Fei [5] pushed Sha Qingge down onto the bed, holding her hands beside her head. His kiss became fiercer and more overwhelming to the female demon, causing her breathing to become heavy.
A few minutes later, Zhang Fei [5] stopped their kiss and licked his lips, making Sha Qingge, who was already carried away by lust, tremble. "Did you enjoy our kiss, Little Princess?"
"Uhm." Sha Qingge shyly nodded. "Why did you come here today?"
"Here," Zhang Fei [5] put a pill into Sha Qingge’s mouth. "Swallow it now, and it will increase your soul power."
After Sha Qingge swallowed the pill, Zhang Fei [5] pressed his palm against her chest to help her dissolve and disperse the effects of the pill.
"Ugh! Rogue!" Sha Qingge was embarrassed because Zhang Fei [5] squeezed her breast. "Please stop it."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] pulled her to sit on the bed. "Close your eyes and concentrate! I’ll leave you now."
"Are you really going to leave?"
"Do you want me to stay?"
"Please stay."
"Alright."

"Cough! I won’t bother you two, and you two can have as much fun as you like." Sha Yuan hurriedly left her daughter’s room and closed the door.
"Did you hear that, Little Princess?" Zhang Fei [5] turned Sha Qingge over and sat her on the dressing table. "Your mother allows us to have fun, so—"
"No," Sha Qingge refused with a shake of her head. "I admit that I’ve started to like you, but I would never do anything like that until my feelings for you deepen."

"Do you realize that you look adorable? I’m just teasing you." Sha Qingge blushed, but Zhang Fei [5] suddenly lifted her chin and planted a gentle kiss. "I have some other matters, so I have to go now, and you must swallow all the remaining pills after I leave."
"Uhm." After Zhang Fei [5] disappeared, Sha Qingge jumped down from the dressing table and got dressed. She didn’t go straight to her mother but sat on the bed, swallowing all the pills in order.

After he left the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain because the leaders of the ice phoenix race had stayed there for several years to cultivate at the eastern lake.

Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow when he arrived there, finding Feng Shizhu had already broken through to the Celestial God Realm. He had long noticed that the quality and quantity of qi in the domain had been enhanced by the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus several years ago, which accelerated the cultivation of the female ice phoenixes.
"Congratulations! You’ve finally made it to this stage."

Feng Shizhu looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a smile. "Isn’t this all because of you? If you hadn’t brought us to this domain, my cultivation wouldn’t have reached this stage now, so I’m truly grateful to you."
"Unfortunately, there is danger lurking in the Paradise Realm, so we cannot relax right now."
"Dangerous?"

Zhang Fei [5] gave a Celestial Soul Ascension Pill to Feng Shizhu and explained to her about those shadowy creatures. "I will send you back to the Ice Phoenix Domain, and you must order all members of your race to watch over every area of your domain. As for the pill, it will help you increase your soul power, but I don’t know how much effect it will have on you as each person experiences different effects."
"Alright." Feng Shizhu pointed to Feng Bingying and the elders. "What about them? Will they continue cultivating in this domain?"
"For now, you don’t need to disturb them and let them cultivate here." Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate to the Ice Phoenix Domain. "You can go now and order your race members."
"Okay."
After Feng Shizhu disappeared and Zhang Fei [5] closed the gate, the two spirits of the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus, Yang Lianhua and Yin Lianhua, appeared there. "Do you guys need anything from me?"
"Did you know about the appearance of those shadowy creatures, Zhang Fei?" Yin Lianhua asked him.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "Not only did I know about their appearance, but I’ve also fought them before. Even if I used my full strength, I could only kill a few of them. The main creature possesses an incredibly high level of strength, capable of annihilating a large area with just a single small attack."

"Yes," Yang Lianhua sighed sadly. "Zhang Fei, the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus is very worried about the appearance of those shadowy creatures, and it has been restless ever since their first appearance. My sister and I are afraid that if those creatures find a way to invade this domain, they will definitely destroy the lotus. You certainly understand the risks if the lotus disappears, right?"

"Yes," Zhang Feo [5] solemnly nodded. "If the lotus disappears, then the balance of Yin and Yang in this universe will be lost, and this universe will be completely chaotic before it is destroyed. For now, I don’t have a solution to defeat those shadowy creatures, but Feng Yao said that I might be able to defeat them after I evolve to ten-tailed."
The two spirits nodded in agreement. "The ten-tailed fox is a powerful creature that controls Yin and Yang, and you are its sole heir, so only you can stop them."
"I’m looking for another way to defeat them now," Zhang Fei [5] then asked them. "What about the lotus? Do I need to replenish its power?"
"You don’t need to do that for now, and we will contact you if the lotus needs you again."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] opened another gate. "In that case, I’ll be heading back out first, as I have some matters to attend to, and either of you can contact me anytime if the lotus needs my help."
"Thank you, Zhang Fei."
"No need." Zhang Fei [5] immediately disappeared into the gate, and his next destination was the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.

In the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, Zhang Fei [5] talked with Luo Feng Han, Huang Xiaoyi, his two brothers-in-law, and his two sisters-in-law regarding the matter of those shadowy creatures. He gave them six Celestial Soul Ascension Pills for their own use, and they did not give the pills to the five ancestors who were still busy in their seclusion.

Zhang Fei [5] did not stay long in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and he went to the Emerald Bamboo Sect in the Peach Garden Domain. He distributed four pills to Li Tianyu, Lan Yueru, Hua Mei’er, and Sima Yun. He also told them about the power of those shadowy creatures, which shocked them. Like the others, he asked them to keep an eye on every area in their domain.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Sky Pillar Domain, and he met several clans there to tell them about those shadowy creatures, such as the Zhi Clan, the You Clan, the Qiao Clan, and several others. "In that case, you must talk to my father once he returns, and you must do everything possible to persuade him not to fight with Zhang Fei, Mother."
"I will do that, but I’m not sure that your father will listen to me."
"Whatever happens, and whatever it takes, you must succeed in persuading my father, Mother."

chapters.title: Chapter 1689: Sha Mo Return
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] decided to meet Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia at the Alchemy Hall. He asked them to help him concoct the Celestial Soul Ascension Pill because the need for the pill was too enormous, especially for his wives who were still in the trial tower and his children. Besides, he wanted to concoct the Heaven Tribulation Conqueror Pill, which would be useful for him to pass his future lightning tribulations.
Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia were quite shocked by the effects of the pill, but they were no longer surprised by Zhang Fei’s [5] ability to take out items with an absurd effect.

Zhang Fei [5] taught Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia the steps to properly concoct the pill because the process was a bit complicated, and his clones had failed repeatedly before they succeeded. Even though he had Lillea, Janette, and Shi Wu by his side to clone those herbs, he would rather not waste the existing herbs in vain.
After Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia understood everything, Zhang Fei [5] asked them to focus on concocting the pills until there was enough for everyone.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Heavenly Mistveil Domain to meet Feng Shanxi. To his surprise, his alchemy shop was very busy, and several people from the demihuman race learned alchemy from the female phoenix.
Zhang Fei [5] met Feng Shanxi in the alchemy room, imparted the recipe for the Celestial Soul Ascension Pill to her, and guided her in the process of concocting it.

Just like Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia, Feng Shanxi was also shocked by the effects of the pill, and she was impatient to try it herself. After all, Zhang Fei [5] never forgets those closest to him, and he would definitely give her the pill.

Just as she expected, Zhang Fei [5] told Feng Shanxi to swallow one pill after she finished concocting it. After all, alchemists needed strong soul power so they wouldn’t get tired easily when concocting pills for days. He also asked her to give the pill to Huo Fengyin and Ren Xiyi, who accompanied her in that domain.

After his business in the domain was finished, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Radiant Starfall Domain to meet Huo Lanyin. She was an alchemist god just like him, and her experience in alchemy was very high.

Huo Lanyin was speechless once Zhang Fei [5] gave her the recipe for the Celestial Soul Ascension Pill. She herself had several pill recipes that were useful for enhancing cultivators’ souls, and all the women of the Blazing Nirvana Domain used her pills to increase the strength of their souls.

Zhang Fei [5] also went to the Lotus Expanse Domain and Twilight Domain, but he didn’t spend much time there, and he immediately left after talking to Huo Yu’er and Huo Xiaoyu. His final destination was the Azure Cloud Domain, where he spoke with Huo Hao’er and Ye Jingyi, better known as Xiao Jingyi.

Zhang Fei [5] could see the impatience in Ye Jingyi’s eyes to take revenge on Tian Liefeng, who killed her parents in the past. He considered taking Ye Jingyi into the training space, but at the last moment, he decided against it because they were only acquaintances, and he was not interested in taking her as his woman.

After he spent some time in that domain, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Radiance Domain to meet Tian Yaoqin, who was one of his women. However, he did not dare to get too close to her location because he was afraid that Tian Qiye would notice his presence in their domain, and he was not ready to fight her.
Zhang Fei [5] opened the system map to confirm Tian Yaoqin’s location, and he asked her to go to one of the areas in her domain to retrieve the pill he had left there.
Not long after Zhang Fei [5] left, Tian Yaoqin arrived in the area and took the pill, and she decided to swallow it on the spot.
A week passed quickly.

Zhang Fei [5], who was spending time with Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling, suddenly received a voice transmission from Wu Zu. He immediately left the two women and went to another domain to meet the female witch.

When Zhang Fei [5] arrived there, Wu Zu handed him the antidote for the Bloodfiend Frenzy Elixir. She also gave him some Demon Soul Elixir, one of the materials for demon evolution. "I’ve been busy concocting the antidote for the past month, so I haven’t had time to concoct the elixir. After I concoct more, I’ll contact you again. But do you have the other materials?"

"I only know that I can find the Infernal Blood Core in the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain, but I don’t know the location of the other three materials." Zhang Fei [5] took out several pills, including the Celestial Soul Ascension Pill, and handed them to Wu Zu. "You will definitely like their effects."
Wu Zu received the pills, but their grades made her whole body tremble with shock and excitement. "Did you concoct them yourself? Aren’t these pills too expensive?"

"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "I could sell them for a high price, and everyone would be scrambling to buy them. However, I’m giving them to you for free in exchange for your help concocting the antidote, and you will also help me concoct the Demon Soul Elixir, so you don’t need to worry about their price. By the way, instead of you staying in this domain alone, how about you move to my sect?"
"Huh?" Wu Zu stared at him, her eyes blinking a few times. "You know—"

Zhang Fei [5] waved his hand. "You already know the situation of my sect, so you don’t need to worry about your safety. I guarantee that you will be completely safe there, and the people of my sect will welcome your presence among them. Besides, there are several alchemy gods there, and you can cooperate with them."
"Hmm?" Wu Zu thought about his offer seriously. "Alright, I will move to your sect, but I need a few days to pack all my things here."
"That’s no problem! You can contact me once you’ve finished packing, and I’ll pick you up then."

"Alright." Wu Zu nodded at him. "Among the three missing materials, the Abyssal Demon Heart is the most difficult to find. Even if you can find it, I’m sure there won’t be much of it. As for the Demon Ritual Sigil and Demon Essence Drop, I will help you look for them in the black market after I move to your sect. However, you will have to spend a lot of money to buy them in large quantities."
"Money is no problem for me, and most importantly, I can help all my demon wives to increase their demon ranks."
Wu Zu nodded in understanding. "Alright, I’ll go to the black market after I move to your sect."
"Thank you! I’ll go now."
After Zhang Fei [5] left, Wu Zu immediately sat down and swallowed all the pills one by one.
"Why did you suddenly come here, young man?"
Zhang Fei [5] smiled and asked. "Aren’t you surprised by my arrival, Senior Dugu?"

"Hahaha," Dugu Yuanshen laughed. "If I hadn’t seen your abilities in the tower, I would definitely be shocked by your appearance in my sect since you were able to break through all the protections here so easily, and I might even attack you directly. So, what brings you here today?"

"I came here to give you a pill." Zhang Fei [5] handed a Celestial Soul Ascension Pill to Dugu Yuanshen, and he explained its effects to him, causing him to take a deep breath in shock. "With your current soul level, you probably won’t break through again because I can’t break through either, but this pill will increase your soul power even more."
"Did you concoct it yourself?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "I never give my pills to outsiders for free, but I will need your help in the future regarding those creatures, so I’m giving it to you."
"You don’t need to worry about that; I will definitely help you deal with them."
"Alright, you can swallow the pill, and I’ll go to another domain."
Dugu Yuanshen let out a soft sigh after Zhang Fei [5] left. "An alchemist god, huh? My hunch about him was right, and my decision to get close to his side was the best."
Two weeks passed quickly.
Zhang Fei’s three clones had concocted many Celestial Soul Ascension Pills, and they had also successfully concocted many Heaven Tribulation Conqueror Pills.

Tian Shuixiang, Lin Jingxia, and Feng Shanxin also managed to concoct quite a lot of Celestial Soul Ascension Pills. However, their concoction results were not as numerous as Zhang Fei’s three clones, mainly due to the difference in time flow between the outside world and the training space.

Zhang Fei [5] directly handed the pills to Qing Qiu’er, and he asked her to distribute them to the elders of the Moonlit Passion Temple. Apart from the elders, he asked her to share it with several other people, such as Tian Huangjin; Shang Fengxue; the leaders of the clans; and the leaders of the Sun Moon Sect and the Hidden Moon Sect.

Of course, Zhang Fei [5] did not forget the families of all his wives and close friends, and he immediately went to them to distribute the pills. As for the disciples, he did not intend to give the pills away for free, and they had to buy them at the Alchemy Hall.
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow as he received Sha Yuan’s voice transmission. "Sha Mo is back, huh? In that case, I’ll meet him today, and I hope I can convince him without a fight."
