chapters.title: Chapter 1690: Meet Sha Mo
paragraphs: "Husband."
"Hahaha," Sha Mo laughed as he approached his wife. He hugged Sha Yuan and kissed her. "Sorry, I took so long to come home because I had some business with Ku Shenzu."
"It’s okay." Sha Yuan sighed inwardly because she couldn’t tell Sha Mo the truth that she and their two children were in Zhang Fei [5]’s hands.
"Hmm?" Sha Mo looked at Sha Qingge, who was standing beside Sha Yuan. "Eh? Are you really my little girl? How did you get this look? Your daddy almost couldn’t recognize you."
Sha Qingge pouted. "Father, you only think about my mother! As for my appearance, I took two beauty pills three weeks ago, so my appearance is this young now."

"Haish!" Sha Mo pulled Sha Qingge in front of him and held her shoulders. "Qingge, my daddy’s precious daughter! I, your dad, have told you many times not to use beauty pills anymore. You are already naturally beautiful and charming like your mother, so you don’t need to use pills to improve your appearance."
Sha Qingge shook her head slightly. "Father, you don’t need to worry about that because these two pills are different from other pills, and I will never use them again after this."
"How so? What’s different about these two pills?"
"Their effects are permanent."
"Huh?" Sha Mo was taken back. "Are you sure the effects of the two pills are permanent? Where did you get them?"
"The effects are truly permanent." Sha Qingge nodded several times before blushing. She twirled her index fingers in front of her chest, embarrassed to tell her father the truth.
Sha Mo was baffled by his daughter’s behavior, and he sensed that she had some thoughts that were difficult to express. "Tell me, who gave you the two pills? Where did you meet that person?"
"I got those pills from an alchemy god."
"Huh? An alchemy god?"

"Yes." Sha Qingge answered in a mosquito-like voice, and the blush on both her cheeks became even redder. "I met him at the Tower of Eternity, and he gave me some pills, including the two beauty pills, because he liked me."

Shock! Sha Mo did not expect that his daughter would attract the interest of an alchemy god. He looked at his wife, seeking an explanation, but Sha Yuan simply shook her head in response. "What is the alchemy god’s name?"
"He—"
"The name is Zhang Fei."
Before he came to the Heavenly Fiend Domain, Zhang Fei [5] had already contacted Sha Qingge, Sha Yuan, and Sha Huo, telling them to act according to his instructions.

Sha Mo turned around and frowned at Zhang Fei [5], who was walking leisurely. He was a demon god with peak cultivation, and the young male demon in front of him had cultivation at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but he couldn’t sense his presence before he appeared.

Sha Mo released his aura to suppress Zhang Fei [5], but it was dispelled by something inside his body, which shocked the demon god. ’How is this possible? How could he dispel my aura with his current cultivation?’
"Tch... Tch..." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "You don’t need to be so fierce, right, father-in-law?"
Sha Yuan and Sha Huo almost fell to the floor due to Zhang Fei [5]’s shamelessness. They didn’t expect that he would nonchalantly address Sha Mo as his father-in-law.

Beside them, Sha Qingge lowered her burning hot face because Zhang Fei [5] was too shameless to call her father his father-in-law at their first meeting. The sweet, alluring smile on her face couldn’t hide her happiness, and she hoped that he wouldn’t fight to the death with her father.
"A nine-tailed lust demon?" Sha Mo frowned after seeing Zhang Fei [5]’s demon form. "Hey brat! I don’t know who you are, but you—"

Sha Mo was shocked when Zhang Fei [5] suddenly disappeared, and he couldn’t see his movements at all. As a demon god, he was quite familiar with the abilities of the lust demon race, and he had never seen a lust demon that could move so quickly, let alone dispel his aura.
"Ahh!"
Sha Mo turned back and saw Sha Qingge already in Zhang Fei [5]’s embrace. "Brat! Release my daughter!"
Zhang Fei [5] ignored Sha Mo, lifted Sha Qingge’s chin, and planted a soft kiss on her lips.
Sha Huo smiled bitterly because of Zhang Fei [5]’s behavior. ’I know he has many strong cultivators by his side, but he is too fearless to do something like that in front of my father.’
Sha Yuan was also no less shocked by Zhang Fei [5]’s behavior, but a faint smile appeared on her face when her daughter hugged his neck and returned his kiss.

Sha Mo’s blood boiled, his face darkened, and all his muscles bulged out from under his skin. He wanted to attack Zhang Fei [5], but he suddenly felt several familiar, powerful auras appear behind him. He immediately looked at the owners of those auras, but his expression changed to shock. "Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, Wu Mian, Ku Shenzu, Jiu Moze, and Jiu Mozu! What are you all doing in my palace?"
"We came to help our master," Jiu Mozu and Jiu Mozu answered indifferently. Ku Shenzu simply nodded resignedly, agreeing with the two male demons.
"Haha," Wu Mian laughed. "Are you that surprised by our sudden arrival, Sha Mo?"
"Actually, I was lazy to come to this domain, but my son-in-law asked me to help him."
"Your son-in-law?" Sha Mo gasped and realized that Nalan Shizhe’s son-in-law was Zhang Fei [5].
"Your reaction was really funny, you know?" Qi Qingxiu pointed to Zhang Fei [5] and Sha Qingge. "He is my husband."
"What?" Sha Mo was shocked to hear that. "You—"
"The man over there is also my husband."

Sha Mo staggered back a little after Ye Mingran said that. He looked at Zhang Fei [5], who was still kissing his daughter, Sha Qingge. ’This demon brat! How can he do all that? Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran are his wives, and Nalan Shizhe is his mother-in-law. The craziest thing is that Ku Shenzu, Jiu Mozu, and Jiu Moze address him as their master!’
"Sha Mo, I know you’re stronger than us, but you’ll never be able to face all six of us at once."
Sha Mo frowned as he looked at Wu Mian. "What do you mean by that? Are you thinking of challenging me?"
"Ant."
Sha Mo froze when a soft hand strangled his neck from behind, causing Sha Yuan’s face to turn pale.
Sha Huo was much calmer than his mother because he knew the people had no intention of killing his father, and they only wanted to intimidate him.
"Do you think you’re that strong? If I wanted to, I could burn you to ashes before you even knew you were dead."

Sha Mo broke out in a cold sweat after hearing the threat of the woman behind him, but another woman’s voice suddenly sounded in his ears, causing him to tremble. "You must not challenge Ling’er because she will not hesitate to burn you alive."
"Empress Huo." Sha Mo called out with a trembling voice. He wasn’t afraid of any cultivator, but Feng Yao scared him half to death.
Listening to them, Sha Qingge hurriedly stopped the kiss and looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Please don’t let them kill my father."
"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled, rubbing her cheeks. "How could I possibly kill my father-in-law, Little Princess?"
"You’re the little one! I’m already a thousand years old!" Sha Qingge shouted at him, but there was no annoyance in her voice.

Zhang Fei [5] hugged her waist. "Even though you are older than me, I will never change my nickname for you, and I will always call you ’little princess’. You are my little princess, and you will accompany me in my future life."
"Humph." Sha Qingge snorted softly. "I haven’t agreed to be your wife yet."

"How could that be? You’ve already accepted my proposal gift, we’ve exchanged kisses several times, and I’ve seen you naked twice." Sha Qingge truly didn’t expect Zhang Fei [5] to speak vulgarities in front of her parents and her big brother, making her eager to find a hole to hide her face. "Hehe! You’re really cute when you blush, little princess."
’Shameless!’ Sha Mo, Sha Yuan, and Sha Huo screamed in their hearts.

"Ling’er." Huo Ling nodded to Zhang Fei [5] and pulled Sha Mo back, sitting him on his throne. "Father-in-law, I actually didn’t want to use such a method on our first meeting, and I wanted our first meeting to be warm and familial. However, the situation is different now, so I won’t waste time fighting with you just to convince you. As you have seen for yourself, six out of ten demon races are already on my side, so I want you to join us."

Sha Mo did not immediately answer Zhang Fei [5] and looked at the seven demons behind him. He still found it hard to believe he could draw them to his side, especially Ku Shenzu. He glanced at Feng Yao and Huo Ling, and he was sure that it was the two women who helped him in doing it.
Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Feng Yao, who immediately walked in front of Sha Mo and touched his chest.
"Hiss!" Sha Mo hissed, feeling a heat in his chest. He could see a phoenix symbol there after Feng Yao pulled her hand back. "What did you do to me, Empress Huo?"

Sha Mo released his aura to suppress Zhang Fei [5], but it was dispelled by something inside his body, which shocked the demon god. ’How is this possible?
How could he dispel my aura with his current cultivation?’
"Tch...
Tch..." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head.
"You don’t need to be so fierce, right, father-in-law?"
Sha Yuan and Sha Huo almost fell to the floor due to Zhang Fei [5]’s shamelessness.
They didn’t expect that he would nonchalantly address Sha Mo as his father-in-law.
Beside them, Sha Qingge lowered her burning hot face because Zhang Fei [5] was too shameless to call her father his father-in-law at their first meeting.
The sweet, alluring smile on her face couldn’t hide her happiness, and she hoped that he wouldn’t fight to the death with her father.
"A nine-tailed lust demon?" Sha Mo frowned after seeing Zhang Fei [5]’s demon form.
"Hey brat!
I don’t know who you are, but you—"
Sha Mo was shocked when Zhang Fei [5] suddenly disappeared, and he couldn’t see his movements at all.
As a demon god, he was quite familiar with the abilities of the lust demon race, and he had never seen a lust demon that could move so quickly, let alone dispel his aura.
"Ahh!"
Sha Mo turned back and saw Sha Qingge already in Zhang Fei [5]’s embrace.
"Brat!
Release my daughter!"
Zhang Fei [5] ignored Sha Mo, lifted Sha Qingge’s chin, and planted a soft kiss on her lips.
Sha Huo smiled bitterly because of Zhang Fei [5]’s behavior. ’I know he has many strong cultivators by his side, but he is too fearless to do something like that in front of my father.’
Sha Yuan was also no less shocked by Zhang Fei [5]’s behavior, but a faint smile appeared on her face when her daughter hugged his neck and returned his kiss.
Sha Mo’s blood boiled, his face darkened, and all his muscles bulged out from under his skin.
He wanted to attack Zhang Fei [5], but he suddenly felt several familiar, powerful auras appear behind him.
He immediately looked at the owners of those auras, but his expression changed to shock.
"Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, Wu Mian, Ku Shenzu, Jiu Moze, and Jiu Mozu!
What are you all doing in my palace?"
"We came to help our master," Jiu Mozu and Jiu Mozu answered indifferently.
Ku Shenzu simply nodded resignedly, agreeing with the two male demons.
"Haha," Wu Mian laughed.
"Are you that surprised by our sudden arrival, Sha Mo?"
"Actually, I was lazy to come to this domain, but my son-in-law asked me to help him."
"Your son-in-law?" Sha Mo gasped and realized that Nalan Shizhe’s son-in-law was Zhang Fei [5].
"Your reaction was really funny, you know?" Qi Qingxiu pointed to Zhang Fei [5] and Sha Qingge.
"He is my husband."
"What?" Sha Mo was shocked to hear that.
"You—"
"The man over there is also my husband."
Sha Mo staggered back a little after Ye Mingran said that.
He looked at Zhang Fei [5], who was still kissing his daughter, Sha Qingge. ’This demon brat!
How can he do all that?
Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran are his wives, and Nalan Shizhe is his mother-in-law.
The craziest thing is that Ku Shenzu, Jiu Mozu, and Jiu Moze address him as their master!’
"Sha Mo, I know you’re stronger than us, but you’ll never be able to face all six of us at once."
Sha Mo frowned as he looked at Wu Mian.
"What do you mean by that?
Are you thinking of challenging me?"
"Ant."
Sha Mo froze when a soft hand strangled his neck from behind, causing Sha Yuan’s face to turn pale.
Sha Huo was much calmer than his mother because he knew the people had no intention of killing his father, and they only wanted to intimidate him.
"Do you think you’re that strong?
If I wanted to, I could burn you to ashes before you even knew you were dead."
Sha Mo broke out in a cold sweat after hearing the threat of the woman behind him, but another woman’s voice suddenly sounded in his ears, causing him to tremble.
"You must not challenge Ling’er because she will not hesitate to burn you alive."
"Empress Huo." Sha Mo called out with a trembling voice.
He wasn’t afraid of any cultivator, but Feng Yao scared him half to death.
Listening to them, Sha Qingge hurriedly stopped the kiss and looked at Zhang Fei [5].
"Please don’t let them kill my father."
"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled, rubbing her cheeks.
"How could I possibly kill my father-in-law, Little Princess?"
"You’re the little one!
I’m already a thousand years old!" Sha Qingge shouted at him, but there was no annoyance in her voice.
Zhang Fei [5] hugged her waist.
"Even though you are older than me, I will never change my nickname for you, and I will always call you ’little princess’.
You are my little princess, and you will accompany me in my future life."
"Humph." Sha Qingge snorted softly.
"I haven’t agreed to be your wife yet."
"How could that be?

You’ve already accepted my proposal gift, we’ve exchanged kisses several times, and I’ve seen you naked twice." Sha Qingge truly didn’t expect Zhang Fei [5] to speak vulgarities in front of her parents and her big brother, making her eager to find a hole to hide her face.
"Hehe!
You’re really cute when you blush, little princess."
’Shameless!’ Sha Mo, Sha Yuan, and Sha Huo screamed in their hearts.
"Ling’er." Huo Ling nodded to Zhang Fei [5] and pulled Sha Mo back, sitting him on his throne.
"Father-in-law, I actually didn’t want to use such a method on our first meeting, and I wanted our first meeting to be warm and familial.
However, the situation is different now, so I won’t waste time fighting with you just to convince you.
As you have seen for yourself, six out of ten demon races are already on my side, so I want you to join us."
Sha Mo did not immediately answer Zhang Fei [5] and looked at the seven demons behind him.
He still found it hard to believe he could draw them to his side, especially Ku Shenzu.
He glanced at Feng Yao and Huo Ling, and he was sure that it was the two women who helped him in doing it.
Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Feng Yao, who immediately walked in front of Sha Mo and touched his chest.
"Hiss!" Sha Mo hissed, feeling a heat in his chest.
He could see a phoenix symbol there after Feng Yao pulled her hand back.
"What did you do to me, Empress Huo?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1691: Talk With Sha Mo
paragraphs: Feng Yao’s lips curled into a wicked smile. "Just say it was a precaution, Sha Mo. You’re lucky that my husband likes your daughter; otherwise, you would have become his slaves like Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu."
"What?" Sha Mo broke out in a cold sweat and glanced at Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu. "Are they really his slaves? What about Ku Shenzu?"

"Father-in-law, you don’t need to panic, okay?" Sha Mo’s lips twitched at Zhang Fei [5]’s shamelessness. "I enslaved Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu because they wanted to kill me in the past, but I have no direct grudges with Ku Shenzu, so I didn’t enslave him. As for you, Feng Yao only implanted her unique flame into your body, and she will remove it once the situation in this universe is safe."
"What do you mean by that?" Zhang Fei [5] created a qi screen, which shows his fight with Feng Yao against those shadowy creatures in the Cangxuan Domain. "Huh? What are those creatures?"

"They are shadowy creatures, and they come from the core of this universe." Sha Mo looked at Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Yao in shock. "As you can see for yourself, their strength is simply too powerful, father-in-law. We already used our full strength when we fought those creatures a while ago, but we could only kill a few of them. For now, those creatures have not appeared in this Paradise Realm, and they only appeared in the Ancient Realm. However, it is not impossible that they will appear in this realm one day, so I took some precautions to keep everything safe. If the fight continues in this realm, we will not be ready if those creatures suddenly appear here. You may not like my way of dealing with this problem, but I have no other choice but to do it."

Sha Mo was truly shocked to listen to Zhang Fei [5]’s explanations, but he was even more shocked to hear that Feng Yao couldn’t fight those shadowy creatures with her immense strength. "Are you really unable to fight those creatures, Empress Huo? What do you mean by the Ancient Realm?"

" Those creatures are truly powerful, and the two of us are powerless to face them." Sha Mo took a deep breath because he never knew there was another realm above the Paradise Realm. "The Ancient Realm is the next realm after this Paradise Realm. Since you’ve been to the Forbidden Land in the past, I can tell you that that domain is part of the Ancient Realm, including those mysterious merchants. For some reason, the Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm are separated from each other, and cultivators from this realm cannot go there, but cultivators from that realm can come here."
"Did those mysterious merchants really come from the Ancient Realm?"
"Yes."
"No wonder they’re so strong," Sha Mo muttered to himself. "Can those shadowy creatures come to this Paradise Realm?"

Feng Yao shook her head. "We don’t have an answer to that question right now, but the possibility of those creatures invading this Paradise Realm remains. For now, we don’t need unnecessary fuss, so my husband and I decided to control all demon races, especially those who haven’t yet joined our side. I want you and your fellow race members to watch over this domain twenty-four hours non-stop, and we will release you all from our control once we find a solution to get rid of those creatures."
"This-"
"Husband, I have ordered our members to monitor all areas in our domain."
Sha Mo nodded to his wife, Sha Yuan. "What do we need to do besides monitoring our domain?"

"Nothing." Sha Mo was confused by Zhang Fei’s answer. "For now, you and your clan members only need to focus on monitoring this domain, father-in-law, and you must contact me immediately if those creatures suddenly appear in this domain. If we’re careless, and they appear in large numbers, then we won’t be able to stop them. They will control the powerful cultivators in this realm, especially the beasts and demons, just like in the Ancient Realm."
"I see." Sha Mo suddenly realized something. "How did you two manage to go to the Ancient Realm? Why have I never heard of a path to that realm?"

"Haha," Feng Yao softly laughed. "Actually, the Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm are almost the same, and the cultivators’ cultivation bases in that realm are on par with those in this realm. However, the people from the Ancient Clans are stronger because they’ve existed for longer, and they possess some things that the people from this realm don’t. My husband can take you to that realm, but the situation there is out of control with the appearance of those shadowy creatures, and we need people to monitor all the domains in this realm."
"Father."
"Hmm?" Sha Mo looked at his son, Sha Huo. "What’s wrong, Huo’er?"

Sha Huo looked at Zhang Fei [5] and Sha Qingge. "Father, I never dreamed of becoming the demon god of our race, but my sister does, so I hope you’ll be willing to pass on your strength to her in the future."

Sha Mo’s face darkened after his son said that, and he looked at Sha Qingge, who lowered her head in fear. For generations, the demon god of their demon race had been male, and there had never been a single woman who held that position. In the past, he wanted to pass on his strength to his first son, but he was killed, so he thought about passing on his position to his second son in the future.

Sha Huo spoke again. "Father, my sister has not yet completely fallen in love with Zhang Fei [5], but feelings have clearly grown in her heart. I understand your wish for me to inherit your position, but I am not interested in that, and I only want to live my life freely. Besides, I am sure no one will object to her becoming the demon god of our demon race if she marries him in the future, and I believe our demon race will be even more prosperous, especially with the support of Empress Huo and the other demon gods."

Sha Mo looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a strange look. He couldn’t understand how a lust demon like him could conquer Feng Yao, Qi Qingxiu, and Ye Mingran. Moreover, Nalan Shizhe recognized him as her son-in-law, and Wu Mian seemed loyal to him.
"Father." Sha Qingge called softly.
Sha Mo sighed and looked at his daughter. "Do you like him, Qingge?"
"I do." Sha Qingge nodded slightly. "As my brother said, I haven’t completely fallen in love with him, but I already have feelings for him."
Sha Mo found it hard to believe that his daughter would have such feelings for Zhang Fei [5], but her words and expression clearly showed that she had indeed begun to fall in love with him.
Sha Yuan sent a voice transmission to her husband, making Sha Mo even more confused about the relationship between Zhang Fei [5] and Sha Qingge.

Sha Mo inhaled deeply. "Qingge, I don’t mind if you fall in love with him and want to be with him, but I won’t talk about the matter of the next demon god of our race today. For now, I want you to focus on your cultivation, and you must strive to reach the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm as soon as possible. Once you reach that stage, we will discuss this matter again."

"I’m not in a rush about that matter, father." Sha Qingge looked at her father. "Furthermore, you are still capable of leading our demon race for a long time, so we don’t need to discuss that matter today."
"Yes,"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately spoke. "Father-in-law, I will take Qingge to train in my private place, and she will be strong in several aspects when she returns. At that time, no demons from your demon race will be able to match her, including you."
"Hmm?" Sha Mo raised an eyebrow, a little annoyed. "Can you really help my daughter to surpass me, kid?"

"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "Aren’t I the proof, Father-in-law? My cultivation is far below yours, but I can do far more than you. Feng Yao, Qi Qingxiu, and Ye Mingran are also willing to become my wives."

’Tch! This shameless brat! I don’t understand how this brat managed to win their hearts! I didn’t want my daughter to fall in love with a lust demon with many wives like him, but it seems it’s too late now.’ Sha Mo was really angry about the matter. "You can take my daughter with you, and I hope she has surpassed me when she comes back. If she can do that, I won’t mind if she becomes the next demon god of our demon race."

Zhang Fei [5] smiled. "You don’t need to worry about that, father-in-law. I won’t say too much now, and you’ll see the results in the next few years. Since our business here is finished, I will send them back to their domains, and I will take my little princess with me."
"Go... take my daughter with you now, or I’ll change my mind."
Sha Qingge hugged her father, mother, and brother. "I’ll go now, and I’ll come back once I’ve become truly strong."
After Feng Yao and Huo Ling entered his body, Zhang Fei [5] sent those demon gods back to their domains. He sent Sha Qingge to his training space and left the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain.
"I’ll be going now."
Sha Yuan approached her husband, rubbing his hands. "Husband, I understand your feelings, but I’m sure our daughter will be happy with him, and she’ll be a powerful demon when she returns."
"I hope so."

chapters.title: Chapter 1692: Shang Zhanluo Wake up
paragraphs: "Shang Xueli?" Sha Qingge was stunned when she saw the Asura Demon Princess.

"Eh?" Hearing that, Shang Xueli looked at Sha Qingge. She hurriedly stopped her training, approached the Heavenly Fiend Demon Princess, and hugged her. "Eh? Long time no see, Qingge! Did Zhang Fei bring you here?"
"Ling time no see, Xueli." Sha Qingge hugged her back for a moment. "You’re right; Zhang Fei sent me her to train. Since when have you been here?"

"It’s a long story! Let’s talk somewhere else." Sha Qingge gaped as Shang Xueli led her into the pavilion. "This residence belongs to Zhang Fei, and he usually dual cultivates with all his wives here."
"Huh? How many wives does Zhang Fei actually have?" Sha Qingge asked as she looked at the surroundings.
"A little over a hundred, maybe." Sha Qingge remembered that Zhang Fei told her that he did have many women. "Does this mean you have a serious relationship with him?"

Sha Qingge shook her head. "I met Zhang Fei in the Tower of Eternity a few months ago, but our relationship is still as shallow as a small river. He said that he liked me, and I already had feelings for him, so I agreed when he offered me to train here."
"You’re lucky." Shang Xueli led her to sit on a park bench. "He saved me about six years ago, and he brought me here afterward. Since then, I’ve lived and trained here for over two decades."
"Over two decades?" Sha Qingge was shocked until her eyes widened.

"The flow of time in this place is much faster than in the outside world, so you don’t need to be surprised by that." Shang Xueli told Sha Qingge some things about the training ground and all the features there.
Sha Qingge was shocked by that because Zhang Fei had not explained anything about the training space, and he asked Shang Xueli to explain everything to her. "What do you mean by I’m lucky?"
"Sigh," Shang Xueli sighed. "At first, I had no feelings for Zhang Fei, and I was just grateful that he brought me out of hell. But—"
"You fell in love with him after you lived here for so long, right?"
"Yes," Shang Xueli nodded. "Unfortunately, he didn’t have the same feelings for me, and he always pushed me aside."
"Why? Is it because you were married to Mo Zixiao before?" Sha Qingge was confused by that because Shang Xueli was a beautiful princess.

"No," Shang Xueli replied with a light shake of the head. "Most of his wives are other people’s ex-wives, Qingge. I don’t know why he never approached me or reciprocated my feelings, but I think it’s because of my father."
"Huh? Uncle Zhanluo?"
"Zhang Fei told me that he would fight my father one day, and their fight might end in a life-and-death situation."
Sha Qingge didn’t know what to say about the matter. "He might kill your father in their fight, and you probably wouldn’t be able to accept that, so he’s unwilling to accept you."

"Yes." Shang Xueli’s expression was filled with sorrow. "I’ve lived here for over two decades, so I’m quite familiar with Zhang Fei’s abilities. My father is indeed strong, but he’s not inferior to him, and he might be able to defeat him in their upcoming battle."

Sha Qingge embraced her. "I can understand your feelings, Xueli. Previously, I was also afraid that he would fight with my father and kill him, but my fears were unnecessary because they didn’t fight in the end, and Empress Huo used something on my father to help him."
"I’ve met Empress Huo several times here, and their relationship is very close."
"Empress Huo is his wife." Shang Xueli looked at Sha Qingge in surprise. "He didn’t tell me when they became husband and wife, but she became one of his wives."
"I see." Shang Xueli felt jealous of Sha Qingge. "You—"

"Oh? I didn’t expect you two to be such close friends." Shang Xueli and Sha Qingge looked at Zhang Fei [4], who was walking towards them. "Qingge, you can start training at the training ground today, and Xueli will explain to you about the device for controlling the situation there."
"Is this one of your clones?" Sha Qingge curiously asked.
"I have five clones, and four of them stay here to concoct pills." Zhang Fei [4] looked at Shang Xueli. "Are you disappointed because I don’t reciprocate your feelings?"
"I do." Shang Xueli bit her lower lip and squeezed the hem of her top. "You know I’ve been in love with you for a long time, but you never responded to my feelings."

Zhang Fei [4] sighed. "Among all the demon gods, your father is one of the most arrogant, and he probably won’t be willing to lose to me. If our future battle turns out to be that intense, I might have no choice but to kill him."
"Don’t you have another way to defeat my father without killing him?" Shang Xueli looked up at him. "I really like you, and I want to be with you, so I don’t want to see my father die in your hands."

"Unfortunately, I don’t have a solution for that yet, Xueli." Shang Xueli’s gaze was filled with mixed feelings. "Honestly, I have liked you for a few years, but I am not sure if you can accept that I might kill your father in our future fight."
"Do... do you really like me?" Shang Xue Li’s voice trembled.
"I do."
Shang Xueli smiled. "Thank you for being willing to answer my feelings."
"No need." Zhang Fei [4] walked back to the alchemy room. "I’ll make a decision about our relationship after my battle with your father."
Tears welled up in Shang Xue’s eyes. "After more than two decades, I finally got an answer from him."

sentences.text: "Shang Xueli?" Sha Qingge was stunned when she saw the Asura Demon Princess.
"Eh?" Hearing that, Shang Xueli looked at Sha Qingge.
She hurriedly stopped her training, approached the Heavenly Fiend Demon Princess, and hugged her.
"Eh?
Long time no see, Qingge!
Did Zhang Fei bring you here?"
"Ling time no see, Xueli." Sha Qingge hugged her back for a moment.
"You’re right; Zhang Fei sent me her to train.
Since when have you been here?"
"It’s a long story!
Let’s talk somewhere else." Sha Qingge gaped as Shang Xueli led her into the pavilion.
"This residence belongs to Zhang Fei, and he usually dual cultivates with all his wives here."
"Huh?
How many wives does Zhang Fei actually have?" Sha Qingge asked as she looked at the surroundings.
"A little over a hundred, maybe." Sha Qingge remembered that Zhang Fei told her that he did have many women.
"Does this mean you have a serious relationship with him?"
Sha Qingge shook her head.
"I met Zhang Fei in the Tower of Eternity a few months ago, but our relationship is still as shallow as a small river.
He said that he liked me, and I already had feelings for him, so I agreed when he offered me to train here."
"You’re lucky." Shang Xueli led her to sit on a park bench.
"He saved me about six years ago, and he brought me here afterward.
Since then, I’ve lived and trained here for over two decades."
"Over two decades?" Sha Qingge was shocked until her eyes widened.

"The flow of time in this place is much faster than in the outside world, so you don’t need to be surprised by that." Shang Xueli told Sha Qingge some things about the training ground and all the features there.
Sha Qingge was shocked by that because Zhang Fei had not explained anything about the training space, and he asked Shang Xueli to explain everything to her.
"What do you mean by I’m lucky?"
"Sigh," Shang Xueli sighed.
"At first, I had no feelings for Zhang Fei, and I was just grateful that he brought me out of hell.
But—"
"You fell in love with him after you lived here for so long, right?"
"Yes," Shang Xueli nodded.
"Unfortunately, he didn’t have the same feelings for me, and he always pushed me aside."
"Why?
Is it because you were married to Mo Zixiao before?" Sha Qingge was confused by that because Shang Xueli was a beautiful princess.
"No," Shang Xueli replied with a light shake of the head.
"Most of his wives are other people’s ex-wives, Qingge.
I don’t know why he never approached me or reciprocated my feelings, but I think it’s because of my father."
"Huh?
Uncle Zhanluo?"
"Zhang Fei told me that he would fight my father one day, and their fight might end in a life-and-death situation."
Sha Qingge didn’t know what to say about the matter.
"He might kill your father in their fight, and you probably wouldn’t be able to accept that, so he’s unwilling to accept you."
"Yes." Shang Xueli’s expression was filled with sorrow.
"I’ve lived here for over two decades, so I’m quite familiar with Zhang Fei’s abilities.
My father is indeed strong, but he’s not inferior to him, and he might be able to defeat him in their upcoming battle."

"I can understand your feelings, Xueli.

"Empress Huo is his wife." Shang Xueli looked at Sha Qingge in surprise.
"He didn’t tell me when they became husband and wife, but she became one of his wives."
"I see." Shang Xueli felt jealous of Sha Qingge.
"You—"

chapters.title: Chapter 1693: Shang Zhanluo-Shang Luohu
paragraphs: With Shang Zhanluo’s return, the situation in the Asura Demon Race calmed down again, and those who had previously planned to rebel changed their minds because they would never win against their demon god.

Shang Zhanluo stood in front of Shang Zhui and the four asura guardians, accompanied by Shang Luohu, who faithfully accompanied him. "What happened to you, Shang Dongzhu? How did you get injured that badly?"
Shang Dongzhu scratched his head, not knowing how to answer Shang Zhanluo. "Demon God, I was injured when I went to other domains to investigate, and I met a powerful cultivator there."
"Who?"

"I don’t know the identity of that woman." Shang Dongzhu replied with a shake of his head. "I only know that that woman is strong, and her strength exceeds mine even though I have used the bloodline awakening technique."

Shang Zhanluo squinted his eyes. "The only woman in the Paradise Realm who can defeat you when you use the bloodline awakening technique is Empress Huo. However, she will never move unless you attack her domain or her subordinates."
"That woman is definitely not Empress Huo, Demon God. I have fought with her in the past, so I have some recollection of her abilities and techniques."
"I see." Shang Zhanluo nodded slightly. "The four of you can leave now, and you must recover your condition quickly, Dongzhu."
"Yes, Demon God." The four asura guardians immediately left the Asura Palace.
"Husband." Shang Zhanluo looked at his wife, Shang Luohu. "Your previous condition was Sha Mo’s doing."
"Sha Mo?"

Shang Luohu nodded. "Sha Mo did not act alone, and he was assisted by a witch demon named Wu Han. She infiltrated our palace, and she used the Bloodfiend Frenzy Elixir on you. Fortunately, someone helped me concoct the antidote; otherwise, you would never have recovered, and you would have been under their control forever."
"Sha Mo and Wu Han." Shang Zhanluo muttered with killing intent in his eyes. "Who was the person who helped you concoct the antidote?"
"A witch demon named Wu Zu."

Shang Zhanluo was slightly surprised to hear that name. "As I recall, Wu Zu separated herself from the witch demon race a long time ago, right? It wasn’t easy to find her location, let alone ask her to concoct the antidote."
"Yes," Shang Luohu nodded. "Someone helped me find Wu Zu, and he managed to persuade her to concoct the antidote."
"He?"
"His name is Zhang Fei."
"Who is Zhang Fei?" Shang Luohu explained a few things to Shang Zhanluo, which shocked him. "Empress Huo’s husband, huh?"

"That’s right." Shang Luohu hugged his arm. "Empress Huo and Zhang Fei aren’t helping us without reason, husband. There’s a serious danger threatening this universe, and those creatures might invade this Paradise Realm one day. They heard about your condition, and they decided to help me."
"What danger is that? What are those creatures you mean?"

Shang Luohu created a qi screen showing those shadowy creatures. "Empress Huo said that they were shadowy creatures, and they were truly powerful. She and Zhang Fei had already fought with them, but they couldn’t eliminate them completely. Besides, the leader of those creatures was even more powerful, and it forced them to flee."

"Even Empress Huo had to flee from their leader, huh?" Shang Zhanluo muttered in shock. Even he didn’t dare to fight Feng Yao head-on, but such a creature could force her to flee, proving that it was truly powerful. "Did you get all this information from them?"
"They told me many things, including the Ancient Realm."
"The Ancient Realm?" Shang Zhanluo was shocked once again.

"The Ancient Realm is a realm higher than this Paradise Realm, and the Forbidden Land is part of that realm." Shang Luohu retold several things to her husband. "They told me about all that, but they didn’t tell me how to get to that realm."

Shang Zhanluo took a deep breath. "Since in the past, Empress Huo has been the strongest cultivator in this Paradise Realm, and she possesses a wealth of knowledge that no other cultivator has ever known. Although she reincarnated a long time ago, I didn’t expect her current reincarnation to be as powerful as her past one. Since Zhang Fei is her husband in this lifetime, he should be as powerful as her, right?"

"Zhang Fei is indeed powerful, husband." Shang Luohu fell into thought, considering whether to tell her husband about their daughter or not. "They can access all domains because he possesses a unique ability."
"A unique ability?"
"Zhang Fei has the ability to open gates to all the domains he has ever visited, and he has already visited all the domains before the gates separated from each other."

Shang Zhanluo exhaled softly. "Although I don’t know Zhang Fei, I’m grateful that he and Empress Huo have restored my condition; otherwise, I would have been under Sha Mo’s control for the rest of my life, so I hope to meet him someday."
"Husband."
"Hmm?"
"If you’re thinking of repaying Zhang Fei, what do you think if we hand over our daughter to him?"

Shang Zhanluo frowned. "Our daughter is already married to Mo Zixiao, and we both know that her condition is very bad. We don’t even have the power to free her from the Celestial Demon Race, so how could we possibly do that?"
"What about Shang Fengxue?"
"My sister? Are you—"
"In fact, Shang Fengxue is not here, husband. She already left before all the domains separated, and she has been living in Zhang Fei’s sect since then."
"What? Did she—"
"Listen to me first, husband." Shang Zhanluo looked at Shang Luohu with a frown before nodding. "Zhang Fei’s sect is entirely different from other sects, and all races gather there."
"All races?"

Shang Luohu nodded. "The human, demon, beast, natural, and demihuman races gather in Zhang Fei’s sect. They live in harmony and peace, so Shang Fengxue is happy to live there, and she helps him train the sect’s disciples."
"Which sect? Which domain?"
"The Moonlit Passion Temple in the Twin Flames Domain."
"Isn’t that sect—"

"In the past, Moonlit Passion Temple was a dual cultivation sect, but Zhang Fei transformed it into a universal sect, and he recruited disciples from all races." Shang Luohu changed the image on the qi screen and displayed the situation in the sect. "You can see everything for yourself."
"Hmm?" Shang Zhanluo seriously looked at the qi screen. "Damn! How did Zhang Fei gather all the races in his sect?"

"Haha," Shang Luohu laughed softly. "Zhang Fei managed to conquer Empress Huo’s heart, remember? In the past, many cultivators wanted to have her as their wife, but not a single one managed to win her heart. Since he was able to do the impossible and marry her, he naturally has advantages that other cultivators didn’t have, right? Although I don’t know his advantages, he has succeeded in doing something that no one has ever managed, including Emperor Long."

"That’s right." Shang Zhanluo nodded in agreement. "In the past, Emperor Long tried to unite all races for the safety of this Paradise Realm, but everyone rejected his idea, including me. I didn’t expect that Zhang Fei succeeded in making that happen, and all races lived in harmony in his sect."
"Emperor." Shang Zhanluo looked at Shang Zhui. "In fact, Zhang Fei brought my son back to this Paradise Realm, and he lives in his sect now."
"What? Has your son really returned to this realm?"
Shang Zhui nodded at him. "My son now goes by the name Tian Shuixiang, and he’s one of the elders at the Moonlit Passion Temple. I’ve met him before, and I didn’t force him to return to our race."
"Does that mean Ye Zhiye has also returned to this realm?"
"Ye Zhiye lives in the sect with my son, and I decided to bless their relationship."
"Why did you decide like that, Zhui?" Shang Zhanluo curiously asked.
Shang Zhui let out a soft sigh. "Emperor, our enmity with the Eternal Night Demon Race is none of their business, and they love each other, so I decided this way for their happiness."
"Does your decision have anything to do with Zhang Fei?"

"More or less." Shang Zhui nodded. "Zhang Fei is not an ordinary cultivator, and he has many unique things in his possession. Besides, Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran are his wives, so I think it would be best if we don’t become enemies with him."
"What? Are you serious about that?" Shang Zhanluo was really shocked when he heard that.
"Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu are Zhang Fei’s wives, husband. In addition, Nalan Shizhe is her mother-in-law because Nalan Wangzi is his wife."
Shang Zhanluo looked at his wife in shock. "Since Empress Huo, Ye Mingran, and Qi Qingxiu are willing to become his wives, he is definitely not an ordinary cultivator."

"That’s right." Shang Luohu smiled at her husband’s shocked expression. "Besides the three of them, the Princess of the Celestial Dragon Race is also his wife, as is the granddaughter of Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu."
Shang Zhanluo took a deep breath. "Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu are grand elders of the fairy race, right?"
"Yes," Shang Luohu nodded. "In fact, Zhang Fei was the one who helped the fairy race to overthrow Jia Zizhen, and he did it because the previous fairy king wanted to get his wife, Jia Yuyan."
"How do you two know so much about Zhang Fei?" Shang Zhanluo suspiciously asked.
"We’ve met Zhang Fei several times, so we know quite a bit about him. That’s why I think our best option is to get close to him, as that will give us many advantages."
Shang Zhanluo still had doubts about that. "What else do you know about Zhang Fei?"

"Does that mean Ye Zhiye has also returned to this realm?"
"Ye Zhiye lives in the sect with my son, and I decided to bless their relationship."
"Why did you decide like that, Zhui?" Shang Zhanluo curiously asked.
Shang Zhui let out a soft sigh.
"Emperor, our enmity with the Eternal Night Demon Race is none of their business, and they love each other, so I decided this way for their happiness."
"Does your decision have anything to do with Zhang Fei?"
"More or less." Shang Zhui nodded.
"Zhang Fei is not an ordinary cultivator, and he has many unique things in his possession.
Besides, Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran are his wives, so I think it would be best if we don’t become enemies with him."
"What?
Are you serious about that?" Shang Zhanluo was really shocked when he heard that.
"Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu are Zhang Fei’s wives, husband.
In addition, Nalan Shizhe is her mother-in-law because Nalan Wangzi is his wife."
Shang Zhanluo looked at his wife in shock.
"Since Empress Huo, Ye Mingran, and Qi Qingxiu are willing to become his wives, he is definitely not an ordinary cultivator."
"That’s right." Shang Luohu smiled at her husband’s shocked expression.
"Besides the three of them, the Princess of the Celestial Dragon Race is also his wife, as is the granddaughter of Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu."
Shang Zhanluo took a deep breath.
"Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu are grand elders of the fairy race, right?"
"Yes," Shang Luohu nodded.
"In fact, Zhang Fei was the one who helped the fairy race to overthrow Jia Zizhen, and he did it because the previous fairy king wanted to get his wife, Jia Yuyan."
"How do you two know so much about Zhang Fei?" Shang Zhanluo suspiciously asked.
"We’ve met Zhang Fei several times, so we know quite a bit about him.
That’s why I think our best option is to get close to him, as that will give us many advantages."
Shang Zhanluo still had doubts about that.
"What else do you know about Zhang Fei?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1694: Zenith Solar Sanctum
paragraphs: "Zhang Fei is an alchemy god, a supreme-rank blacksmith, a ten-rank array master, and a god-rank swordmaster."
Shang Zhanluo’s eyes widened. "Are you serious about that?"

"Otherwise, Empress Huo and the others wouldn’t be willing to become his wives, right?" Shang Zhanluo agreed with Shang Luohu. "Husband, I know you love Shang Fengxue very much, but she has the right to choose her own path in life. Zhang Fei does have many wives, but I think it doesn’t matter if my sister-in-law becomes his wife."

Shang Zhanluo frowned as he considered his wife’s words about Zhang Fei. An alchemy god? A supreme-rank blacksmith? A ten-rank array master? A god-rank swordmaster? Throughout his life, he had met many people—both friends and foes—but none of them had the ability to master all areas. If his Asura Demon Race had a good relationship with him, all members of his race would benefit tremendously, and they would become the strongest demon race.
"There’s one more thing I want to tell you, but I hope you won’t get carried away by this matter, husband."
"Why? What do you mean by that?"

Shang Luohu sighed. "With Empress Huo by his side, Zhang Fei could be said to be the strongest cultivator in this Paradise Realm, even though his cultivation was still at the Celestial Emperor Realm."

"Then?" Shang Zhanluo did not argue with his wife because Feng Yao was clearly the strongest cultivator in the Paradise Realm, and she was quite brutal, like her actions when she returned to their realm the first time.

"Besides, Zhang Fei is Tianshi Bailong’s son-in-law, and he also has a good relationship with Emperor Long and all races." Shang Zhanluo breathed deep air because there had never been a cultivator who could establish such a relationship in the past. "In fact, our daughter is free, and—"
"What?" Shang Zhanluo was completely shocked. "Are you serious? Has our daughter been freed from the Celestial Demon Race? Did Zhang Fei free her?"
Shang Luohu changed the image on the qi screen, showing her husband all the time she had spent with Shang Xueli, except for their time in the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain.

"Xueli... my daughter..." Shang Zhanluo involuntarily shed tears when he saw Shang Xueli in good health, and she laughed so cheerfully with her mother. "Where is our daughter now? Is she with Zhang Fei?"
"Yes," Shang Luohu nodded. "Zhang Fei freed our daughter from the Celestial Demon Race about six years ago, and she has lived with him since then."
"What—"

"Zhang Fei didn’t treat our daughter badly, and he gave her many valuable opportunities to improve herself. You may not believe this, but her cultivation continues to improve, and she has already reached the 3-Star Celestial Emperor Realm now."
"The 3-Star Celestial Emperor Realm," Shang Zhanluo murmured. "The last time I met our daughter, her cultivation was still at the Celestial King Realm."

"Not only has her cultivation but also our daughter has also improved in many ways, including her soul power, all thanks to the opportunities Zhang Fei gave her. I had a spar with our daughter when he brought her to our domain, and I couldn’t beat her in some aspects, especially speed."
"Her speed?"

"Believe it or not, our daughter’s speed is incredibly fast, and I can’t catch up to her." Shang Zhanluo was stunned by Shang Luohu’s statement. "I don’t know how our daughter trains because Zhang Fei forbade her from telling anyone else, including me."
"It seems we owe Zhang Fei a lot," Shang Zhanluo softly said. "Can you ask him to bring our daughter here? I haven’t met our daughter in a long time, so I want to meet her and hug her."

"I can contact Zhang Fei, but I’m not sure that he will bring our daughter here for now." Shang Zhanlo was dejected because he missed Shang Xueli so much. "Husband, our daughter fell in love with him."
"Huh? Are you for real?"
"Yes," Shang Luohu touched her husband’s forehead and shared his memories of when she spoke with Shang Xueli. "Look at them first."

Shang Zhanluo closed his eyes and watched all the memories. He could see her daughter’s joy when she talked about Zhang Fei, and he could hear her confessing her feelings for him to Shang Luohu. "Does that mean our daughter has become his wife?"

"Not yet," Shang Luohu shook her head slightly. "Honestly, I don’t know Zhang Fei’s feelings for our daughter yet, but our daughter clearly loves him. However, one thing is hindering their relationship, and that problem relates to you."
Shang Zhanluo raised an eyebrow. "What do you mean by that? I’ve never even met Zhang Fei, so there shouldn’t be any problems between us, right?"

"You two may have never met, but that doesn’t mean there can’t be problems between you two, right?" Shang Zhanluo was even more confused by this. "Husband, many people know of your ambitions, including Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, and Nalan Shizhe. Two of them are Zhang Fei’s wives, and the other is his mother-in-law, remember? Do you think they won’t tell him about your plans against their three demon races? He is different from you, and he would rather not dominate other races; instead, he wants all races to coexist in peace, like in his sect. Since you have the ambition to become the strongest demon god and subdue all demon races, it’s natural that he considers you an enemy."

Shang Zhanluo let out a heavy sigh. "You’re right, I do have that ambition, but I want to do it for the future of our demon race. Mo Shentian and the Celestial Demon Race are the strongest, and he has oppressed us for years, so I want to destroy him. However, our race will still never be at peace with the other demon gods harboring the same ambitions, such as Sha Mo, Ku Shenzu, Jiu Mozu, and Qian Yan. Therefore, I must become stronger than them, and I must subdue them to realize my dream."
"Unfortunately, you’re too late for that, husband."
"You mean?"
"Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran are Zhang Fei’s wives, and Nalan Shizhe is his mother-in-law. Besides, he has a close relationship with Wu Mian, and Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu are his slaves."
"Huh?" Shang Zhanluo was shocked again. "Are you serious about that, wife?"

"One hundred percent serious," Shang Luohu nodded. "Sooner or later, Zhang Fei will also make a move against Ku Shenzu and Sha Mo, and I believe it won’t be difficult for him to subdue them with the help of Empress Huo and the others. If he really subdues them, only three demon races will remain."
"Our Asura Demon Race, the Celestial Demon Race, and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race."

Shang Luohu nodded again. "Zhang Fei doesn’t want to fight Mo Shentian yet because his abilities are different from yours or the others’. He also doesn’t want to fight Qian Yan yet for some reason, and you should already know that, since you yourself don’t dare face him."

"Qian Yan has always been underestimated, but I know he is actually the strongest among all demon gods. He is a demon beast, and his physical strength is extraordinary. Besides, he has the ability of his middle eye, and it is terrifying." Shang Luohu agreed with her husband. "If everything you say is true, it means that the five demon races are already on Zhang Fei’s side, and he will have the support of the other two if he attacks Ku Shenzu and Sha Mo. If he succeeds in subduing them, then I’m sure his next target will be me."

Shang Luohu sighed. "Husband, I can’t guess Zhang Fei’s plans for our demon race, but I believe that we should not be his enemies. Besides, our daughter has already fallen in love with him, so I don’t want us to be enemies with him for the sake of her happiness."
"Phew," Shang Zhanluo exhaled softly. "If our daughter really falls in love with Zhang Fei, I am willing to give in for her happiness."
"Really?"
"Really." Shang Zhanluo nodded seriously. "However, I hope he is willing to hand over Sha Mo to me, especially after what he did to me."
Shang Luohu was silent for a moment. "I’ll try to contact Zhang Fei and ask him to meet us, and the two of us will talk to him at that time."
"That’s good."
Shang Luohu glanced at Shang Zhui, who nodded at him and disappeared straight away. "What if we try to have another child, husband?"
"Oh?" Shang Zhanluo hugged her waist. "Are you sure you want to try again? We’ve been trying for so long, but you never got pregnant again after our daughter was born."
"Let’s try again."
"Alright."
*Swoosh*
After a month of travel, Long Xukong led Zhang Fei and the others out of the void, but they arrived in a devastated, empty domain.
"Is this really the location of the Zenith Solar Sanctum? Why don’t I see anything here?" Yue Ningxue asked while looking at the area around them.

"This domain was truly the location of the Zenith Solar Sanctum, but a past disaster had destroyed it. In fact, the Endless Night Dungeon was also in this domain, and both disappeared at the same time." Feng Yao led them north. "Even though both have disappeared, there are two portals in this domain that will connect us to both places."
Soon, they arrived at the northernmost part of the domain, and they landed there.
"How are we supposed to find the portal to enter that place, Big Sis Yao?" Luo Yunxiao asked.
"Wait." Feng Yao stretched her hand forward and shot her qi. Soon, a golden yellow portal appeared in front of them. "Let’s go in."
