chapters.title: Chapter 1695: The Spirit Of The Sun Flame
paragraphs: Unlike the Endless Night Dungeon, the Zenith Solar Sanctum was much brighter and less gloomy, but many ruins from past buildings remained.
"Did you enter this place from the Ancient Realm, Zhang Fei?" Tian Taiyang’s gaze filled with longing after seeing his clan’s residence.
Zhang Fei nodded. "I left the Puyang Clan a month ago and only arrived today. So, where is the location of the Sun Flame?"
"Over there," Tian Taiyang pointed towards the floating platform in the north. "The Sun Flame should be there, but it seemed to have moved to another area, and I couldn’t detect it."
Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao. "Were you able to detect the location of the Sun Flame?"
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "I don’t know why Ying Tai did that, but he moved the Sun Flame to the bottom floor of the old Sun Palace."
"Ying Tai? Is he the spirit of the Sun Flame?"

"Just like Yin Ling is the spirit of the Moon Flame, Ying Tai is the spirit of the Sun Flame. However, I don’t think we need to rush to that place, and we can check other areas first because those shadowy creatures have not invaded this place." Feng Yao looked at the other women. "You guys can explore all the areas in this place if you like, and one of the best places is the library."
"Where is the library located, Big Sister Yao?"

"There." Tian Taiyang pointed towards the east. "If you fly in that direction, you will find a building covered by a special barrier. I’m sure the place is still intact, even though it has been abandoned for a long time."
Luo Yunxiao and the others remembered when they visited the library in the Endless Night Dungeon in the past; it was still intact even though other areas were completely destroyed.

Tian Taiyang pointed to the southeast. "If you go to that area, you’ll find a weapons and artifacts warehouse. All of you can choose a weapon or artifact that suits you, and they will be useful to you."
"Which other areas are useful for us, Senior?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.
"If you go west, you will find an underground pond. Since it’s underground, I’m sure it’s still intact, and you can soak there if you want."
"Underground pond? Is that useful for us?" Helian Xun’er asked in confusion. "Moreover, this place has been abandoned for so long, so the water in the pond should be dry, right?"

"Hahaha," Tian Taiyang laughed. "Young lady, my clan’s underground pond is not an ordinary one, and the water in the pond comes from underground, so it will never dry. Even though this place has been abandoned for so long, I am sure that the water in the pond is still full and clean. You guys should go there to soak in the pond, and I’m sure you will like the benefits."
Nalan Wangzi looked at Zhang Fei. "Why don’t you bring Yue Qianrou, Shang Xueli, and Sha Qingge over?"
"Wait." Zhang Fei opened a portal to the training space, asking Yue Qianrou, Shang Xueli, and Sha Qingge to come out from inside.
"Eh? Where is this place?" Sha Qingge asked.
Yue Qianrou tried to sense the qi there. "The quality and quantity here are much better than in the Paradise Realm, husband."
"Does this mean we’re in the Ancient Realm, Zhang Fei?" Shang Xueli asked.

Zhang Fei nodded at them. "This place is the Zenith Solar Sanctum, where the Sun Clan lived in the past. There are many valuable items here, and there is also a natural pond to the west. Senior Taiyang said that the pond has special benefits, so I brought the three of you here."
"Aren’t you going to bring my big sister here, husband?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei softly laughed. "My fifth clone is picking up some people in our domain and some other domain."
"I see." Yue Qianrou nodded in understanding.

Soon, several women in the Twin Flames Domain, such as Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Yue Xuelian, Tian Huangjin, Tian Zhiling, Xian Xian, Yan Yinqing, Jing Qiuyue, Lin Jingxia, and several other women, came out of the training space.
Not long after, Qi Qingxue, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, Tian Yaoqin, and Dong Xuanyin also walked out of it.
"Hmm? The Zenith Solar Sanctum, huh?" Qi Qingxiu immediately recognized the place.
"Hehe," Ye Mingran giggled. "The only area I miss about this place is the west underground pond; the underground water has many benefits for our bodies."

"I’ve been here twice, and I feel that only the underground pond is the most useful for us." Nalan Shizhe looked east. "The library has many techniques, but none of them are suitable for demons like us."
"We don’t need to think about those techniques, and we should head to the underground pond now." Dong Xuanyin flew into the area, followed by the three female demon gods.
Zhang Fei looked at Tian Yaoqin. "Have you never entered this place in the past?"
"I was too focused on my cultivation in the past, so I’ve never entered this place," Tian Yaoqin replied with a wry smile. "Are you going to explore other areas?"

"I will explore all the areas, but I’ll do that later. My main goal in going to this place is to find the Sun Flame, and it’s in the Sun Palace, so I’ll go there now." Zhang Fei looked at all the other women. "If you guys haven’t explored this place in the past, you can do so now, and you can go underground afterward. There are no shadowy creatures here, so you guys can spend time here freely."
"Let’s go! We start from the library in the east first!" Almost all the women went to the east area, and a few of them stayed beside Zhang Fei.

Yue Ningxue felt that the Sun Clan wouldn’t have a technique suitable for her, especially since she was an ice element possessor. Just like her, Tianshi Shengjie wasn’t confident that she could find a good technique there because she was a dragon, so she chose not to go to the library.
Luo Yunxiao felt that her own technique was enough for her, so she had no intention of looking for a new technique, and she preferred to accompany Zhang Fei in searching for the Sun Flame.

Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou did not go to the library either, and they decided to follow Zhang Fei to the Sun Palace. Tian Yaoqin also decided to stay because she was of a winged race and her techniques were suitable for her.

Since Nalan Shizhe and the others said that the techniques of the Sun Clan were not suitable for demons like them, Nalan Wangzi did not want to waste time going to the library, and she followed her mother to the underground pond, together with Shang Xueli and Sha Qingge.
"Let’s go to the Sun Palace now."

With Zhang Fei’s movement technique, they arrived at the Sun Palace in the blink of an eye. Since Feng Yao had said that the Sun Flame was on the bottom floor of the palace, Tian Taiyang immediately led them there.

Unlike the Moon Palace in the Endless Night Dungeon, the Sun Palace was completely destroyed. Tian Taiyang could only sigh as he looked at the ruins of the palace, which had been destroyed by the Moon Clan in the past.
Within a few minutes, they had arrived at the bottom floor, where they saw the Sun Flame hovering at the end of the place.

Zhang Fei walked towards the Sun Flame, but a flame immediately shot towards him. Since he had some heavenly flames and he also mastered the fire elemental law, he could easily block the attack. "Ying Tai, I came here to see you, and I know you are hiding in the flames, so please come out now."

Since Ying Tai did not respond to Zhang Fei, the Spirit of Earth Flame, Huo Diqiu came out of his master’s body. "Brother Ying! I am Huo Diqiu, the Spirit of Earth Flame. Please come out and speak to me."
Ying Tai didn’t respond to Huo Diqiu, and another flame attacked Zhang Fei again, but it was repelled by him once again.
"Take Yin Ling out of your soul world, husband." Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao and took Yin Ling out of his soul world.
"Eh? The Sun Flame?" Yin Ling was slightly surprised. "Brother Ying Tai, aren’t you going out to meet your sister? We haven’t seen each other for a long time, remember?"
*Swoosh*
A flame shot out from the Sun Flame, and it quickly transformed into a young man, who was none other than Ying Tai. "Yin Ling, why are you with them?"
"Hehehe," Yin Ling laughed as she darted towards Ying Tai, hugging him. "I missed you, Brother Ying."
Ying Tai’s expression turned soft and hugged Yin Ling back. "I’ve missed you all this time too, Ling’er. Unfortunately, I don’t have a master, so I can’t leave this place to meet you."
"I know that." Yin Ling released her embrace from Ying Tai and cupped his face. "You haven’t changed since the last time we met, Brother Ying."

Ying Tai rubbed her head. "We are the spirits of the Sun Flame and the Moon Flame, and our appearance remains the same as when we were born. You haven’t answered my question before, why are you with them?"
"Have you forgotten about me, Ying Tai?"
"Hmm?" Ying Tai looked at Tian Taiyang. "Oh! Old Taiyang! I didn’t expect to see you again after so much time has passed!"
"Hahaha," Tian Taiyang laughed. "The souls of your master and the others are no longer here, right?"
Ying Tai nodded. "They entered the circle of reincarnation a long time ago, so I’m left here alone. Why did you bring these people here, Old Taiyang?"

sentences.text: Unlike the Endless Night Dungeon, the Zenith Solar Sanctum was much brighter and less gloomy, but many ruins from past buildings remained.
"Did you enter this place from the Ancient Realm, Zhang Fei?" Tian Taiyang’s gaze filled with longing after seeing his clan’s residence.
Zhang Fei nodded.
"I left the Puyang Clan a month ago and only arrived today.
So, where is the location of the Sun Flame?"
"Over there," Tian Taiyang pointed towards the floating platform in the north.
"The Sun Flame should be there, but it seemed to have moved to another area, and I couldn’t detect it."
Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao.
"Were you able to detect the location of the Sun Flame?"
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled.
"I don’t know why Ying Tai did that, but he moved the Sun Flame to the bottom floor of the old Sun Palace."
"Ying Tai?
Is he the spirit of the Sun Flame?"
"Just like Yin Ling is the spirit of the Moon Flame, Ying Tai is the spirit of the Sun Flame.
However, I don’t think we need to rush to that place, and we can check other areas first because those shadowy creatures have not invaded this place." Feng Yao looked at the other women.
"You guys can explore all the areas in this place if you like, and one of the best places is the library."
"Where is the library located, Big Sister Yao?"
"There." Tian Taiyang pointed towards the east.
"If you fly in that direction, you will find a building covered by a special barrier.
I’m sure the place is still intact, even though it has been abandoned for a long time."
Luo Yunxiao and the others remembered when they visited the library in the Endless Night Dungeon in the past; it was still intact even though other areas were completely destroyed.
Tian Taiyang pointed to the southeast.
"If you go to that area, you’ll find a weapons and artifacts warehouse.
All of you can choose a weapon or artifact that suits you, and they will be useful to you."
"Which other areas are useful for us, Senior?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.
"If you go west, you will find an underground pond.
Since it’s underground, I’m sure it’s still intact, and you can soak there if you want."
"Underground pond?
Is that useful for us?" Helian Xun’er asked in confusion.
"Moreover, this place has been abandoned for so long, so the water in the pond should be dry, right?"
"Hahaha," Tian Taiyang laughed.
"Young lady, my clan’s underground pond is not an ordinary one, and the water in the pond comes from underground, so it will never dry.
Even though this place has been abandoned for so long, I am sure that the water in the pond is still full and clean.
You guys should go there to soak in the pond, and I’m sure you will like the benefits."
Nalan Wangzi looked at Zhang Fei.
"Why don’t you bring Yue Qianrou, Shang Xueli, and Sha Qingge over?"
"Wait." Zhang Fei opened a portal to the training space, asking Yue Qianrou, Shang Xueli, and Sha Qingge to come out from inside.
"Eh?
Where is this place?" Sha Qingge asked.
Yue Qianrou tried to sense the qi there.
"The quality and quantity here are much better than in the Paradise Realm, husband."
"Does this mean we’re in the Ancient Realm, Zhang Fei?" Shang Xueli asked.
Zhang Fei nodded at them.
"This place is the Zenith Solar Sanctum, where the Sun Clan lived in the past.
There are many valuable items here, and there is also a natural pond to the west.
Senior Taiyang said that the pond has special benefits, so I brought the three of you here."
"Aren’t you going to bring my big sister here, husband?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei softly laughed.
"My fifth clone is picking up some people in our domain and some other domain."
"I see." Yue Qianrou nodded in understanding.

Soon, several women in the Twin Flames Domain, such as Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Yue Xuelian, Tian Huangjin, Tian Zhiling, Xian Xian, Yan Yinqing, Jing Qiuyue, Lin Jingxia, and several other women, came out of the training space.
Not long after, Qi Qingxue, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, Tian Yaoqin, and Dong Xuanyin also walked out of it.
"Hmm?
The Zenith Solar Sanctum, huh?" Qi Qingxiu immediately recognized the place.
"Hehe," Ye Mingran giggled.
"The only area I miss about this place is the west underground pond; the underground water has many benefits for our bodies."
"I’ve been here twice, and I feel that only the underground pond is the most useful for us." Nalan Shizhe looked east.
"The library has many techniques, but none of them are suitable for demons like us."
"We don’t need to think about those techniques, and we should head to the underground pond now." Dong Xuanyin flew into the area, followed by the three female demon gods.
Zhang Fei looked at Tian Yaoqin.
"Have you never entered this place in the past?"
"I was too focused on my cultivation in the past, so I’ve never entered this place," Tian Yaoqin replied with a wry smile.
"Are you going to explore other areas?"
"I will explore all the areas, but I’ll do that later.
My main goal in going to this place is to find the Sun Flame, and it’s in the Sun Palace, so I’ll go there now." Zhang Fei looked at all the other women.
"If you guys haven’t explored this place in the past, you can do so now, and you can go underground afterward.
There are no shadowy creatures here, so you guys can spend time here freely."
"Let’s go!
We start from the library in the east first!" Almost all the women went to the east area, and a few of them stayed beside Zhang Fei.
Yue Ningxue felt that the Sun Clan wouldn’t have a technique suitable for her, especially since she was an ice element possessor.
Just like her, Tianshi Shengjie wasn’t confident that she could find a good technique there because she was a dragon, so she chose not to go to the library.
Luo Yunxiao felt that her own technique was enough for her, so she had no intention of looking for a new technique, and she preferred to accompany Zhang Fei in searching for the Sun Flame.
Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou did not go to the library either, and they decided to follow Zhang Fei to the Sun Palace.
Tian Yaoqin also decided to stay because she was of a winged race and her techniques were suitable for her.

Since Nalan Shizhe and the others said that the techniques of the Sun Clan were not suitable for demons like them, Nalan Wangzi did not want to waste time going to the library, and she followed her mother to the underground pond, together with Shang Xueli and Sha Qingge.
"Let’s go to the Sun Palace now."
With Zhang Fei’s movement technique, they arrived at the Sun Palace in the blink of an eye.
Since Feng Yao had said that the Sun Flame was on the bottom floor of the palace, Tian Taiyang immediately led them there.
Unlike the Moon Palace in the Endless Night Dungeon, the Sun Palace was completely destroyed.
Tian Taiyang could only sigh as he looked at the ruins of the palace, which had been destroyed by the Moon Clan in the past.
Within a few minutes, they had arrived at the bottom floor, where they saw the Sun Flame hovering at the end of the place.
Zhang Fei walked towards the Sun Flame, but a flame immediately shot towards him.
Since he had some heavenly flames and he also mastered the fire elemental law, he could easily block the attack.
"Ying Tai, I came here to see you, and I know you are hiding in the flames, so please come out now."
Since Ying Tai did not respond to Zhang Fei, the Spirit of Earth Flame, Huo Diqiu came out of his master’s body.
"Brother Ying!
I am Huo Diqiu, the Spirit of Earth Flame.
Please come out and speak to me."
Ying Tai didn’t respond to Huo Diqiu, and another flame attacked Zhang Fei again, but it was repelled by him once again.
"Take Yin Ling out of your soul world, husband." Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao and took Yin Ling out of his soul world.
"Eh?
The Sun Flame?" Yin Ling was slightly surprised.
"Brother Ying Tai, aren’t you going out to meet your sister?
We haven’t seen each other for a long time, remember?"
*Swoosh*
A flame shot out from the Sun Flame, and it quickly transformed into a young man, who was none other than Ying Tai.
"Yin Ling, why are you with them?"
"Hehehe," Yin Ling laughed as she darted towards Ying Tai, hugging him.
"I missed you, Brother Ying."
Ying Tai’s expression turned soft and hugged Yin Ling back.
"I’ve missed you all this time too, Ling’er.
Unfortunately, I don’t have a master, so I can’t leave this place to meet you."
"I know that." Yin Ling released her embrace from Ying Tai and cupped his face.
"You haven’t changed since the last time we met, Brother Ying."
Ying Tai rubbed her head.
"We are the spirits of the Sun Flame and the Moon Flame, and our appearance remains the same as when we were born.
You haven’t answered my question before, why are you with them?"
"Have you forgotten about me, Ying Tai?"
"Hmm?" Ying Tai looked at Tian Taiyang.
"Oh!
Old Taiyang!
I didn’t expect to see you again after so much time has passed!"
"Hahaha," Tian Taiyang laughed.
"The souls of your master and the others are no longer here, right?"
Ying Tai nodded.
"They entered the circle of reincarnation a long time ago, so I’m left here alone.
Why did you bring these people here, Old Taiyang?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1696: Ying Tai’s Approval
paragraphs: "They—"
*Swoosh*
*Smack*
"That fucking hurts!" Ying Tai screamed loudly as he held his head. "Who—"
"You little brat!" Ying Tai stiffened upon hearing the voice, and he cautiously looked at Huo Ling. "What? Aren’t you happy to see me?"
"Big... Big Sis Ling!" Ying Tai called out stammeringly, moving behind Ying Ling. "Why... why did you suddenly come to this place?"
"You’re still afraid of Ling’er like in the past, Little Ying."
Ying Tai looked at Feng Yao. "Don’t tell me that you are Big Sis Guang Zhiyi."
"Heh." Feng Yao grinned. "Do you think anyone else can get Huo Ling?"
"Big Sis Guang!" Ying Tai wanted to fly towards Feng Yao, but Huo Ling grabbed his collar. "Big... Big Sis Ling, please let me go."
"Get back." Huo Ling pulled Ying Tai back. "I haven’t taught you a lesson yet because you dared to attack my husband."
Ying Tai looked at Huo Ling in shock. "H-husband? Are... are you really married?"
"Him." Huo Ling pointed her index finger at Zhang Fei. "My master and I are his wives."
"Are you kidding me?" Ying Tai shouted in shock.
"Ling’er didn’t lie to you." Feng Yao hugged Zhang Fei’s arm. "He is our husbands, and all the women behind us are also his wives."

Ying Tai looked at Luo Yunxiao and the others; he realized that several of them were powerful female cultivators. However, he was confused by their decision to choose Zhang Fei as their husband, especially Feng Yao and Huo Ling’s.
*Smack*
"Ouch!" Ying Tai glared at Huo Ling. "Why did you smack my head again?"

"I know what you think of our husband, so I smacked your head." Ying Tai pursed her lips. "Our husband’s cultivation is still at the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, but he has already defeated other cultivators with cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm several times, so you should not underestimate him."
Ying Tai rubbed his head. "Since when did you become talkative like this? In the past, you only said a few words, and you were mostly silent."
"Humph! I’m too lazy to talk to you!" Huo Ling returned to Zhang Fei’s body.
"So, what brings you here today, Big Sis Guang?"
"The Sun Flame." Ying Tai raised an eyebrow slightly. "Husband, show him your heavenly flames."
Ying Tai was truly shocked when Zhang Fei summoned his eight heavenly flames. "I didn’t expect your husband to have already obtained eight of the ten heavenly flames, Big Sis Guang."
"Hehehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "Do you think the man I chose to be my husband is an ordinary man?"
"No," Ying Tai shook his head. "If you choose him as your husband, he must have many advantages that no other man has."
Feng Yao smiled. "Little Ying, I want you to follow my husband."
"Big Sis Guang, you know—"

"It’s okay, Ying." Ying Tai looked at Tian Taiyang. "My Sun Clan was destroyed long ago, and your master has already entered the cycle of reincarnation. This universe is in danger, and Zhang Fei has given me a path to revival, so I want you to acknowledge him as your new master."
"But—"

Tian Taiyang shook his head. "When I reshape my body in the future, I will rebuild my Sun Clan. However, my new clan will no longer be the same as in the past, so you don’t need to think about that. The most important thing is that Zhang Fei needs the power to save this universe from danger, so your help will be very useful for him."
"Danger? What do you mean by that, Old Taiyang?"

"Let me show you." Feng Yao created a screen showing the shadowy creatures. "They are strong, Little Ying. I used my full strength when I faced them earlier, but I could only kill a few of them, and the main creature was much stronger."
"Where did they come from, Big Sis Guang?"

"The core of this universe." Ying Tai’s face turned solemn after Feng Yao said that. "Currently, they have already invaded almost every domain in the Ancient Realm, and I fear they will also invade every domain in the Paradise Realm in the future. Our only hope of defeating them is my husband, so I hope you are willing to follow him."
Ying Tai looked at Zhang Fei with a serious gaze. "What exactly is so special about him? Why did you choose him to be your husband?"
"My husband is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir."
"Are you serious? Is he really Hu Tianlang’s sole heir?"
"Do you think I would joke about this kind of thing?"
"No," Ying Tai thought for a moment before he grabbed Zhang Fei’s shoulder and brought him into the Sun Flame. "Alright! I agree with you, and he will be my next master."
Yin Ling was overjoyed with Ying Tai’s decision, and they could be together again like in the past. Unlike her, Huo Diqiu pursed his lips because the male spirit ignored him.
Yin Lin rubbed Huo Diqiue’s head. "Don’t think too much about it, okay? Brother Ying is like that, and he rarely talks to people he just met."
"Sigh." Huo Diqiu nodded. "How long will the process take? Back then, it took my master about two months to obtain my Earth Flame, so I think the process will take longer this time."
"Hehe," Yin Ling laughed softly. "Unlike you, Brother Ying doesn’t like to play around, and the process will be over in a few hours."
"I’ll go to that place first, Empress Huo." Feng Yao nodded to Tian Taiyang, who immediately disappeared from her sight.
"Where is he going, Big Sis Yao?"

"The Sun Clan Mausoleum." Feng Yao sighed. "His ancestors were buried there, but his clan members who died at the same time as him did not have graves. If you guys want to visit other areas, you can go now, and I will wait for our husband here."
"Are there any other interesting places here besides the library, the treasury, and the underground pond?"
"There’s nothing left in this place besides those three."
Tianshi Shengjie pulled Luo Yunxiao along with her. "Let’s go to the treasury, and we might get some good items there."
Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou followed behind the two women, but Yue Ningxue and Tian Yaoqin chose to wait there.
"What actually happened to this place? Why did all the residents die?" Yue Ningxue asked.

"It all started with a catastrophe that occurred in the past, and the situation was worsened by Yin Yue’s actions, which caused both clans to be completely destroyed." Feng Yao explained everything to Yue Ningxue and Tian Yaoqin, which shocked both women. "The Sun Clan will rise again in the future, especially after Tian Taiyang reforms his body. The Moon Clan will also rise again, but the clan will no longer be the same as in the past because its leader is a woman."
Tian Yaoqin nodded her head. "For descendants, they will use the father’s surname, so the Moon Clan will no longer use the Yin surname in the future."

"That’s right," Feng Yao agreed with her. "That’s why I said the Moon Clan will no longer be the same, and the clan members will use another surname for their future descendants unless Yin Yue meets a husband who is willing to use her surname."
"Hasn’t Yin Yue been living with Zhang Fei for a long time?"
Feng Yao nodded. "However, they haven’t shown any interest in each other, and Zhang Fei isn’t necessarily willing for his children to use their mother’s surname."
"Sister Guang." Feng Yao looked at Yin Ling. "Can you help my master?"
"What kind of help?"
"Help my master with Zhang Fei."
"No," Feng Yao refused with a shake of her head. "I’m not a matchmaker, so I won’t interfere in their relationship. If Yin Yue likes Zhang Fei, she should act on her own to become his woman."

Yin Ling put on a disappointed look. "In my opinion, there is no other man suitable for my master apart from Zhang Fei, so I want them to be together. If they have children in the future, their children will definitely be stronger than ordinary children."

"Haha," Feng Yao laughed softly. "If you want them to be together, you’ll have to persuade your master yourself. Her Moon Clan demon bloodline is not an ordinary demon, and Zhang Fei is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir, so their child will definitely be different from other children."
"Do you really not want to help them get together?"
"No."
Yin Ling sighed and said nothing more. ’What should I do to persuade my master?’

Meanwhile, Qi Qingxiu and the other female demon arrived at the underground pond. They could see that the water inside was clear, even though the room above was in ruins. They immediately took off their dresses and entered the pond to soak.
"Eh?" Sha Qingge was surprised when she entered the pond. "What exactly is in this pond, Senior?"
Shang Xueli was also surprised by this. She scooped up the water and washed her face. "The water in this pond is different from normal water."
"You two can try to see the bottom of this pond." Dong Xuanyin said.
Shang Xueli and Sha Qingge dipped their heads into the water to examine the bottom, where they found many materials, most of which were glowing red.
Sha Qingge pulled her head out of the water. "What materials are at the bottom of the pond?"

"We don’t have any information about those materials, and we can’t take them either. However, we do know that the minerals that make up the water in this pond are different, and you will feel the difference in your body after you soak in here for a while."

chapters.title: Chapter 1697: The Sun Clan’s Ancestor
paragraphs: "Ahh!" Sha Qingge screamed as Qi Qingxiu pulled her forward, and both his hands immediately squeezed her plump breasts. "Ahh! Please don’t do this, Demon God Qingxiu."

"Haha," Qi Qingxiu laughed softly. "Why are you still calling me by my title, Little Qingge? You’ll be his wife soon, so we’re sisters from the same husband. From now on, you have to call me Big Sister Qingxiu, and you can call Ye Mingran Big Sis Mingran."
"Qingxiu is right, Little Qingge. We are indeed older and more senior than you, but you will be our sister soon, so you should change the way you address us," Ye Mingran said softly.
Sha Qingge blushed as she lowered her embarrassed face. "Big Sis Qingxiu and Big Sis Mingran."
"Hehe." Qi Qingxiu moved Sha Qingge to her side and wrapped her right hand around her shoulder. "Has he not done anything to you?"
Sha Qingge shook her head slightly. "He kissed me and saw me naked, but he didn’t do anything else to me because I wasn’t completely ready to be his wife."
"What makes you still not ready to be his wife, Little Qingge?"
Sha Qingge looked at Nalan Shizhe. "Demon God Shizhe, I—"
"Drop my title and call me aunt."
Sha Qingge felt awkward. "Aunt Shizhe, I like him, and I’m grateful to him for some of his help, but my feelings for him aren’t deep enough, so I’m not ready to be his wife yet."
"What makes you like him?" Ye Mingran curiously asked.

Sha Qingge was stunned, as she herself didn’t know how she could like Zhang Fei. Their first meeting was in the forest, and her opinion of him wasn’t good at that time, mainly because he used his techniques to control her. Their second meeting occurred when he visited her domain, during which he kissed her for the first time; however, she also resented him for using his technique on her mother. Their third meeting was some time later, and he gave her several techniques and many valuable pills, including the two beauty pills.

"To be honest, I don’t know what makes me like him, Big Sis Mingran. He treated me badly in the forest; he kissed me forcefully, and he also treated my mother like that. But for some reason this feeling suddenly appeared in my heart, and I realized that I had started to like him." Sha Qingge pressed her palm to her chest. "Every time I think about him, my heart beats fast, and I always look forward to his presence beside me."

"Haha," Qi Qingxiu laughed at that. "You are such an innocent little girl, do you know that? He may have treated you badly in that forest, but he also treated you well on several occasions, including giving you several valuable things, and you unknowingly fell in love with him."
"Perhaps you’re right, Big Sis Qingxiu." Then, Sha Qingge asked her, "Are you two happy being his wives?"

"I do," Qi Qingxiu nodded. "At first, my relationship with him wasn’t good, and he used his abilities on me, which made me unable to fight him. However, I started to change after becoming his wife, and I’ve been enjoying my life as a wife ever since."
"What about you, Big Sis Mingran? Did he use his abilities on you too?"

Ye Mingran answered her directly. "He didn’t use his abilities on me, and I took the first initiative to kiss him. Perhaps I was too lonely because I had lived alone for too long, and I gave myself to him at that time. Although I initially felt strange about our relationship, I slowly started to get used to everything, especially after we spent time in seclusion together."
"Oh." Sha Qingge nodded in understanding. "Do your two children agree with your relationship with him?"

"Why would they disagree?" Ye Mingran asked back with a smile. "In fact, they’ve been asking me to find a new husband for a long time, and they know his abilities and prowess, so they have no problem with our relationship. Little Qingge, you should prepare yourself and your feelings as soon as possible, and I believe you will enjoy your life with him, just like me and Qingxiu."
"Uhm." Sha Qingge nodded slightly. "I will prepare myself and my feelings first."
Shang Xueli was a little jealous that Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran cared so much about Sha Qingge, but they didn’t care that much about her, and they never asked her about her feelings.
Unlike Sha Qingge, Zhang Fei didn’t have any thoughts towards Shang Xueli yet, so Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran put on an indifferent attitude in front of her.

Meanwhile, Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, and several other women arrived at the eastern area, the location of the Sun Clan’s library. Upon arrival, they found the library building completely intact, and the protective barrier had disappeared.
"It seems Senior Taiyang already deactivated the barrier before we arrived here, Big Sis," You Feiling said.

Qing Qiu’er nodded in agreement. "Our sect doesn’t have many techniques, especially common ones. However, our husband said that we can’t take all the techniques here, and he wants to leave them all for the future Sun Clan. That’s why he asked us to copy them, and the people in our sect can study them later."
"I think that’s inappropriate, right? After all, all the techniques in this library belong to the Sun Clan, so we can’t copy them for our purposes," Tian Huangjin said.
Qing Qiu’er looked at her. "You’re not wrong about that, Huangjin. However, you should know that my husband wouldn’t do that if he didn’t get permission from Senior Taiyang."
"So, Senior Taiyang has allowed Zhang Fei to copy everything?"

"Yes," Qing Qiu’er answered with a light nod. "If it weren’t for my husband, Senior Taiyang would be trapped in the abyss of the Endless Night Dungeon. To repay his favor, he allowed us to copy everything so our people could study them according to their needs."

"Since Senior Taiyang has given permission for it, we should go in now to copy all the techniques, and we will choose later." Yan Yinqing pulled Jing Qiuyue into the library, followed by Qing Qiu’er and all the other women.

"Damn! This library looks small from the outside, but the inside is so spacious, and it has three floors!" Tian Zhiling exclaimed as soon as they arrived inside. "So, how are we going to copy everything? If we do that, it’ll take us several days to finish everything."
Lin Jingxia went to a nearby bookshelf. "In that case, we don’t need to waste any more time, and we should split into groups so we can copy everything faster."

"I’ll contact my husband and ask him to send more people here, so we won’t waste too much time copying all these techniques." Qing Qiu’er immediately contacted Zhang Fei and conveyed her ideas, and she began to copy the techniques with others.
Not long after, dozens of men and women arrived at the place, and they immediately joined Qing Qiu’er and the others.
Luo Yunxiao, Tianshi Shengji, Yue Xuelian, and Yue Qianrou arrived at the southeastern area, where the weapons and artifacts warehouse was located.
When they arrived, the barrier surrounding the area had disappeared, so they immediately entered to investigate.
"Holy! The Sun Clan was filthy rich in the past!" Yue Qianrou exclaimed after seeing so much equipment and artifacts in that place.
Tianshi Shengjie nodded in agreement. "My dragon race is one of the richest in the Paradise Realm, but we cannot compare to the Sun Clan."
"Hehe," Luo Yunxiao giggled. "After all, the Sun Clan is one of the Ancient Clans, and they have existed much longer than us, so it’s natural that they are much richer than us, right?"

Yue Xuelian walked towards an artifact. "Although the Sun Clan is very rich, we must not be greedy, and we cannot take everything for ourselves. We should only take the equipment or artifacts that are suitable for us, and we will leave the rest for the future generations of the clan."
"That’s true." Luo Yunxiao walked in another direction. "Since the others are busy in the library and the pond, we can freely choose any equipment or artifacts here."

Thereafter, the four women immediately checked all the equipment and artifacts available at that place. Since there were so many of them, they had to search through them one by one to find the right one.

Meanwhile, Tian Taiyang had arrived at the mausoleum and stood in front of the three large tombs. "Ancestors, Taiyang returns to pay his respects to the three of you. Our Sun Clan was destroyed long ago, and all our members have entered the cycle of reincarnation, but I still exist now. Although I cannot reshape my body yet, I will definitely do so in the future, and I will revive our clan."
*Swoosh*
Tian Taiyang was shocked when a woman’s soul emerged from the tomb, but he immediately prostrated himself on the ground to pay his respects. "Ancestor Tian Shuying."
"Get up," Tian Taiyang didn’t listen to the woman and stared at her. "You are still as stubborn as in the past, Little Taiyang."
"Why is your soul still here, Ancestor Shuying? Why didn’t you enter the circle of reincarnation like the others?"

Tian Shuying let out a soft sigh. "How can I enter the circle of reincarnation with our clan’s situation like this? Even though everything passed a long time ago, I still regret the destruction of our clan. Unlike you, I no longer have the chance to reshape my body, and I am relying solely on the remaining strength of my soul to keep my soul from disappearing. I can feel that your soul is already so strong, and you should be able to reshape your body soon, so I have to rely on you to revive our clan."

chapters.title: Chapter 1698: Tian Shuying - Feng Yao
paragraphs: Tian Taiyang smiled. "All of this is thanks to Zhang Fei, Ancestor. If he hadn’t saved and helped me recover my soul, it would have disappeared forever."
"Zhang Fei? Who is he?"
Tian Taiyang created a qi screen, showing two people on it. "The man is Zhang Fei, and he is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir."
"Huh?" Tian Shuying was completely shocked. "Is this young man really Hu Tianlang’s sole heir? Where did you meet him?"

"I met him in the Moon Clan several years ago, and he has been helping me recover my soul ever since." Tian Shuying’s expression changed slightly as soon as Tian Taiyang mentioned the Moon Clan. Someone from that clan caused the downfall and destruction of their Sun Clan, and she harbored resentment towards them. "After that person killed all our clan members, I went to the Moon Clan to settle accounts. I fought with Yin Yue for many years, which resulted in both of our deaths. To prevent further destruction, Guang Zhiyi imprisoned my soul in the abyss and hers in the palace."

"Guang Zhiyi." Tian Shuying didn’t have a good impression of that name because she could have saved their Sun Clan from destruction at that time, but she chose to remain silent and let someone from the Moon Clan slaughter all her clansmen.

At that time, Tian Shuying wanted to move to save the Sun Clan from disaster, but she couldn’t do it because her soul was too weak to act, and she was afraid that she would die in that person’s hands.
"Then, who is the woman beside Zhang Fei? Why are you showing her to me?"
"Her current name is Feng Yao, and she is one of Zhang Fei’s wives." Tian Shuying looked at them with a straight face. "She is the reincarnation of Guang Zhiyi."
Tian Shuying’s expression turned shocked after Tian Taiyang said that. "What did you just say? Is that woman really the reincarnation of Guang Zhiyi?"
"Feng Yao is truly the reincarnation of Guang Zhiyi, Ancestor."

Even though so many years had passed since she last met Guang Zhiyi, Tian Shuying still remembered the woman’s character, and she remembered for sure that she had no passion for love. Yet, Tian Taiyang said that the woman had been married to Zhang Fei in this lifetime, which was truly unbelievable.
"Did Guang Zhiyi decide to marry Zhang Fei because he was Hu Tianlang’s sole heir?"

Tian Taiyang shook his head. "Honestly, I don’t know much about their relationship, Ancestor. From what I’ve heard, she met Zhang Fei when he was just starting his cultivation path in the lower realm, but I don’t know the details, and she returned to the Paradise Realm several years earlier."
"How old is Zhang Fei? What level is his cultivation at?"
"Zhang Fei is still under a hundred years old, but his cultivation has already reached the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm."

Tian Shuying took a deep breath as she continued to look at Zhang Fei’s image on the qi screen. "Hu Tianlang’s sole heir is truly extraordinary! He was born in the lower realm, but he managed to reach the Celestial Emperor Realm in less than a hundred years. When I was alive, the only cultivator who could do such a thing was Guang Zhiyi."
"However, Zhang Fei is different from Guang Zhiyi, and he is a dual cultivator with more than a hundred wives by his side, Ancestor."

Tian Shuying nodded slightly. "Dual cultivation paves a way for cultivators to improve their cultivation faster, but I’ve never met a dual cultivator who could reach the Celestial Emperor Realm in less than a hundred years, let alone Zhang Fei, who started from the bottom in the lower realm. Even cultivators who began their journey in this realm wouldn’t be able to reach that level with that little time, let alone a cultivator from the lower realm."
"He—"

"Hahaha." Tian Shuying and Tian Taiyang looked at Feng Yao, who had just arrived. "I thought all your clan members had entered the circle of reincarnation, but it turns out your soul is still here, Little Shuying."
"Do you know that my hatred for you runs deep, Guang Zhiyi?" Tian Shuying asked in a vicious tone, and her eyes were also filled with hatred.

"I know that." Feng Yao nodded at her. "However, you must remember that, as the guardian of the ancient realm at that time, I could not interfere in matters between clans. I couldn’t stop the destruction of your clan or the other clans at that time, so I decided to imprison Tian Taiyang’s soul in the abyss because I knew that someone would free him, and he would become the cornerstone of your Sun Clan’s revival."
"What do you mean by that?" Tian Shuying and Tian Taiyang were both confused by Feng Yao’s words.

"Hu Tianlang." Tian Shuying and Tian Taiyang raised their eyebrows. "No one knew that Hu Tianlang could see into the future, and at that time, he foresaw the future of your clan. He came to me and told me everything, so I imprisoned the souls of your descendant and Yin Yue’s for the sake of the revival of both clans. As he said back then, my husband managed to free their souls, and he also helped them strengthen their souls so they could reshape their bodies in the future."
Tian Shuying nodded in understanding. "So, everything was arranged by Hu Tianlang, huh?"
"You’re wrong about that," Feng Yao denied her guess. "Hu Tianlang has the ability to see the future, but he wasn’t the one who arranged everything."
"Then, who arranged everything?"
"The one who arranges everything is one of the hidden forces in this universe, and people call it Fate."
"Fate?" Tian Shuying and Tian Taiyang were shocked. "What—"

"I can’t say anything about hidden forces," Feng Yao stopped them. "Anyways, your soul power is too weak, and you can’t possibly reshape your body with your current state, but that doesn’t mean there’s no way to bring you back to life."
Tian Shuying’s eyes and soul trembled as soon as Feng Yao said that. ’Alive again? Do I still have a chance to live again?’
"Is there still a chance for my Ancestor to come back to life, Senior Feng?" Tian Taiyang asked with a glimmer of hope in his eyes.

"When you met my husband, your soul was already too weak, and you would have disappeared completely in a few years, but my husband managed to restore your soul power." Tian Taiyang smiled bitterly listening to Feng Yao’s words. "If you want to come back to life to rebuild your clan, I can ask my husband to help you, so the decision is yours."
"Where’s your husband now? Why didn’t you bring him here?"
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "We came here to retrieve the Sun Flame, and my husband is in the process of merging with it."
Tian Shuying frowned at that, but she realized that the Sun Flame was no longer of any use to her clan since everyone was long dead. "Can I really come back to life?"

"Your soul is so weak, but it’s still intact. My husband only needs to strengthen your soul, and you can reshape your body after a few decades," Feng Yao said confidently because she knew Zhang Fei very well. "So, what’s your decision? Do you want to live again? Or do you want to enter the cycle of reincarnation? If you want to live again, I will take you to my husband. If you want to be reincarnated, I will send you there, and you will be born as a new individual."

Tian Shuying looked at several other areas before returning her gaze to Tian Taiyang in thought. She looked at Feng Yao and made a decision. "Please help me come back to life, Guang Zhiyi. Little Taiyang can’t possibly rebuild our Sun Clan by himself, so I will help him."
"Alright." Feng Yao enveloped them with her aura and brought them back to the bottom floor of the Sun Palace.
"Eh?" Yue Ningxue and Tian Yaoqin were surprised by Tian Shuying’s presence. "Who is this woman, Empress Huo?"
Tian Shuying looked at Feng Yao. "Empress Huo? Is that your identity now, Guang Zhiyi?"

"Empress Huo Yanling is my identity after Guang Zhiyi, and my current identity is Feng Yao." Feng Yao’s answer gave Yue Ningxue and Tian Yaoqin a headache because she had too many identities. "This woman is Tian Shuying, and she is one of the ancestors of the Sun Clan."
Yue Ningxue and Tian Yaoqin were surprised again, not expecting that the soul of one of the ancestors of the Sun Clan still existed.
Tian Shuying looked at Yue Ningxue and Tian Yaoqin. "A human and a winged race, huh? Are they also the wives of your husband, Guang Zhiyi?"
"Tian Yaoqin comes from the winged race, and she is one of my husband’s wives. Yue Ningxue is a human, and she will become his wife soon."

"Hahaha," Tian Shuying laughed mockingly. "When you were still living as Guang Zhiyi, you chased away every man who tried to approach you, so I didn’t expect you to be willing to share a husband with so many women in this lifetime."

Feng Yao simply smiled at that. "In my lifetime as Guang Zhiyi or Huo Yanling, there wasn’t a single man worthy of standing beside me, let alone becoming my husband. In this lifetime, the only man worthy of being by my side is Zhang Fei, so I’ve decided to accept him as my husband."
"Is it because Zhang Fei is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir?"
"Do you think being Hu Tianlang’s sole heir means that much?"
"Then?"
"I won’t say much, but I can tell you that Zhang Fei far surpasses Hu Tianlang."

I couldn’t stop the destruction of your clan or the other clans at that time, so I decided to imprison Tian Taiyang’s soul in the abyss because I knew that someone would free him, and he would become the cornerstone of your Sun Clan’s revival."
"What do you mean by that?" Tian Shuying and Tian Taiyang were both confused by Feng Yao’s words.
"Hu Tianlang." Tian Shuying and Tian Taiyang raised their eyebrows.
"No one knew that Hu Tianlang could see into the future, and at that time, he foresaw the future of your clan.
He came to me and told me everything, so I imprisoned the souls of your descendant and Yin Yue’s for the sake of the revival of both clans.
As he said back then, my husband managed to free their souls, and he also helped them strengthen their souls so they could reshape their bodies in the future."
Tian Shuying nodded in understanding.
"So, everything was arranged by Hu Tianlang, huh?"
"You’re wrong about that," Feng Yao denied her guess.
"Hu Tianlang has the ability to see the future, but he wasn’t the one who arranged everything."
"Then, who arranged everything?"
"The one who arranges everything is one of the hidden forces in this universe, and people call it Fate."
"Fate?" Tian Shuying and Tian Taiyang were shocked.
"What—"
"I can’t say anything about hidden forces," Feng Yao stopped them.
"Anyways, your soul power is too weak, and you can’t possibly reshape your body with your current state, but that doesn’t mean there’s no way to bring you back to life."
Tian Shuying’s eyes and soul trembled as soon as Feng Yao said that. ’Alive again?
Do I still have a chance to live again?’
"Is there still a chance for my Ancestor to come back to life, Senior Feng?" Tian Taiyang asked with a glimmer of hope in his eyes.

"When you met my husband, your soul was already too weak, and you would have disappeared completely in a few years, but my husband managed to restore your soul power." Tian Taiyang smiled bitterly listening to Feng Yao’s words.
"If you want to come back to life to rebuild your clan, I can ask my husband to help you, so the decision is yours."
"Where’s your husband now?
Why didn’t you bring him here?"
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled.
"We came here to retrieve the Sun Flame, and my husband is in the process of merging with it."
Tian Shuying frowned at that, but she realized that the Sun Flame was no longer of any use to her clan since everyone was long dead.
"Can I really come back to life?"
"Your soul is so weak, but it’s still intact.
My husband only needs to strengthen your soul, and you can reshape your body after a few decades," Feng Yao said confidently because she knew Zhang Fei very well.
"So, what’s your decision?
Do you want to live again?
Or do you want to enter the cycle of reincarnation?
If you want to live again, I will take you to my husband.
If you want to be reincarnated, I will send you there, and you will be born as a new individual."
Tian Shuying looked at several other areas before returning her gaze to Tian Taiyang in thought.
She looked at Feng Yao and made a decision.
"Please help me come back to life, Guang Zhiyi.
Little Taiyang can’t possibly rebuild our Sun Clan by himself, so I will help him."
"Alright." Feng Yao enveloped them with her aura and brought them back to the bottom floor of the Sun Palace.
"Eh?" Yue Ningxue and Tian Yaoqin were surprised by Tian Shuying’s presence.
"Who is this woman, Empress Huo?"
Tian Shuying looked at Feng Yao.
"Empress Huo?
Is that your identity now, Guang Zhiyi?"
"Empress Huo Yanling is my identity after Guang Zhiyi, and my current identity is Feng Yao." Feng Yao’s answer gave Yue Ningxue and Tian Yaoqin a headache because she had too many identities.
"This woman is Tian Shuying, and she is one of the ancestors of the Sun Clan."
Yue Ningxue and Tian Yaoqin were surprised again, not expecting that the soul of one of the ancestors of the Sun Clan still existed.
Tian Shuying looked at Yue Ningxue and Tian Yaoqin.
"A human and a winged race, huh?
Are they also the wives of your husband, Guang Zhiyi?"
"Tian Yaoqin comes from the winged race, and she is one of my husband’s wives.
Yue Ningxue is a human, and she will become his wife soon."
"Hahaha," Tian Shuying laughed mockingly.
"When you were still living as Guang Zhiyi, you chased away every man who tried to approach you, so I didn’t expect you to be willing to share a husband with so many women in this lifetime."
Feng Yao simply smiled at that.
"In my lifetime as Guang Zhiyi or Huo Yanling, there wasn’t a single man worthy of standing beside me, let alone becoming my husband.
In this lifetime, the only man worthy of being by my side is Zhang Fei, so I’ve decided to accept him as my husband."
"Is it because Zhang Fei is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir?"
"Do you think being Hu Tianlang’s sole heir means that much?"
"Then?"
"I won’t say much, but I can tell you that Zhang Fei far surpasses Hu Tianlang."

chapters.title: Chapter 1699: Ten Heavenly Flames
paragraphs: In their royal chamber, Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu lay naked side by side on the bed. "Have you managed to contact Zhang Fei, Wife?"
"I’ve spoken to him, but he won’t be able to bring our daughter here anytime soon."
"Why?" Shang Zhanluo asked with a frown.

"Be patient, okay?" Shang Luohu hugged her husband’s arm in a coquettish manner, entirely different from her usual appearance. "He took our daughter to another domain, but he didn’t tell me which domain. He wanted her to cultivate there for the time being, and he would bring her to us after they returned from there."
"Another domain, huh? Is there a special domain in this Paradise Realm?"
"Hehe," Shang Luohu giggled. "Naturally, he did not take our daughter to another domain in this Paradise Realm, but he took her to one of the domains in the Ancient Realm."
Shang Zhanluo just remembered that Zhang Fei had a way to go to the Ancient Realm. "Why is he willing to help our daughter to that extent? Does he have a hidden purpose for doing so?"
"I don’t know for sure, but I have my own opinion about his goal."
"What’s his goal?"
"Perhaps he wants our daughter to replace your position and become the new demon god of our Asura Demon Race."

Shang Luohu looked at his wife thoughtfully. In fact, he had no problem with his daughter becoming the next demon god of his Asura Demon Race, but that wasn’t simple to achieve because some members of his race had ambitions to replace him, such as Shang Dongzhu and several others. "Do you think Zhang Fei really wants our daughter to replace me?"

"For now, this matter is still just my guess, and we have to meet with him first to confirm his plans." Shang Luohu looked up at him. "Do you think there will be a big riot if our daughter takes your place in the future?"

"That’s for sure." Shang Zhanluo replied with a serious expression. "Apart from Shang Dongzhu and Shang Beixuan, some of my family members also have ambitions to replace me. They haven’t made any moves yet, but they will make their move once I hand over my power and position to our daughter. At that time, our demon race will face great chaos, and the number of casualties will be numerous."

"That’s true." Shang Luohu nodded in agreement. "Honestly, I am tired of being the Empress, and I want to rest to live a quiet life with you. At that time, we can play with our grandchildren, and our life will become more colorful without having to think about the affairs of our demon race."

"Hahaha." Shang Zhanluo pulled his wife to lie on top of him. "Actually, I never thought about retiring before all these changes, but it looks like I should start considering it. If Zhang Fei truly wants our daughter to become the next demon god of our Asura Demon Race, I might consider it as long as he is willing to support her from behind. Although I haven’t seen our daughter for a long time, I’m still familiar with her character, and she will never be able to lead our demon race with her timid character, so she needs a powerful supporter."

Shang Luohu smiled at the thought. "If he is willing to support our daughter to ascend the throne, I’m sure that Empress Huo and the others will also lend their support to her, and no member of our race will be able to go against them."

"Let’s wait for him to come to us first, and we’ll talk to him then." Shang Zhanluo flipped his wife over and pinned her beneath him. "Since you want to have another child, we have to work hard for it."
Shang Luohu smiled as she embraced her husband’s neck. "In that case, we’ll go into seclusion, and we won’t get out until I’m pregnant."
"Alright." Quickly, the royal chamber was filled with Shang Luohu’s moans.
Inside the Sun Flame, Zhang Fei felt incredible heat, even though he had the fire element and eight heavenly flames. His clothes had long since turned into ash, and his skin was completely red.
"The heat of the Sun Flame is incredibly hot, Ying Tai."

"The Sun Flame is different from the other flames, and it is actually the third strongest after the Chaos Flame and the Primordial Flame. If you didn’t have the Primordial Flame, I wouldn’t dare bring you here because your body will suffer serious injuries from the heat." Zhang Fei agreed with Ying Tai. "Do you know the advantages of each heavenly flame?"
"What do you mean?"
"The Phoenix Flame is synonymous with death and resurrection, and the Dragon Flame is synonymous with destruction."
Zhang Fei was not surprised about the Dragon Flame, but he was confused by Ying Tai’s words about the Phoenix Flame. "Resurrection? Are you saying I can resurrect the dead using the Phoenix Flame?"
"You cannot use the Phoenix Flame to resurrect the dead, and the phoenix can do so because it possesses the Phoenix Nirvana."
"Then?"

Ying Tai sighed and explained. "You can use the Phoenix Flame to temporarily resurrect the dead, but the duration is short, so you can use it to find the information you need when you’re in an unfamiliar place."
"Is something like that really possible?"
"You can try it later."
Zhang Fei nodded. "Then, what about the Blood Flame and the Soul Flame?"

"You can use the Soul Flame to burn the souls of all living creatures, and they will disappear forever." Zhang Fei had obtained the Soul Flame a long time ago, but he had never used it for anything like that. "As for the Blood Flame, you should be able to guess its use, right?"
"I guess?"
Ying Tai continued. "All living creatures have blood in their bodies, and the Blood Flame can burn their blood, which will slowly kill them."
"Killing living creatures by burning their blood, huh? Isn’t that no different from torturing them before their death?"
"That’s right." Ying Tai nodded. "The Soul Flame and the Blood Flame are two evil flames among the ten heavenly flames, so you shouldn’t be surprised by their effects."
"I see." Zhang Fei pondered this seriously, as he almost never used his eight heavenly flames to kill his enemies. "What about the Sky Flame and the Earth Flame?"

"Although you can use the Sky Flame and the Earth Flame to kill your enemies, they don’t have the killing property." Zhang Fei was confused by Ying Tai’s answer. "You’re an alchemist and a blacksmith, right?"
"I’m a god-rank alchemist and a supreme-rank blacksmith." Zhang Fei nodded.

"A god-rank alchemist and a supreme-rank blacksmith, huh?" Ying Tai mumbled. "When you’re practicing alchemy, you can try using the Sky Flame to concoct your pills, and you’ll understand its benefits then. When you forge equipment, you can use the Earth Flame to do so, and all the equipment you forge will have much better durability."
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh. "I’m such an ignorant person! I never knew that each heavenly flame had its own function, and I’ve always only used them for fighting."
"Haha," Ying Tai laughed. "Didn’t Guang Zhiyi explain everything to you?"

"No," Zhang Fei shook his head. "Feng Yao helped and guided me a lot, but there were many things she didn’t explain to me, and she wanted me to understand things on my own step by step. What is the difference between the Moon Flame and the Sun Flame?"

"The Sun Flame is a flame that can melt everything, even the hardest materials, which the other flames cannot do. As for the Moon Flame, it can freeze everything, and living creatures caught in it will die slowly."
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "Can the Moon Flame really freeze everything?"

"Another name for the Moon Flame is the Freezing Flame, and it has Yin properties." Ying Tai felt that Zhang Fei was too ignorant to oppose the ten heavenly flames. "If a living being is trapped within the Moon Flame, their body will freeze from the outside, and they will burn to death from the inside."
"What about the Primordial Flame and the Chaos Flame?"
"The Primordial Flame is the flame that cannot be extinguished, and it has several advantages that other flames have."
*Swoosh*
*Smack*
"Ouch!" Ying Tai screamed as soon as Huo Ling smacked his head. "Big Sis Ling, why are you always treating me rudely?"

"Do you want to protest?" Ying Tai covered his mouth when Huo Ling narrowed her eyes. "Humph! Husband, the Primordial Flame has almost the same effect as some other heavenly flames, so you don’t need to use the other flames to do alchemy or blacksmithing."
"Is it true?"
Huo Ling nodded. "You are my husband; I will never lie to you, and the Primordial Flame is a special flame second only to the Chaos Flame."

’Hahaha! I didn’t expect that an arrogant woman like Big Sis Ling would act like an infatuated woman in front of her husband!’ Ying Tai laughed in his heart as he looked at Zhang Fei. ’You’re really great, brother-in-law! You managed to tame a wild woman like her, and she seems very obedient to you.’
Zhang Fei pulled Huo Ling over and kissed her, making her body turn soft. "Ling’er, you’re so different from before, you know? At that time, you—"
"Don’t say anything." Huo Ling covered Zhang Fei’s mouth with his hand. "Forget everything that happened in the past, and we just need to look to the future."
Zhang Fei pulled her hands away from his mouth. "So, what about the Chaos Flame?"

Ying Tai and Huo Ling’s expressions turned serious as soon as Zhang Fei asked about the Chaos Flame. "That flame is the most terrifying of the ten heavenly flames, and it’s protected by a powerful guardian."

chapters.title: Chapter 1700: Chaos Flame - Chaos Beast
paragraphs: "A powerful guardian? Is that guardian a beast?"
Ying Tai and Huo Ling nodded at Zhang Fei.

"The beast is no random beast, and its power is truly formidable, husband. Even my master should think twice about fighting the beast because it possesses such terrifying abilities, and none of the heavenly flames can harm it."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei rubbed his chin. "The Chaos Flame, huh? Could it be the Chaos Beast?"
Ying Tai and Huo Ling froze, looking at Zhang Fei in shock.
"So, my guess is correct, huh? The beast guarding the Chaos Flame is the Chaos Beast."
"How did you guess that the beast was the Chaos Beast?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "In my home realm, there are many novels about cultivators and the like, and I read a lot of them in the past."
"What are novels?"

"Novels are fictional stories written by residents of my realm." After Zhang Fei made that statement, Ying Tai and Huo Ling exchanged puzzled glances. "In some stories, the universe is described as being created by Chaos, and the Chaos Beasts are the children of Chaos. Since the last heavenly flame is the Chaos Flame, I guess its guardian is a Chaos Beast."
Ying Tai shook his head slightly. "I don’t understand how mortals in your home realm can think like that, but the guardian of the Chaos Flame is indeed the Chaos Beast."
"Do you have any memories of the Chaos Beast, Ling’er?"
Huo Ling nodded slightly and created a screen, showing the appearance of the Chaos Beast and the Chaos Flame.
Zhang Fei’s expression turned serious as he looked at the image of the Chaos Beast on the qi screen.

The Chaos Beast possessed a colossal physique forged from Chaos, its body towering like a mountain range beneath the heavens. Black scales covered its monstrous body, each scale engraved with ancient runes. Its flesh seemed neither completely solid nor ethereal, constantly twisting like the instability of reality itself. Its crimson eyes glowed in the darkness, carrying both ferocity and indifference. Endless black mist coiled around its body like living serpents, obscuring its true form.

There were two jagged horns spiraling toward the sky like broken heavenly pillars above its head. Its claws were massive enough to tear through mountains. A pair of enormous wings stretched across the heavens, blotting out the sunlight and shrouding the area in darkness. Its tail resembled a giant black dragon forged from darkness, capable of leveling an entire area with a single strike. Its limbs were thick as giant trees, and its fangs resembled ancient divine swords, each filled with a destructive intent. The pressure radiating from its body alone caused any cultivators to kneel as their souls trembled uncontrollably.

"The Chaos Beast truly lives up to its name!" Zhang Fei exclaimed. "Back then, in the era of the beginning, I didn’t see any images of the Chaos Beasts, and I only saw images of the two primordial beasts there."

"Husband, the Chaos Beast and this universe are one, so its image will not appear in the era of the beginning." Zhang Fei looked at Huo Ling. "All the living beings that appeared in that place were those who were born after this universe was formed, and the Chaos Beast was born along with this universe."
"The Chaos Beast lives near the universe core, right?"
"That’s right," Huo Ling answered him with a nod. "Ever since this universe was created, the Chaos Beast has never left that place, and it faithfully protects the Chaos Flame."
Zhang Fei thought for a while before asking again. "Who spread the news about the ten heavenly flames in this universe? Is that person Feng Yao?"
"Shen Yuanzhi was the first to spread the news about the ten heavenly flames, and all her reincarnations also spread the news, except my current master."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "If Feng Yao didn’t spread the news about the ten heavenly flames, how could the people in the Three Mortal Realms have information about them?"
"Actually, my master is also confused regarding that matter, and she suspects that it has something to do with those hidden forces, such as the Fate."
"Fate, huh?" Zhang Fei mumbled. "The lightning tribulations are also the work of those hidden forces, right?"

"The heavens control the lightning tribulations, and you must already understand why they want to kill you." Zhang Fei just smiled when Huo Ling mentioned his lightning tribulations. "They haven’t sent down your lightning tribulations since you broke through to the Five Celestial Realms, and they’re likely waiting until your cultivation breaks through to the Celestial God Realm before attacking you again. If that’s true, you will face lightning tribulations that no living creature has ever faced, and the realm you broke through will surely be completely destroyed by then."

Zhang Fei patted Huo Ling’s head. "Don’t worry, okay? Those lightning tribulations are powerful, but the heavens will never be able to kill me. I’m still weak now, but I’ll become stronger in the future, and I’ll break through to the Exalt Supreme Realm. At that time, I’ll challenge those hidden forces, especially the heavens, and I’ll destroy them."

"Hahaha! Master, you can’t possibly defeat them, let alone destroy them. They—Ouch." Ying Tai rubbed his head and looked at Huo Ling. His neck shrank, seeing her deathly glare. ’Tch! This brute big sister!’

Huo Ling looked at Zhang Fei with a serious look; she stretched out her hand and rubbed his cheek. "Are you serious about destroying those hidden forces, husband? I’ve watched you for a long time, and I’m satisfied with your development as a cultivator. However, they are on a different level from all the enemies you have faced so far, and they have immense power. Even my master doesn’t dare to fight them because she knows their strength, and she knows that she cannot defeat them."
"Have you ever heard me say nonsense?"
"No."

"See?" Zhang Fei sighed softly. "I understand your concerns, but I won’t challenge them before I’m ready. For now, I don’t want to think about them, and I will focus fully on reaching the pinnacle of the cultivation world. When I have enough strength, I will challenge them, starting with the heavens, who have repeatedly tried to kill me."

Huo Ling could only sigh at Zhang Fei’s stubbornness. "Since you want to fight them in the future, I, as your wife, will help you fight them at that time. After you obtain the Sun Flame, you should reduce all your outside activities and focus on pursuing your cultivation in seclusion. I will accompany you to the location of the Chaos Flame once your cultivation reaches the Three God Realm."
"The Three God Realms? Doesn’t that mean I have to go to the Primordial Realm to reach that level?"

"Yes." Huo Ling nodded. "You won’t be able to reach the Three God Realms in the Ancient Realm, let alone the Paradise Realm. Other people don’t know the way to the Primordial Realm, but my master is the embodiment of the core of this universe, and she knows the safest route to go there. Once your cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm, my master will take you to that realm, where you can continue to cultivate and strive to reach the Exalt Supreme Realm, and you will be unrivaled in the universe."

"Alright! I’ll work hard to reach the Celestial God Realm, and we’ll go to the Primordial Realm when I’m ready to break through to the Three God Realms." Huo Ling nodded and smiled at Zhang Fei. "Ying Tai, how long will it take me to obtain the Sun Flame?"
"Two weeks, Master."
"Two weeks, huh?" Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "By the way, what is your relationship with Yin Ling?"
Ying Tai rubbed his nose embarrassedly. "Ling’er is my sister, but she is also my lover, Master."

"Oh? Moon and Sun being lovers is a little strange to me." Zhang Fei thought it was strange because day and night are always separate, as are the moon and sun. "Since Yin Ling is your sister and lover, you two can live together again."
"Are you really okay with that, Master?"
Zhang Fei smiled. "Why should I have a problem with that?"
"Does that mean Ling’er’s master is your wife, Master?"
Zhang Fei remembered Yin Yue and smiled to himself. "For now, I’m still helping Yin Yue strengthen her soul, and I’ll help her reshape her body in the future."
"Why don’t you dual soul cultivate with Yin Yue, Husband? That way, her soul power will strengthen much faster, and she can reshape her body ahead of schedule."
Zhang Fei sighed. "You know Yin Yue’s situation, right? I hadn’t thought about it before, but I think I’ll talk to her about this soon."

"Hehe," Huo Ling chuckled. "Husband, there is only one solution to revive the Moon Clan, and that solution is to take Yin Yue as your wife. When you two have children in the future, your children must use her surname."
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow slightly. "Actually, it’s not a problem for me, Ling’er. Even if my children use their mothers’ surnames, they are still my children."
"I think that’s good."
"Alright, let’s talk about that matter in the future. I don’t want to have children right now, and I’ll have children after I reach a stage where no cultivator can resist me anymore."

Mo Shentian, accompanied by Mo Zainan, stood in front of their three sons, two daughters, and two daughters-in-law. He watched them with a serious gaze, but he didn’t find anything strange about them. He didn’t even realize that Shang Xueli, Nalan Wangzi, Mo Yousha, and Mo Anqi in front of him were artificial dolls.
"Why did you gather us all here, Father?" Mo Zixiao asked.

"The beast is no random beast, and its power is truly formidable, husband.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei rubbed his chin.
"The Chaos Flame, huh?
Could it be the Chaos Beast?"
Ying Tai and Huo Ling froze, looking at Zhang Fei in shock.
"So, my guess is correct, huh?
The beast guarding the Chaos Flame is the Chaos Beast."
"How did you guess that the beast was the Chaos Beast?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed.
"In my home realm, there are many novels about cultivators and the like, and I read a lot of them in the past."
"What are novels?"
"Novels are fictional stories written by residents of my realm." After Zhang Fei made that statement, Ying Tai and Huo Ling exchanged puzzled glances.
"In some stories, the universe is described as being created by Chaos, and the Chaos Beasts are the children of Chaos.
Since the last heavenly flame is the Chaos Flame, I guess its guardian is a Chaos Beast."
Ying Tai shook his head slightly.
"I don’t understand how mortals in your home realm can think like that, but the guardian of the Chaos Flame is indeed the Chaos Beast."
"Do you have any memories of the Chaos Beast, Ling’er?"
Huo Ling nodded slightly and created a screen, showing the appearance of the Chaos Beast and the Chaos Flame.
Zhang Fei’s expression turned serious as he looked at the image of the Chaos Beast on the qi screen.
The Chaos Beast possessed a colossal physique forged from Chaos, its body towering like a mountain range beneath the heavens.
Black scales covered its monstrous body, each scale engraved with ancient runes.
Its flesh seemed neither completely solid nor ethereal, constantly twisting like the instability of reality itself.
Its crimson eyes glowed in the darkness, carrying both ferocity and indifference.
Endless black mist coiled around its body like living serpents, obscuring its true form.
There were two jagged horns spiraling toward the sky like broken heavenly pillars above its head.
Its claws were massive enough to tear through mountains.
A pair of enormous wings stretched across the heavens, blotting out the sunlight and shrouding the area in darkness.
Its tail resembled a giant black dragon forged from darkness, capable of leveling an entire area with a single strike.
Its limbs were thick as giant trees, and its fangs resembled ancient divine swords, each filled with a destructive intent.
The pressure radiating from its body alone caused any cultivators to kneel as their souls trembled uncontrollably.
"The Chaos Beast truly lives up to its name!" Zhang Fei exclaimed.
"Back then, in the era of the beginning, I didn’t see any images of the Chaos Beasts, and I only saw images of the two primordial beasts there."
"Husband, the Chaos Beast and this universe are one, so its image will not appear in the era of the beginning." Zhang Fei looked at Huo Ling.
"All the living beings that appeared in that place were those who were born after this universe was formed, and the Chaos Beast was born along with this universe."
"The Chaos Beast lives near the universe core, right?"
"That’s right," Huo Ling answered him with a nod.
"Ever since this universe was created, the Chaos Beast has never left that place, and it faithfully protects the Chaos Flame."
Zhang Fei thought for a while before asking again.
"Who spread the news about the ten heavenly flames in this universe?
Is that person Feng Yao?"
"Shen Yuanzhi was the first to spread the news about the ten heavenly flames, and all her reincarnations also spread the news, except my current master."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow.
"If Feng Yao didn’t spread the news about the ten heavenly flames, how could the people in the Three Mortal Realms have information about them?"
"Actually, my master is also confused regarding that matter, and she suspects that it has something to do with those hidden forces, such as the Fate."
"Fate, huh?" Zhang Fei mumbled.
"The lightning tribulations are also the work of those hidden forces, right?"
"The heavens control the lightning tribulations, and you must already understand why they want to kill you." Zhang Fei just smiled when Huo Ling mentioned his lightning tribulations.

"They haven’t sent down your lightning tribulations since you broke through to the Five Celestial Realms, and they’re likely waiting until your cultivation breaks through to the Celestial God Realm before attacking you again.
If that’s true, you will face lightning tribulations that no living creature has ever faced, and the realm you broke through will surely be completely destroyed by then."
Zhang Fei patted Huo Ling’s head.
"Don’t worry, okay?
Those lightning tribulations are powerful, but the heavens will never be able to kill me.
I’m still weak now, but I’ll become stronger in the future, and I’ll break through to the Exalt Supreme Realm.
At that time, I’ll challenge those hidden forces, especially the heavens, and I’ll destroy them."
"Hahaha!
Master, you can’t possibly defeat them, let alone destroy them.
They—Ouch." Ying Tai rubbed his head and looked at Huo Ling.
His neck shrank, seeing her deathly glare. ’Tch!
This brute big sister!’
Huo Ling looked at Zhang Fei with a serious look; she stretched out her hand and rubbed his cheek.
"Are you serious about destroying those hidden forces, husband?
I’ve watched you for a long time, and I’m satisfied with your development as a cultivator.
However, they are on a different level from all the enemies you have faced so far, and they have immense power.
Even my master doesn’t dare to fight them because she knows their strength, and she knows that she cannot defeat them."
"Have you ever heard me say nonsense?"
"No."
"See?" Zhang Fei sighed softly.
"I understand your concerns, but I won’t challenge them before I’m ready.
For now, I don’t want to think about them, and I will focus fully on reaching the pinnacle of the cultivation world.
When I have enough strength, I will challenge them, starting with the heavens, who have repeatedly tried to kill me."
Huo Ling could only sigh at Zhang Fei’s stubbornness.

After you obtain the Sun Flame, you should reduce all your outside activities and focus on pursuing your cultivation in seclusion.
I will accompany you to the location of the Chaos Flame once your cultivation reaches the Three God Realm."
